                                                                                heading
                                                                                Before you share the file
                                                                                items
                                                                                • q
                                                                                  Is an if-something-happens-to-me file the same as a will?
                                                                                  a
                                                                                  No. It is an information and location record. A will and other legal arrangements serve different purposes and must meet applicable requirements. Keep the location of current documents in the file, but get professional advice about their legal effect and who has authority to act.
                                                                                • q
                                                                                  Should I put every password in the folder?
                                                                                  a
                                                                                  Not as an openly accessible list. Record where approved access or recovery arrangements are managed, and protect credentials according to the relevant provider and security guidance. The appropriate process may differ during incapacity and after death. Knowing that an account exists does not authorise someone to sign in.
                                                                                • q
                                                                                  Is a half-finished file worth keeping?
                                                                                  a
                                                                                  Yes, if it clearly says what is current, what is incomplete and where the information came from. Start with immediate responsibilities and key document locations. Do not present an unfinished list as a complete legal or financial inventory, and avoid leaving a confident-looking answer where the real answer is unknown.

                                                                                heading
                                                                                Keep the map usable
                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                • The best first file is not the thickest one. It is the one with accurate directions, a clear access plan and someone who knows it exists. For the broader checklist, use [what to write down in case something happens](/guides/what-to-write-down-in-case-something-happens-to-you).
                                                                                • [Personal Life Affairs Companion](/shop/personal-life-affairs-companion) is an optional way to organise information you choose to record. It does not turn an information file into a will or grant authority. A protected folder and the free worksheet here are enough to begin.

                                                                                    • position
                                                                                      1
                                                                                      kind
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      • If the hotel cannot find your reservation, first confirm the exact property, arrival date, lead guest name and both the booking-site reference and hotel confirmation number. Show the original confirmation. If it was booked through a third party, contact that provider through its verified support route while asking the desk what can be established locally.
                                                                                      • You are at the counter, the bags are heavy, and your phone says confirmed while the desk says nothing is there. The immediate job is to find out whether the booking can be located and where you can stay tonight. You do not need to settle every refund question before taking the next useful step.
                                                                                      • This is a practical troubleshooting guide, not a guarantee of a room, compensation or a refund. Policies and legal rights depend on the booking, provider and jurisdiction. Keep the evidence and check the terms rather than accepting a generic promise from this article.
                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                      false

                                                                                      kind
                                                                                      list
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      Check the details that can actually change the search
                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                      true
                                                                                      items
                                                                                      • Match the full property name and street address. A chain name alone is not enough, especially near airports or in cities with several branches.
                                                                                      • Check arrival and departure dates, including a booking made for the night before a very early arrival. Ask whether the reservation was marked as a no-show or cancelled.
                                                                                      • Read the lead guest name exactly as shown on the confirmation, including another person's surname or the person who made the booking.
                                                                                      • Distinguish the travel site's order reference from a hotel confirmation number. Ask the desk which reference its system can search.
                                                                                      • Check whether the message confirms accommodation or only an enquiry, payment attempt or request. Look for changes and cancellation messages as well as the first email.

                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      If the hotel cannot find a third-party booking
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      • Contact the company you booked with using its app, original confirmation or verified website. Do not use an unverified support number supplied in a random search result or message. Ask the provider to contact the property, verify the booking status and give you the hotel-side confirmation reference.
                                                                                      • For a concrete policy example, [Hilton directs third-party customers](https://www.hilton.com/en-gb/help-center/reservations/can-i-book-through-a-third-party-site/) back to that provider for confirmation, changes and cancellation. Another brand or contract may work differently. The useful principle is to identify which party controls your booking, not assume the front desk can change a travel site's order.
                                                                                      • Ask for a case reference, the person's name or department and the next promised action. If possible, ask support to speak with the property directly while you remain available. A screenshot of a confirmation is helpful evidence, but it is not proof that the desk can create a room or override inventory.

                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      Before you pay for another room
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      • If you need somewhere safe to stay, practical constraints may require a new booking. Before paying where possible, ask the original provider what it is authorising and what remains unresolved. A verbal promise that someone will sort it out later is not the same as a written commitment to cover a particular cost.
                                                                                      • Check the new room's full price, taxes, deposit and cancellation terms. Keep the original reservation evidence and the new receipt. Do not assume a pending card hold is a second completed charge, or that a charge disappearing means a booking is valid. Your issuer can explain the transaction status and any dispute process or deadline that applies.
                                                                                      • If you are travelling with children, have access needs, or are arriving late with limited transport, tell the desk and provider what makes a proposed alternative unsuitable. This is information they need to assess an option; it does not create a universal entitlement to a specific replacement.
                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                    • position
                                                                                      10
                                                                                      kind
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      A booking that was there under another name
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      • An invented example: Alex arrives with a confirmation for the right property, but the desk's first search uses Alex's surname. The lead guest on the booking is Alex's partner. Searching the lead guest name and hotel reference finds it. That is one possible cause, not a reason to blame the traveller or assume every missing booking is a spelling problem.
                                                                                      • In a different case the provider cannot establish the booking and the hotel is full. The useful record then becomes the provider's case number, the property's confirmation of what it found, the agreed next step and any replacement costs. Keep the two situations distinct: locating a valid stay and negotiating an unresolved booking are different jobs.
                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                      false
                                                                                    • position
                                                                                      11
                                                                                      kind
                                                                                      faq
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      When the confirmation is not enough
                                                                                      items
                                                                                      • q
                                                                                        Does a confirmation email guarantee that the hotel has a room for me?
                                                                                        a
                                                                                        It is important evidence of what was booked, but it does not resolve every issue with dates, cancellation, transmission or available inventory. Compare the exact property, guest and dates, then ask the responsible provider to confirm current status. Keep the email while the parties investigate rather than treating it as a complete answer.
                                                                                      • q
                                                                                        Should I cancel the original reservation myself?
                                                                                        a
                                                                                        Not automatically. Ask the provider what cancellation would do to the existing case and any refund or replacement arrangements. If you choose to cancel, save the terms, confirmation and reason. Do not assume that cancelling a booking you cannot locate is required or harmless in every contract.
                                                                                      • q
                                                                                        Can the front desk refund a booking made on another website?
                                                                                        a
                                                                                        It depends on who collected the money and the booking terms. The property may not control the travel site's payment or order. Ask both parties who can make the change and request written next steps. A brand-specific support policy is not a universal rule for every booking platform.
                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                      false

                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      heading
                                                                                      Give the next conversation a starting point
                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                      • Once tonight is sorted, keep the case trail together. Our [one-page itinerary guide](/guides/how-to-write-a-one-page-trip-itinerary) helps put each stay's address, dates and references within reach. For a disrupted connection, use the separate [flight-delay guide](/guides/flight-delayed-with-a-connection-what-to-do-first).
                                                                                      • [Travel Companion](/shop/travel-companion) is an optional place for the travel details you enter. It does not locate a missing booking, contact a hotel or guarantee a refund. The free worksheet here can carry the same practical references without a purchase.

                                                                                      • position
                                                                                        1
                                                                                        kind
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        • A usable homeschool record keeping template records the date, the subject and lesson or activity, what actually happened, and a short observation or evidence reference when useful. Keep a separate place for required attendance, assessments and legal filings. A learning log can support your records, but it does not automatically satisfy every state's rules.
                                                                                        • The record is easy to postpone when the lesson has already taken the morning. Then a few weeks pass and you remember that there was science, but not which experiment, what changed, or where the photo went. The template's job is to leave a small trail while the details are still available.
                                                                                        • This guide is for US homeschool parents who want a practical daily record on paper, in a spreadsheet or in a chosen app. It is not a curriculum, a grading system or a legal compliance certificate. Check the requirements for your child's actual educational route before deciding what must be kept or submitted.

                                                                                        items
                                                                                        • Choose one place for each child's record. Add the child's name or identifier where more than one child uses the same sheet.
                                                                                        • After the learning activity, record the actual date and enough detail to identify the work later.
                                                                                        • Write what happened rather than what was scheduled. Mark unfinished or changed work without turning the entry into a judgment about the child.
                                                                                        • Add an observation or sample reference if it helps explain progress or a question to revisit.
                                                                                        • Check separately that required attendance, subject, assessment and filing records are being maintained under the rules that apply.

                                                                                        intro
                                                                                        These examples show the level of detail, not a recommended grade-level timetable or evidence of a real child's progress.
                                                                                        columns
                                                                                        • Date and activity
                                                                                        • What happened
                                                                                        • Useful next note
                                                                                        rows
                                                                                          • Monday: fractions, lesson 8
                                                                                          • Compared halves and quarters with paper strips
                                                                                          • Ask for an explanation without strips next time
                                                                                          • Tuesday: reading, chapter 4
                                                                                          • Read together; discussed why the character left
                                                                                          • Book title on the reading list; no additional sample needed
                                                                                          • Wednesday: planned writing session
                                                                                          • Stopped after the opening sentence; discussed the idea aloud
                                                                                          • Try a spoken outline before writing
                                                                                          • Thursday: seed observation
                                                                                          • Measured and sketched two seedlings
                                                                                          • Sketch in science folder, dated Thursday

                                                                                      • position
                                                                                        7
                                                                                        kind
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        heading
                                                                                        An observation is more useful than a performance label
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        • 'Difficult' tells you how the session felt, but may not explain what to do next. 'Could compare the strips but could not explain the relationship without them' names a specific question. You do not need that much detail for every activity. Save it for work where the next decision depends on what you noticed.
                                                                                        • Likewise, 'completed' and 'understood' are not interchangeable. A child can finish a worksheet with help, explain an idea orally without producing a page, or need another approach. Use [checking whether learning stuck](/guides/how-to-check-if-your-child-learned-something) when you need a better follow-up than another tick.
                                                                                        • Do not turn the log into continuous testing. Its purpose is to support teaching and preserve a record, not to force a score onto every conversation, book or outing.

                                                                                        heading
                                                                                        Keep legal requirements beside the template, not inside a guess
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        • As one jurisdiction-specific example, [Florida's home-education statute](https://wwwo.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=1000-1099%2F1002%2FSections%2F1002.41.html%2F) describes an activity log made as instruction happens, reading-material titles and samples of the student's work. That example does not tell a parent in another state what their records must contain.
                                                                                        • Find your current official rules and record the required items, deadlines and retention arrangements separately. Our [requirements verification guide](/guides/homeschool-record-keeping-requirements-by-state) explains that process. If an evaluator, school or authority requests records, confirm what is required rather than sending every private family note by default.

                                                                                        11
                                                                                        kind
                                                                                        list
                                                                                        heading
                                                                                        When the record falls behind
                                                                                        items
                                                                                        • Restart with today's actual work. Do not leave a growing blank period because the earlier pages are incomplete.
                                                                                        • Reconstruct older entries from dated work, reading lists and other evidence where possible, marking uncertain dates honestly.
                                                                                        • Do not backfill a weekly plan as a completed attendance or learning record. Keep the difference visible.
                                                                                        • Use [catching up on homeschool records](/guides/how-to-catch-up-on-homeschool-records) for a larger gap, and ask the relevant authority or adviser promptly if a required deadline is involved.
                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                        false
                                                                                      • position
                                                                                        12
                                                                                        kind
                                                                                        faq
                                                                                        heading
                                                                                        Keep the template workable
                                                                                        items
                                                                                        • q
                                                                                          Do I need an entry for every minute of homeschooling?
                                                                                          a
                                                                                          Not as a universal rule. This template is a learning log, not a national attendance requirement. Keep any hours, days, subjects or other evidence required for your situation separately and accurately. The useful level of detail is enough to identify actual work and support the next teaching or record-keeping decision.
                                                                                        • q
                                                                                          Can I use the same activity entry for two children?
                                                                                          a
                                                                                          You can record a shared activity once for logistics, but keep each child's involvement and evidence identifiable where needed. Children may do different work or understand different parts of the same topic. Do not automatically copy the same result to everyone just because they sat at the same table.
                                                                                        • q
                                                                                          Should I scan every worksheet into the log?
                                                                                          a
                                                                                          Not automatically. Keep the material your applicable rules require and useful samples that explain the work. A dated reference to where a sample is stored may be more manageable than attaching everything. Check submission and retention requirements before discarding originals or assuming a digital copy is sufficient.
                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                        false
                                                                                      • position
                                                                                        13
                                                                                        kind
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        heading
                                                                                        A record you will open tomorrow
                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                        • Use the smallest record that preserves the information you actually need. For selecting evidence across a year, read [what goes in a homeschool portfolio](/guides/what-goes-in-a-homeschool-portfolio). The log and portfolio serve related but different purposes.
                                                                                        • If keeping separate subjects and records for several children is the difficult part, [Homeschooling Companion](/shop/homeschooling-companion) is an optional organiser, not a curriculum or a compliance guarantee. The free record sheet here works on its own.

                                                                                          • position
                                                                                            1
                                                                                            kind
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            • A homeschool portfolio brings together the records and work samples needed to explain a child's learning over a period. Depending on your rules and purpose, that may include an activity log, reading-material titles, dated writing or mathematics samples, project evidence and required assessment records. Start with the actual requirements, then select evidence that is understandable rather than merely attractive.
                                                                                            • By the time you need the folder, the kitchen experiment has been cleared away and the best explanation happened out loud. A useful portfolio is built before those details disappear. It does not have to look like a published book. It has to make the work and its context findable.
                                                                                            • This guide is for US parents assembling evidence for their own records or a requested review. Portfolio requirements differ by educational route, location and purpose. The suggestions below are an organisation method, not a promise that every authority requires or accepts the same contents.
                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                            false

                                                                                            kind
                                                                                            list
                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            Find the purpose before choosing the pages
                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                            true
                                                                                            items
                                                                                            • Identify whether this is a personal learning record, a required evaluation portfolio, a transfer record or another specific submission.
                                                                                            • Locate the current official instructions for that purpose. Record required contents, deadlines, retention periods and who is entitled to request or receive material.
                                                                                            • Choose a date range and keep one child's evidence identifiable. Do not mix several children's work without clear attribution.
                                                                                            • Select dated items that show actual work and enough context to explain what the child did independently or with support.
                                                                                            • Check that the log and samples agree. Keep gaps and reconstructed details visible rather than manufacturing a complete-looking history.

                                                                                          • position
                                                                                            6
                                                                                            kind
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            Keep samples that explain progress, not just highlights
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            • A polished final page may be useful, but it can hide the learning that got there. When appropriate, keep earlier and later examples with a brief note explaining the task. A sample corrected heavily by an adult should not be presented as wholly independent work.
                                                                                            • You do not need to collect something impressive from every subject every week. Choose a manageable routine for saving useful evidence, alongside anything the applicable rules specifically require. The [learning-log template](/guides/homeschool-record-keeping-template) gives each sample a dated reference so you can find the supporting record.
                                                                                            • Practical, oral and collaborative work can still be documented. A short note of what the child explained, a sketch or a photograph with context may preserve more information than a photograph of a completed object alone. Check what the particular review accepts; an attractive photo is not a substitute for required evidence.
                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                            false
                                                                                          • position
                                                                                            7
                                                                                            kind
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            An invented portfolio entry with enough context
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            • Suppose a child compares two seedlings over several weeks. The portfolio holds a dated drawing and measurement note, a photograph of the setup and a brief explanation of what the child noticed. The entry also says which parts were done together and which explanation the child gave without prompting.
                                                                                            • The parent adds a later observation when the child changes the explanation. That pair tells a clearer story than a single picture labelled science project. It is still an example of documentation, not proof of a particular grade standard or a guarantee that an evaluator will accept those materials alone.

                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            Check local requirements without copying another family's rule
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            • For a specific statutory example, [Florida's home-education law](https://wwwo.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=1000-1099%2F1002%2FSections%2F1002.41.html%2F) describes an activity log, reading-material titles and samples of student work. That is a Florida example, not a universal definition for every state or home-learning arrangement.
                                                                                            • Use the [requirements verification guide](/guides/homeschool-record-keeping-requirements-by-state) to separate what must be retained from what must be submitted. Check current official instructions and ask for written clarification if requests conflict. Do not send private family information simply because it happens to be stored beside the learning records.

                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            Do one final evidence pass
                                                                                            items
                                                                                            • Make dates, child names and subject references consistent enough that someone can follow them without your memory filling every gap.
                                                                                            • Check that photographs and files open, that required originals are preserved, and that the review can use the format you chose.
                                                                                            • Separate required submissions from personal working notes. Share only what is appropriate through the agreed route.
                                                                                            • Save the submitted version and confirmation, then use [preparing for a homeschool evaluation](/guides/preparing-for-a-homeschool-evaluation) for the appointment or process itself.

                                                                                            12
                                                                                            kind
                                                                                            faq
                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            A portfolio does not have to be a showcase
                                                                                            items
                                                                                            • q
                                                                                              How many samples should I keep for each subject?
                                                                                              a
                                                                                              There is no universal number. Start with the applicable rules and the purpose of the portfolio. Then choose enough relevant, dated evidence to explain the work and any development over time. A large stack of repetitive pages is not automatically more informative than a smaller set with clear context.
                                                                                            • q
                                                                                              Can a homeschool portfolio be digital?
                                                                                              a
                                                                                              It can be useful digitally, but check the format accepted for the particular review and any rules about originals. Use understandable file names, dates, backups and access permissions. Make sure a reviewer can actually open the material before assuming a shared folder or a link is sufficient.
                                                                                            • q
                                                                                              Should I leave mistakes out of the portfolio?
                                                                                              a
                                                                                              Not automatically. Earlier work and a later correction can explain learning, especially when the task and support are recorded. Select evidence for the portfolio's actual purpose, not to manufacture an appearance of perfect performance. Keep any specifically required materials even when they are not the pieces you would otherwise choose.
                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                            false

                                                                                            heading
                                                                                            Make the evidence easy to return to
                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                            • The practical goal is a record you can explain and locate. Keep the [reading log](/guides/homeschool-reading-log), daily activity references and selected work connected instead of maintaining three unrelated archives.
                                                                                            • [Homeschooling Companion](/shop/homeschooling-companion) is an optional place to organise the learning information you enter. It is not a curriculum, evaluator or legal certification. A clearly labelled folder and the free worksheet can do the first useful job without a purchase.

                                                                                            • position
                                                                                              1
                                                                                              kind
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              • If your to-do list feels overwhelming, check whether it is trying to be a backlog, a decision-maker, a calendar and a set of instructions at the same time. Keep the full record somewhere findable, then choose one useful next action and keep real deadlines visible. You do not have to rewrite the whole list before starting.
                                                                                              • Taxes. Dentist. Mum's birthday. Fix the car. Those are useful reminders that something exists. They are not yet instructions you can follow. When every glance requires you to decide the priority, remember the context and work out the first move, looking at the list can become another task.
                                                                                              • This is an organisational experiment, not a diagnosis or a treatment for ADHD, anxiety or other conditions. Lists help many people; feeling stuck does not prove a particular cause. If difficulties are persistent or affecting daily life, seek appropriate support rather than assuming a better planner must solve everything.

                                                                                              false

                                                                                              2
                                                                                              kind
                                                                                              list
                                                                                              heading
                                                                                              Reset one item, not the whole backlog
                                                                                              checkable
                                                                                              true
                                                                                              items
                                                                                              • Choose one item that matters today. Check actual deadlines and consequences before picking the easiest item by default.
                                                                                              • Rewrite it as a visible action you can take: open, find, ask, compare, send or book, with the object named.
                                                                                              • Put the information needed for that action beside it, such as the document location, contact or booking reference.
                                                                                              • If the action depends on someone else, record who you are waiting for and when to review it. Do not keep calling it today's task if you cannot advance it.
                                                                                              • Keep the rest of the backlog available but outside this immediate view. Make a deliberate review time so out of sight does not become forgotten.

                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              heading
                                                                                              Do not make everything due today
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              • A date can mean a deadline, a planned session or a reminder to check something. If every row says today, you lose that distinction. Keep real deadlines explicit. Put a review date on waiting work and an intended time on work you actually plan to do.
                                                                                              • That is not permission to ignore an overdue bill or official notice. If the consequences are already active, the next step may be to contact the relevant organisation or get qualified help, not spend the morning reformatting the list. Use [starting when everything is overdue](/guides/how-to-start-when-everything-is-overdue) for triage rather than applying a gentle backlog reset to an urgent situation.

                                                                                              kind
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              heading
                                                                                              A first move can reveal a different obstacle
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              • Sometimes the action is clear and you still cannot start. You may lack time, money, permission, energy or a decision. You may be worried about the result. A smaller verb cannot remove every barrier, and that does not make the method or the person a failure.
                                                                                              • An invented example: Rowan changes insurance to 'open the renewal letter'. Once it is open, the obstacle is not remembering where to click. The quote is unaffordable. The next task becomes understanding the options or seeking advice, not creating a more elaborate reminder to renew.
                                                                                              • If this is the recurring pattern, [thinking about a task without doing it](/guides/why-you-keep-thinking-about-a-task-and-not-doing-it) explores the decision bottleneck, while [the ten-minute task-paralysis guide](/guides/task-paralysis-what-to-do-in-the-next-ten-minutes) focuses on a short attempt at starting. Neither should be presented as a clinical explanation for every reader.

                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              • The [East London NHS support page](https://www.elft.nhs.uk/adult-adhd-services/support-available) includes task and organisation resources among wider support options. That is a useful counterweight to the claim that lists are inherently bad. A particular format can help one person and create extra work for another.
                                                                                              • Try this reset on a small part of your existing system before moving everything into a new app. Judge whether you can find the action, the necessary information and the follow-up. A tidy screenshot is not the measure of whether a tool fits your day.

                                                                                              heading
                                                                                              When the list is still difficult
                                                                                              items
                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                Does struggling with a to-do list mean I have ADHD?
                                                                                                a
                                                                                                No. A list problem alone cannot diagnose ADHD or any other condition. There are many possible practical and personal reasons a task may be difficult. If attention, organisation or starting difficulties are persistent and affect daily life, discuss the broader pattern with an appropriate qualified professional.
                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                Should I delete my backlog to feel less overwhelmed?
                                                                                                a
                                                                                                Not automatically. Deleting everything can also remove real obligations and useful context. Separate the immediate action view from the stored backlog, preserve important deadlines and make a review arrangement. Remove outdated items deliberately rather than using deletion as a substitute for checking whether something still matters.
                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                What if even the first small action feels impossible?
                                                                                                a
                                                                                                Check what is making it unavailable: missing information, a decision, cost, time, energy or distress. The appropriate next step may be asking for support or clarifying the problem, not making the action smaller forever. Use urgent or professional help appropriate to the actual circumstances rather than relying on a list technique.

                                                                                              heading
                                                                                              A list with a smaller job
                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                              • Keep the obligations. Give today's action a clearer place. The free reset sheet asks what matters, what can move, what is blocked and when the rest will be reviewed.
                                                                                              • [ADHD Life Companion](/shop/adhd-life-companion) is an optional product to consider if its approach suits you. It is not a diagnosis or treatment, and no product is required for the method here. Start with one useful action, not a promise to become a different kind of person.

                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                1
                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                • A current balance commonly reflects transactions that have posted, while an available balance reflects what the bank currently makes available after its treatment of holds and pending items. Labels and calculations differ by bank and account. Neither number is a complete spending plan: a future bill or a transaction the bank has not yet received may still need to be covered.
                                                                                                • The app shows two numbers, and the larger one is tempting. The problem is not choosing the optimistic balance. It is working out what each number already includes, and what still has to leave the account. Subtracting every pending item again can be just as misleading as ignoring every commitment.
                                                                                                • This guide concerns deposit-account balances, not credit-card available credit. It is general organisation guidance, not a prediction that a bank will honour a particular payment. Read your own account terms and contact the bank about unclear transactions, holds or an unexpected balance.

                                                                                                Check the balance without double-counting
                                                                                                checkable
                                                                                                true
                                                                                                items
                                                                                                • Note which account and balance label you are using, and the time you checked it.
                                                                                                • Inspect pending transactions and holds. Establish whether each is already reflected in the displayed available amount.
                                                                                                • List outstanding commitments the bank does not yet reflect, such as a bill you still need to pay or a payment not yet presented.
                                                                                                • Keep the money needed before your next reliable income available in the appropriate account. Do not include uncertain income as if it has arrived.
                                                                                                • Ask the bank about anything you cannot reconcile, especially unfamiliar charges, negative balances or a hold affecting an important payment.

                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                A pending item is not a promise about the final result
                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                • A pending amount may change, be replaced by a final transaction or disappear from the immediate view. That alone does not tell you that an obligation has been cancelled. Ask the merchant or bank about the relevant transaction rather than relying on its temporary appearance.
                                                                                                • In its [posting guidance](https://www.chase.com/personal/checking/overdraft-services/how-transactions-post), Chase says that pending activity affects available balance, that some authorised transactions may not appear as pending, and that daytime display does not guarantee later payment. This is a specific bank's explanation, not a rule copied across every provider.
                                                                                                • If your bank includes an overdraft facility or another credit arrangement in what it displays, separate borrowed availability from your own funds. Check the terms, costs and payment consequences. Do not count a lending limit as income or assume that every account displays it in the same way.

                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                The bank cannot reserve an intention it has not received
                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                • A bill due next week, a cheque not yet presented, or groceries still to buy may not be represented in the number on screen. Your record supplies that missing context. Keep a [monthly bills list](/guides/monthly-bills-list) and review [what is due before direct debits leave](/guides/what-to-check-before-each-direct-debit-date).
                                                                                                • An invented example: the app shows enough for an optional purchase, but an annual insurance payment is due before payday and has not reached the bank. The account is not wrong. The spending decision is missing a commitment. For that broader decision, use [how much money is actually safe to spend](/guides/how-much-of-your-money-is-actually-safe-to-spend).
                                                                                                • The opposite mistake is reserving the same purchase in three places: it reduced available, it remains in a pending list, and it is also included in an upcoming-bills total. Match individual items before subtracting totals. A more conservative number is not automatically a more accurate one.

                                                                                                items
                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                  Should I use current or available balance before spending?
                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                  Available balance is often the more relevant immediate availability figure, but check how your own bank defines it. Account separately for commitments not already reflected. Neither balance guarantees a payment will clear or tells you what is affordable after all upcoming needs. Do not automatically subtract pending items twice.
                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                  Why is my available balance lower than my current balance?
                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                  Pending transactions, deposit availability rules or holds may explain a difference, depending on your account. Open the detailed activity and ask the bank about unclear entries. Do not infer that a particular hold has expired, that a merchant was paid or that a deposit is fully usable from the difference alone.
                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                  Does money disappearing from pending mean I can spend it?
                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                  Not necessarily. A pending display can change before the final transaction arrives. Keep your own record of what you authorised and ask the bank or merchant if the status is unclear. Removing an item from a screen is not the same as confirming that the underlying obligation has ended.
                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                false

                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                Use the account number with the rest of the picture
                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                • Start with a balance you understand, match the items already represented, and reserve what remains due. You are building a spending decision, not trying to make the banking app show a more reassuring number.
                                                                                                • [Personal Finance Companion](/shop/personal-finance-companion) is an optional organiser for the financial information you enter. It cannot decide what your bank will pay or make an uncertain balance reliable. The worksheet here works without connecting a bank account or buying a product.

                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  • If your budgeting app has stopped being useful, identify the failure before replacing it: outdated transactions, excessive maintenance, missing commitments, unclear categories or income that does not cover the required costs. Restart with current balances and the bills due next, then restore only the detail you need. There is no evidence here for a universal two-month failure point.
                                                                                                  • The app opens with money left in a category, but you know the number cannot be right. Several purchases are uncategorised and an annual bill never made it into the plan. You close it, not because you stopped caring about money, but because this screen no longer answers a question you can trust.
                                                                                                  • That is one possible pattern, not a diagnosis of every abandoned budget. This guide is for someone deciding whether to repair an existing system or change it. It is not financial advice, and no app can close a real gap between reliable income and essential costs just by reorganising the categories.
                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                  Find which part stopped helping
                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                  • Check when balances and transactions were last updated. Separate missing data from money that is actually missing.
                                                                                                  • List essential payments due before the next reliable income, including non-monthly bills and known commitments.
                                                                                                  • Identify the maintenance job you stopped doing: imports, category decisions, manual entry, reconciliation or something else.
                                                                                                  • Choose one decision the budget should support this week, such as whether the next bills are covered. Do not rebuild every report first.
                                                                                                  • If essential costs exceed reliable income, deal with that problem directly and seek appropriate support rather than treating it as a software failure.

                                                                                                  6
                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                  Repair a trustworthy starting point
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  • Start with the accounts you intend to include and note the date of the snapshot. Check pending activity and outstanding commitments rather than treating a higher balance as extra money. The [available versus current balance guide](/guides/available-balance-vs-current-balance) explains why the banking label still needs context.
                                                                                                  • If a backlog is large, you may decide to use a documented current starting point for planning while preserving old statements and any records needed for tax, disputes, reporting or other obligations. Do not erase required history just to make the app tidy. Write down what the reset includes and what remains unreconciled.
                                                                                                  • The [CFPB toolkit](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/educator-tools/your-money-your-goals/toolkit/) separates spending tracking, income, bill management and cash-flow tools. That is a useful distinction: a spending chart and a plan for paying next Tuesday's bill do not answer the same question.
                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                  An invented reset after two missed weeks
                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                  • A parent has two weeks of uncategorised activity and does not trust the remaining grocery figure. They do not assume the money is available, and they do not rebuild six months of reports before checking the rent. First they confirm current balances, expected income and the essential payments due before it arrives.
                                                                                                  • They then review the missing activity in a small, clearly defined period, watching for duplicates and forgotten bills. They reduce category choices that do not affect a decision, while preserving distinctions they actually need. The result is not proof that fewer categories work for everybody. It is a test of whether this particular system is maintainable.

                                                                                                    Sharing the household job
