                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                • Name a first contact and willing backup, with current ways to reach them.
                                                                                                                                                • List dependants and the location of their established care instructions.
                                                                                                                                                • Identify urgent household commitments and where the current bills or calendar can be found.
                                                                                                                                                • List important providers by name, not every private account identifier.
                                                                                                                                                • Record where legal, identity and insurance documents are kept and who can lawfully obtain them.
                                                                                                                                                • Point to a protected digital-access plan or provider legacy setting rather than exposing secrets here.
                                                                                                                                                • Date the page and tell the intended helper where it is.

                                                                                                                                                7
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                Use two levels of privacy
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                • The first page can contain names and locations, but those are still personal information. Share it only with people who need it and choose storage appropriate to your situation. A note pointing to a safe is not harmless if it also explains exactly how to open it.
                                                                                                                                                • Keep sensitive identifiers, passwords, recovery codes, access keys and medical detail in a more protected arrangement. There is no need to make the same page both easy to find and capable of opening every account. Your trusted person should know the lawful route to the next record, not receive unrestricted access by accident.
                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                8
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                Do not turn access planning into impersonation
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                • Knowing a phone passcode or having a physical key does not settle whether someone may transact, read private material or make decisions. Check each institution's process and any relevant legal arrangements. For money or healthcare authority, obtain appropriate advice rather than relying on a note saying 'please handle everything.'
                                                                                                                                                • For your own Google account, [Inactive Account Manager](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/3036546?hl=en) allows chosen data sharing or notification after a selected period of inactivity. It is not an immediate emergency login and does not provide unrestricted access. Other providers need their own current checks.

                                                                                                                                                10
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                Test the locations rather than sharing secrets
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                • Ask your intended helper, while you are available, to locate the page and explain which contact they would approach first. Have them identify an unclear location such as 'office file.' You can correct it to a useful description without showing private document contents.
                                                                                                                                                • Test practical barriers too. Is the folder in a locked home nobody can enter? Does the backup know they were named? Is the only copy on a device that requires you to unlock it? Solve the retrieval problem with the right level of privacy rather than hiding the record more thoroughly.

                                                                                                                                                  Willingness
                                                                                                                                                  line
                                                                                                                                                  Would you be willing to be the first contact if I cannot respond? I am writing a short list of who to call and where the important records are.
                                                                                                                                                • situation
                                                                                                                                                  Limits
                                                                                                                                                  line
                                                                                                                                                  This page does not give you authority over accounts or medical decisions. It should help you find the right people and documents.

                                                                                                                                                  line

                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                12
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                When a page is not enough
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                • Children, a business, care responsibilities, disputed relationships or property in several places may need more detailed arrangements. The [NIA affairs-in-order checklist](https://www.nia.nih.gov/health/advance-care-planning/getting-your-affairs-order-checklist-documents-prepare-future?page=1) is an official planning starting point; this revision reviewed its search listing, not the blocked full page. Use qualified legal or care professionals for documents that establish authority.
                                                                                                                                                • If there is coercion, abuse or a risk that a person will misuse access, do not hand over a comprehensive map of your affairs to them. Seek confidential professional help to plan access and contacts safely. Trust and convenience are not the only considerations.
                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                13
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                Keep it current without rewriting your life
                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                • Review after changes in contacts, home, work, care or providers, and choose a periodic reminder that you can maintain. Mark the last review date. Remove obsolete shared copies where possible and tell helpers when the location changes.
                                                                                                                                                • When the first page works, expand using [the fuller if-something-happens file](/guides/the-if-something-happens-to-me-file). Keep this page short enough to answer the first few questions, rather than duplicating the whole archive. Unknown entries can become a small follow-up list.
                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                14
                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                faq
                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                  Is this the same as a will?
                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                  No. This page is a practical index to people, commitments and records. Legal documents have their own purposes and validity rules. A useful location note does not create financial authority, appoint a guardian or replace instructions for medical decisions.
                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                  Should the helper have my passwords?
                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                  Use a protected, provider-appropriate access plan rather than putting passwords on the first page. Consider authorization as well as technical access. The right arrangement depends on the provider and situation; a recovery feature may share limited data or require a separate request.
                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                  What if I cannot finish every line?
                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                  Finish the useful parts and mark unknowns. Prioritize the first contact, immediate dependants and document location. A partial page should be labeled honestly so nobody assumes a blank means nothing exists. Give each consequential gap a next action rather than inventing an answer.

                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • After a death, preserve devices and account information before deleting or closing anything. Identify the authorized person, decide whether data is needed and use each provider's deceased-user process. A death certificate, family relationship or known password does not automatically establish unrestricted access.
                                                                                                                                                      • The phone may hold family photographs, authentication messages and business records at once. The wish to stop recurring charges can conflict with the need to preserve information. This guide organizes that decision. It cannot unlock a device, determine legal rights or promise that a provider will release content.
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      2
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      Separate three different requests
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • Closing an account, obtaining selected data and taking control of an account are different actions. Ask the provider what it supports and what evidence is required. Do not interpret a closure form as an inheritance claim or assume a successful identity check transfers all the account's contents.
                                                                                                                                                      • Also separate a device from an online service. Possession of a laptop does not mean a cloud account can be opened, and access to one service does not establish the right to transact through another. Provider terms and applicable law may treat messages, purchased content, money and stored files differently.
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      3
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      Preserve the starting position
                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                      • Keep devices, storage media and existing documentation secure without trying repeated passcode guesses.
                                                                                                                                                      • Record the services you know exist and the evidence for each, using only lawful access.
                                                                                                                                                      • Identify the estate representative or other person authorized for the proposed task.
                                                                                                                                                      • List what must be preserved, what is costing money and what can wait.
                                                                                                                                                      • Find each provider's official deceased-user or bereavement instructions.
                                                                                                                                                      • Save requests, supporting-document copies and confirmation numbers in a protected file.
                                                                                                                                                      • Do not close an account until the person responsible has considered related data requests and dependencies.

                                                                                                                                                      6

                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      What Google actually says
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • [Google's deceased-user request process](https://support.google.com/accounts/troubleshooter/6357590?hl=en) says it may work with immediate family or representatives to close an account and may provide content in certain circumstances after review. It does not provide passwords or other login details.
                                                                                                                                                      • The same page warns that closing an account prevents a later request for its contents. If a content request is already pending, Google says to wait for that process before submitting a closure request. This is a provider-specific warning, not evidence that every service uses the same rules.

                                                                                                                                                        • Phone
                                                                                                                                                        • Is useful local data preserved?
                                                                                                                                                        • Secure it and obtain appropriate advice
                                                                                                                                                        • Photo service
                                                                                                                                                        • Is there a verified backup or legacy arrangement?
                                                                                                                                                        • Check the provider's current instructions
                                                                                                                                                        • Paid subscription
                                                                                                                                                        • Can billing stop without destroying needed files?
                                                                                                                                                        • Ask about cancellation and retention separately

                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      Do not turn recovery into impersonation
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • A saved browser session or password manager entry may make access technically possible. It does not settle whether the person using it is authorized. Do not change beneficiaries, move money, send messages as the deceased person or accept new terms on their behalf because a session remains open.
                                                                                                                                                      • If the account contains business, client, employee or confidential professional material, involve the appropriate responsible person. The estate's interests may not be the only duties involved. Preserve potentially relevant material and seek advice before copying or distributing it.
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      9
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      Build a request log, not a guessing campaign
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • For each provider, record the account identifier, official help page, desired outcome, claimant role, documents requested and submission status. Give private evidence only through the verified channel, and share the minimum required. Be cautious about unofficial services promising guaranteed access.
                                                                                                                                                      • If a request is refused, ask what the refusal means: missing evidence, an unsupported request type or a final policy decision. Ask whether an appeal or legal process exists. A court document may be relevant, but this guide cannot promise a court can compel any particular disclosure.

                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      Treat billing and authentication as dependencies
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • A subscription may renew while access is unresolved. Contact the provider and authorized payment or estate representative about the billing route. Do not assume canceling a payment closes the account or that closing the account resolves every financial obligation.
                                                                                                                                                      • An email address or phone number can also receive notices for other services. Record those dependencies without using password resets as an automatic workaround. Retaining a service temporarily can have costs and privacy implications; have the responsible person decide what is proportionate.
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      For your own accounts, plan separately
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • [Google's Inactive Account Manager](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/3036546?hl=en) lets an account holder choose notifications or selected data sharing after inactivity. It does not provide unrestricted login access or operate simply because a family member reports a death.
                                                                                                                                                      • Check any other provider's current legacy setting directly and tell the intended contact what you have arranged. Keep access keys or recovery instructions protected and findable. For the household's broader map, use [what to write down in advance](/guides/what-to-write-down-in-case-something-happens-to-you).
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      14
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                      When to escalate
                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                      • Get qualified advice when authority is disputed, essential business records are involved, a device is locked or significant funds depend on an account. Noncustodial digital assets and hosted financial accounts have different recovery routes; there is no universal conclusion that all cryptocurrency is either recoverable or lost.
                                                                                                                                                      • If there is a suspected security incident, contact the provider through a known channel rather than clicking a message offering help. Keep a record of the incident and do not publish identity documents or sensitive credentials in a family discussion thread.
                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                      15
                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                        Can the provider give me the password?
                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                        Do not assume so. Google's verified process specifically says it will not provide passwords or other login details, even when it considers a deceased-user request. Another provider may offer selected data or closure rather than login access. Check the exact supported outcome.
                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                        Should I delete social accounts first?
                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                        Not automatically. Decide whether messages, photographs, evidence or another request need preserving, and use the platform's current process. Memorialization, closure and data release are separate possibilities whose availability varies. This guide does not verify a universal social-media rule.
                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                        Does being executor guarantee access?
                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                        No universal guarantee follows from that role. Providers may require particular documentation, consent, review or legal process, and different data can be treated differently. Ask for the official requirements and get legal advice if essential records or a disputed claim cannot be resolved administratively.

                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • Keep a document while it supports ownership, rights, tax reporting, an active account, a claim or another unresolved purpose. Protect important originals and confirm the applicable retention rule before destroying them. Age alone is not enough to decide what can go.
                                                                                                                                                          • A drawer can contain obsolete leaflets beside the only evidence of a paid loan. Sorting all of it into 'older than seven years' is quick but unsafe. This guide is for ordinary US household records. Business records, an estate, a dispute or a legal hold need their own advice.

                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Ask what the paper proves
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • For every important document, finish 'I may need this to show...' A closing statement may help establish property history; an old policy may matter to a claim; a statement may support a tax entry or prove a payment. One document can serve several purposes, so use the longest relevant retention need.
                                                                                                                                                          • Separate true duplicates from different versions. A later summary may not contain the terms, endorsement, signature or transaction detail that made the original important. Do not call something a duplicate merely because it has the same account name.

                                                                                                                                                          Sort without premature destruction
                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                          • Set aside current legal and identity originals before handling ordinary correspondence.
                                                                                                                                                          • Create a separate group for active disputes, claims, notices and uncertain documents.
                                                                                                                                                          • Link tax-supporting records to the relevant return rather than leaving them in a generic bank-statement pile.
                                                                                                                                                          • Keep property acquisition, improvement and disposal evidence together.
                                                                                                                                                          • Check whether replacement copies are available, what they cost and whether they include the needed detail.
                                                                                                                                                          • Write a retention reason and review trigger for the archive.
                                                                                                                                                          • Destroy sensitive records securely only after the decision is established.

                                                                                                                                                          6

                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Use federal tax periods with their exceptions
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • [IRS Topic 305](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc305) explains that records supporting a return must remain available for the relevant limitations period. Its general assessment period is three years, but exceptions and other deadlines apply. A refund claim, substantial omitted income, a fraudulent return or no return can change the analysis.
                                                                                                                                                          • Do not reduce this to 'all receipts can go after three years.' State taxes, unresolved notices and other purposes can require longer retention. If the filing history or rule is unclear, consult a qualified tax professional before shredding.

                                                                                                                                                            • Maintain an asset history

                                                                                                                                                          8
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Invented example: an old drawer
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • A household finds a 2019 tax return, a recent kitchen invoice, a canceled subscription notice and an old employer insurance document. None is assigned a destruction date from its age alone. The tax return is checked against filing circumstances and any open issue. The invoice is classified by what work it describes and whether it is relevant to the property's records.
                                                                                                                                                          • The cancellation notice stays until billing is resolved. The old insurance paper is checked with the provider before being treated as irrelevant. This example is a sorting method, not advice that any particular expense increases tax basis or any specific old return is safe to destroy.

                                                                                                                                                          9
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Property papers often have a longer story
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • The IRS guidance specifically discusses property records: their relevance can extend through the limitations period for the year of disposal. Purchase, improvement, depreciation and sale information can connect across many tax years. Not every repair is a capital improvement, and mixed-use or inherited property can complicate matters.
                                                                                                                                                          • Keep the underlying documents and ask a tax professional about treatment where needed. Avoid writing 'all home improvement receipts raise basis' on an index; that is a tax conclusion the index cannot establish.

                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          11
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Choose storage by access and consequence
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • Keep frequently needed current material in an accessible protected place. Store important originals where they are protected from foreseeable damage and can be obtained by an authorized person. A location known only to you is not a complete retrieval plan.
                                                                                                                                                          • Make a low-detail index describing what exists, its location, the custodian and any access restriction. Do not put safe codes or full account identifiers on a widely shared index. If a safe-deposit box or adviser holds originals, confirm the actual access process rather than assuming a spare key is sufficient.

                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          A scan is a backup, not automatic permission to shred
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • A readable scan can make ordinary information easier to find, but acceptance depends on the document and purpose. Check whether a recipient needs an original, certified copy or specific electronic format. Do not destroy signed legal papers based on a general article about digital filing.
                                                                                                                                                          • Check scan completeness, both sides, attachments and legibility before relying on it. Keep a protected backup separate from the only device and test that you can retrieve it. An encrypted file whose recovery method nobody can use has its own access problem.

                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          14
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                          Stop the shred pile when circumstances change
                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                          • Pause destruction when a claim, investigation, audit, dispute or litigation is pending or reasonably relevant. Follow any formal preservation requirement and get advice if you are unsure. Do not discard something merely because its routine review date arrived.
                                                                                                                                                          • For a repair-specific archive, use [what to keep after a home repair](/guides/what-to-keep-after-a-home-repair). For the short map someone else can follow, use [the advance handover list](/guides/what-to-write-down-in-case-something-happens-to-you). The index and the retention decision are related but separate jobs.

                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                          15
                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                            Can I throw away bank statements after a year?
                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                            Not automatically. Check whether they support a tax entry, prove payment, document a dispute or establish another important fact. A general household review point is not a legal destruction rule. Verify what the bank can reissue before relying on future access.
                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                            Do tax records always need seven years?
                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                            No single period covers every situation. IRS guidance starts with a general limitations period and lists exceptions; property and claim records may have longer relevance. State rules can differ. Check the record's actual purpose and filing circumstances rather than applying a universal seven-year label.
                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                            Should I destroy an old will when I sign a new one?
                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                            Ask the lawyer or other qualified adviser handling the change. Earlier documents may matter in some circumstances, and validity or revocation questions are not resolved by a filing checklist. Keep current documents clearly identified without independently deciding which legal history should disappear.

                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                1
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • After a home repair, keep the itemized invoice, your original symptom, the technician's findings, the work and parts supplied, warranty terms and any remaining action. Save supporting photos and payment evidence with that record. If the fault returns, the next person should be able to see what actually happened.
                                                                                                                                                                • A paid invoice can be detailed or very brief. Neither the amount nor 'service call completed' necessarily tells you whether the original problem was resolved. This guide helps homeowners and renters document a visit. It does not diagnose equipment or decide whether a charge is reasonable.
                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                2
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Separate what you saw from what you were told
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • Write the symptom in observable terms: 'water under the sink after running the dishwasher' rather than 'pump failed.' Record a diagnosis as the technician's finding, especially when it remains uncertain. Save a test result or written service note where available.
                                                                                                                                                                • Then distinguish work completed from work proposed. 'Replaced the hose' is not the same as 'recommended replacement.' If the provider could not reproduce an intermittent fault, preserve that conclusion instead of recording the visit as a confirmed repair.

                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Capture the completed visit
                                                                                                                                                                checkable
                                                                                                                                                                true
                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                • Identify the equipment, location, model and serial where relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                • Save visit date, provider, job reference and technician details offered.
                                                                                                                                                                • Record the original symptom and any relevant photos taken safely.
                                                                                                                                                                • Ask for findings and actual work in writing, including part identifiers where useful.
                                                                                                                                                                • Save the accepted estimate, approved changes, itemized invoice and payment proof.
                                                                                                                                                                • Confirm any parts, labor or workmanship warranty and its claims process.
                                                                                                                                                                • List unresolved faults, restrictions on use and promised return visits.
                                                                                                                                                                • Set a follow-up date for each open item rather than closing the whole job.

                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Ask before the visit ends
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • Ask what was checked, what was not checked and whether normal use is appropriate. A technician may have resolved one fault but identified another unrelated concern. Confirm which matters are included in the price and which need a separate approval.
                                                                                                                                                                • The [FTC contractor guidance](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/how-avoid-home-improvement-scam) recommends written estimates and contracts and keeping the relevant records. For a substantial project, include change orders, completion documents and any permits or inspection approvals that apply. A personal note cannot replace required paperwork.

                                                                                                                                                                10
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Check warranty terms before authorizing more work
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • If a failure may be covered, use the actual warranty claim route before agreeing to an independent paid repair. Ask about required authorization, covered parts, labor, call-out fees and evidence. Do not assume the repair is free simply because the appliance is within a broad warranty date.
                                                                                                                                                                • At the same time, do not assume any outside work automatically voids all warranty coverage. The [FTC warranty guidance](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/warranties) explains limits on requirements for specified parts or services. Coverage questions depend on the terms, the cause and applicable law. For a dispute, ask for the reason and seek appropriate consumer advice.
                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                11
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Keep the tax question separate
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • Do not classify work by everyday language alone. [IRS Publication 523](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p523) distinguishes repairs from improvements and gives examples. A replacement system can be an improvement even if you called the job a repair because the old one broke.
                                                                                                                                                                • Keep invoices with a description of the scope, particularly where a repair becomes part of a larger renovation. Ask a tax professional about basis, rental use or another relevant issue. Do not assume every invoice increases home basis, or that every replacement after failure is excluded.
