                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                12
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                Renters need a different responsibility note
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • Record who reported the problem, who authorized entry or work and which landlord or manager is handling payment. Do not commission chargeable work in someone else's name or assume reimbursement without checking the lease and applicable process. Preserve communications about the fault and access.
                                                                                                                                                                • If a safety issue remains or the property cannot be used normally, contact the responsible person promptly and seek local advice where necessary. The service ticket should not be treated as proof that a housing or safety obligation has been satisfied.
                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                13
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                If the problem returns
                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                • Refer to the original symptom, job reference and outcome rather than starting with an unverified diagnosis. Describe what changed and ask whether the provider treats this as a return visit, warranty claim or new fault. Confirm any charge before authorizing work.
                                                                                                                                                                • Stop using equipment if the provider directs you to or if there is an immediate hazard. Do not continue test cycles around dangerous water or electricity to obtain better evidence. For routine future service, carry the relevant note into [your maintenance log](/guides/home-maintenance-log-template).
                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                14
                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                faq
                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                  Is a receipt enough?
                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                  It may prove payment but omit the diagnosis, scope or warranty. Keep it together with the accepted work description, invoice and any service notes. Ask for missing details while the visit is recent, and label your own recollection separately from the provider's written findings.
                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                  How long should I keep the record?
                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                  Use its purpose: equipment history, warranty, insurance, tax, property work or an unresolved dispute may need different retention. There is no single destruction date for every repair. Preserve records while a claim or other relevant issue remains open and seek advice before discarding uncertain documents.
                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                  Should I keep a replaced part?
                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                  Ask the provider whether there is a safety, warranty-return or disposal reason affecting it. Do not keep hazardous material or interfere with a required return simply for an archive. A written part identifier and suitable photograph may be more useful, but claim requirements vary.

                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                    1
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • Track the appliance's identity, proof of purchase, warranty start rule, separate coverage periods and claim instructions. Keep the actual warranty terms, not just an expiry reminder. Before authorizing a paid repair, ask what the warranty covers and whether the provider requires a particular claim process.
                                                                                                                                                                    • A label saying 'ten-year warranty' can hide different periods for a major component, other parts and labor. A single calendar date may therefore give the wrong impression. This guide concerns ordinary US appliance warranty administration, not a review of paid home-service plans.

                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    Build one warranty record
                                                                                                                                                                    checkable
                                                                                                                                                                    true
                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                    • Photograph the full rating plate and record the exact model and serial.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Save the receipt, order confirmation, delivery and installation evidence available.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Download the warranty version applying to the purchase rather than relying on a current marketing page.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Record what event starts each coverage period.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Separate component, parts and labor periods and any stated limits.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Note registration status, transfer rules and documented maintenance requirements actually found in the terms.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Save the official claims contact and authorization procedure.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Keep service visits and claim correspondence attached to the appliance record.

                                                                                                                                                                    5

                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    Write terms you can trace back
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • For each summary, record the page or heading in the warranty. 'Coverage starts from installation under section 2' is checkable; 'installed sometime last spring, probably covered' is not. If the terms are unclear, ask the manufacturer or seller and retain the response.
                                                                                                                                                                    • The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/warranties) advises keeping the warranty and receipt and checking coverage and claims procedures. This record cannot decide whether a particular failure is a covered defect. Do not write that most claims fail because of paperwork; that would need evidence this guide does not have.

                                                                                                                                                                    7
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    A warranty and a service contract differ
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • A manufacturer's warranty and a separately purchased service contract can have different providers, exclusions, fees and claims routes. 'Extended warranty' is often used loosely. Read the actual agreement before treating it as an extension of the original manufacturer's obligations.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Do not assume a whole-home plan covers every appliance, renews on the same terms or pays every visit fee. Keep the contract's own record if you have one. This guide does not recommend buying a plan or predict whether its price will be worthwhile.

                                                                                                                                                                    9
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    Do not invent a maintenance condition
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • Some terms connect coverage to proper use and maintenance, but there is no universal annual-service rule covering all furnaces, water heaters and appliances. Copy the condition actually applicable to your model. Keep maintenance evidence without inventing a visit that did not happen.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Nor should you assume that using an independent repairer voids the entire warranty. FTC guidance explains restrictions on requirements to use specified parts or services. Damage caused by improper work and an unlawful blanket restriction are different questions. Ask for a written explanation of a refusal and seek qualified consumer advice if needed.

                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    Before authorizing a repair
                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                    • situation
                                                                                                                                                                      Coverage
                                                                                                                                                                      line
                                                                                                                                                                      My appliance has this model and serial, and I have these purchase documents. Which parts of this fault may be covered?
                                                                                                                                                                    • situation
                                                                                                                                                                      Authorization
                                                                                                                                                                      line
                                                                                                                                                                      Do I need a claim number or approval before anyone starts work, and what costs could remain mine?
                                                                                                                                                                    • situation
                                                                                                                                                                      Refusal
                                                                                                                                                                      line

                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                    11
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    Track the claim separately from the expiry
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • Record when the fault was observed, when you contacted the provider, what was submitted and the promised next step. Do not assume a reminder just before expiry preserves a claim or that a submitted form means approval. Check the actual reporting requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                    • If a visit is arranged, ask who is coming, what was authorized and how additional work will be approved. Afterward, keep the service record and any changed coverage terms with the claim. Use [the repair record guide](/guides/what-to-keep-after-a-home-repair) for what to capture.
                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                    12
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                    A safety recall is another route
                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                    • Search the [CPSC recall listings](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls) and manufacturer guidance if there is a safety concern. Match model, serial range and other identifiers to the actual notice and follow its instructions. A broad search result for the brand does not establish that your unit is affected.
                                                                                                                                                                    • Do not wait for a warranty appointment to respond to an immediate hazard. Stop and obtain appropriate emergency or professional help for dangerous symptoms. A warranty record is administrative evidence, not permission to keep using unsafe equipment.
                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                    13
                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                    faq
                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                      What if I lost the receipt?
                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                      Ask the retailer, installer or account history for available proof, and ask the warrantor what alternative evidence it accepts. A serial may identify the unit but not necessarily prove the purchase date or owner. Do not substitute an invented purchase date for missing documentation.
                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                      Does registration always extend coverage?
                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                      No. Effects vary by product, terms and applicable law. Check whether registration is requested, what benefit is offered and what evidence confirms completion. Keep the response or confirmation, but do not assume a marketing invitation creates a longer warranty.
                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                      Can the warranty transfer to a buyer?
                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                      Check the written transfer rules and any required process or deadline. Do not promise transferable coverage when selling an appliance or home based only on the original term. Record whether transfer is confirmed, restricted or unknown and direct the buyer to the actual terms.

                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            • Open an admin call with the issue and the action you want, then give the key facts once. Before ending, confirm what happens next, who is responsible, the reference and the date you should follow up. A useful script helps the conversation produce a record, not a performance.
                                                                                                                                                                            • You may know exactly what went wrong and still lose the thread when someone answers. Keep a few lines beside you and change them to fit your situation. These scripts cover routine customer service and billing, not emergency calls or legal advice.
                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                            false

                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                            scripts
                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                            Open with the actual issue
                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              Wrong amount
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              The amount on my bill differs from the amount I expected. Can you explain this charge and check the account?
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              Duplicate charge
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              I see two charges for the same purchase. Can you check whether both are completed charges and tell me how to correct an error?
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              After cancellation
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              I canceled on [date] and have a confirmation. Please check why a further charge appeared and what happens next.
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              Missing refund
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              A refund was confirmed on [date], but I cannot see it. Has it been issued, and what reference or next step can you provide?
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              Chasing an answer
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              I contacted you on [date], reference [reference]. What is its current status, and who is responsible for the next action?
                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                              Cancellation
                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                              I want to cancel this service. What is required, when will it take effect, and will there be a further payment?

                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                            3
                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                            Keep the facts beside the ask
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            • Write three facts before dialing: the transaction or event, its date and the evidence available. Use the number on a trusted statement or the provider's official site. Do not give passwords or one-time security codes to an unexpected caller who offers to fix a problem.
                                                                                                                                                                            • If the agent needs more detail, answer that question rather than repeating the whole history. If you are unsure of a fact, say so and check it. A precise uncertainty is better than an invented date that sends the search in the wrong direction.

                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                            Before you hang up
                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                            • Read back the agreed action and correct any misunderstanding.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Ask for a case or call reference and the agent's name or identifier if available.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirm whether you must send evidence or take another step.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Ask for a specific follow-up date or the basis for calculating it.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Request written confirmation through an appropriate channel.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Write your note immediately and set the promised check date.

                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                            9
                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                            When a call is not enough
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            • Some processes require more than telephone contact. For a US credit-card billing error, the [CFPB](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/how-do-i-dispute-a-charge-on-my-credit-card-bill-en-61/) says to call promptly and also send a written billing-error notice within the applicable 60-calendar-day window to protect rights. Check the correct billing-inquiry address and instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                            • Do not assume waiting for a promised callback pauses a deadline. A debit-card issue, identity theft, legal notice or different financial product may need another route. If a notice has a response date, follow the official process and get qualified help where needed.

                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                            Leave a useful voicemail
                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                            • Give your name, a brief non-sensitive reason, callback number and availability. Avoid account numbers and private details unless the verified system specifically requires them. Record when you left the message and choose the next chase date.
                                                                                                                                                                            • If the obstacle is getting yourself to dial rather than finding words during the call, use [the avoided-call preparation guide](/guides/how-to-make-a-phone-call-you-have-been-avoiding). For a written follow-up, use [the email and chase guide](/guides/the-email-you-keep-not-sending-and-how-to-chase-a-reply).
                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                            12
                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                              Do I need to sound assertive?
                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                              You need to be understandable, specific and able to pause before accepting a proposal. A louder or harder tone does not create options the agent lacks. Use your natural voice, keep the evidence available and ask for the appropriate review route if the first answer does not resolve it.
                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                              What if they will not give a reference?
                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                              Record the time, number dialed, team or identifier offered and what was said. Ask whether a case exists or whether confirmation can be sent another way. Do not invent a reference or treat the lack of one as proof the conversation was not recorded internally.
                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                              Should I record the call?
                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                              Recording laws, consent requirements and provider policies vary. This guide does not determine whether you can lawfully record a particular call. Written contemporaneous notes and requested confirmation are useful without secretly recording; get appropriate advice before relying on recording as your evidence method.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                    1
                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Open the delayed item, check its current date and request, then ask what can be done now. You can acknowledge the gap in one sentence: 'I have not dealt with this until now, and I want to understand the next step.' Do not wait until you have a perfect explanation.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • An unopened letter can become harder to face because of the imagined conversation about being late. The task and the delay are now two separate problems. This guide helps you return to one obligation, not erase consequences or explain why avoidance happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                    false

                                                                                                                                                                                    2
                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                    Read before deciding it can wait again
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check the sender, latest notice, deadline and practical request. Do not assume the oldest letter still describes the current position. Compare later correspondence or ask the organization whether there has been a change.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Court papers, threatened loss of housing or essential services, urgent care issues and other serious notices may need immediate specialist help. Opening the envelope is useful, but it is not automatically enough for today if a consequential response is due. Check the actual time constraint before stopping.

                                                                                                                                                                                    Return to the obligation
                                                                                                                                                                                    checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                    true
                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Choose one item, keeping related later messages beside it.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Read the deadline and requested action before drafting a response.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Verify the contact route independently if the message is unexpected or asks for money.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Write what you know, what you do not know and the one question you need answered.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Choose a call, written message or required form that fits the actual process.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Acknowledge the delay briefly if useful, without promising something unaffordable or impossible.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Save the response, current status and next date.

                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                    Ask about now, not only what you missed
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    • A useful question is 'What is the current status, and what options remain?' That leaves room for the account having moved, the form having changed or the organization needing different evidence. Do not send an outdated form simply because you finally found it.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • If money is involved, verify the current amount and who is entitled to collect it. Do not make a token payment or admit a disputed obligation just to end an uncomfortable call. Seek appropriate advice if legal rights or old debts may be affected.

                                                                                                                                                                                    10
                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                    Give a reason when it matters
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    • You do not owe every customer-service agent a detailed personal history. But illness, disability, bereavement or another circumstance may be relevant to an extension, accommodation or review. Ask what the process requires before deciding that explanations never matter.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [CCI procrastination resources](https://www.cci.health.wa.gov.au/Resources/Looking-After-Yourself/Procrastination) offer self-help approaches to delayed tasks. This guide's script is not a therapeutic technique or a prediction of how another person will react. You may encounter understanding, limits or a firm refusal.
                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                    11
                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                    If the answer is no
                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                    • Ask what remains required, whether a formal review exists and the deadline for it. Request the current position in writing. Do not keep negotiating indefinitely while a separate response deadline passes. Qualified advice may be more useful than another call.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • For practical support, ask someone to sit nearby or help read the instructions without taking over. If even the first move is blocked, use [the ten-minute starting plan](/guides/task-paralysis-what-to-do-in-the-next-ten-minutes). If there are many items, use [overdue-task triage](/guides/how-to-start-when-everything-is-overdue) rather than treating every envelope as equally urgent.
                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                    12
                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                    faq
                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                      Should I apologize for the delay?
                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                      A brief acknowledgment may help, but it does not need to become the whole message. State the current question and any relevant circumstance. Avoid making promises you cannot keep merely to sound cooperative; a realistic next action is more useful than an elaborate apology.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                      What if I am afraid to open it alone?
                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                      Ask a trusted person for a specific form of support, such as sitting nearby, reading the deadline or helping find the official contact. Protect private information as needed. If there may be an urgent consequence, arrange that support promptly rather than setting an indefinite later date.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I stop after reading the letter?
                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                      Sometimes, if there is no urgent next action. First check the deadline and consequences. Leave a note with the current request and next step. A general permission to pause should not be mistaken for advice to ignore a legal, care or essential-service deadline.

                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Before a homeschool evaluation, confirm the required method, evaluator qualifications, submission deadline and evidence. Then gather the records for that route, with work samples and concise notes where appropriate. An evaluation may involve testing, a portfolio, discussion or another approved process; it is not universally an informal conversation.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • You may already have a folder full of work and still be unsure what the reviewer expects. Start by checking the requirement rather than collecting more pages. This guide prepares the meeting and paperwork; it cannot establish compliance for your child or promise a favorable result.
                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                          Confirm the route before assembling the folder
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Find the current official instructions for your state, district or program. Identify who chooses the evaluator, which credentials are accepted, what must be assessed and who submits the result. Ask whether the child needs to attend, what format is used and whether the evaluator supplies a report.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • [Florida's official overview](https://www.fldoe.org/file/5606/HomeEd-Sept-2025.pdf) describes annual evaluation options and portfolio duties. That is an example of why the route matters, not a rule for all states. A helpful reviewer cannot waive a legal requirement simply by preferring a different folder.
                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                          false

                                                                                                                                                                                          Confirm the practical arrangements
                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Save the applicable official instructions and the date you checked them.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Confirm evaluator eligibility and the selected assessment method.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check appointment, location or remote arrangements, costs and cancellation terms.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ask for a specific evidence list rather than guessing how much work to bring.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Confirm required forms, signatures, submission recipient and deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Discuss access needs and permitted accommodations in advance.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep proof of what you submit and how receipt will be confirmed.

                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                          7
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                          Choose samples that answer a question
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • If a portfolio is part of your route, select work that shows the relevant subjects and periods without hiding difficult stretches. Note whether an item was independent, dictated, copied from a model or completed with help. The context may be more useful than the neatness of the page.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • For example, two writing samples could show changes in organizing ideas, but a polished typed piece and an unsupported handwritten draft are not directly comparable. Explain the different conditions rather than claiming a measured improvement the samples cannot establish.
