                                                                                                                                                                                          9
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                          Write short, specific progress notes
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • A note might say: 'We changed fraction materials in January. The student now models equivalent fractions independently but still needs prompts when simplifying notation.' This is more informative than 'math improved a lot.' Include the next instructional step if you know it.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ask your child what work they would like included, where appropriate, without coaching them to conceal uncertainty. Confirm with the evaluator what discussion is expected. Do not rehearse supposedly correct answers to questions you do not know will be asked.
                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                          10
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                          If records or deadlines are missing
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Separate missing evidence from missing learning. Use [the reconstruction guide](/guides/how-to-catch-up-on-homeschool-records) to label recovered information, and do not invent attendance or hours. Ask what alternative evidence is permitted. A retrospective folder may not satisfy a requirement for contemporaneous records.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • If the deadline is close or passed, contact the responsible office promptly. Ask for the current status and written next steps. Do not rely on a general article's assurance that a gap is normal or that a review cannot produce adverse consequences.

                                                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                          After the evaluation
                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                          • Save the report, selected evidence and submission confirmation in the child's records. Record any required follow-up and who is responsible. If the result raises concerns or creates a formal obligation you do not understand, get qualified advice about the applicable process rather than treating the report as a routine checklist completion.
                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                          13
                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                            Is an evaluation always a test?
                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                            No, but it is not always a portfolio discussion either. The permitted or required methods depend on the governing rules and chosen route. Confirm the method and evaluator qualifications before booking, and distinguish a private educational consultation from a legally required evaluation.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                            Should I bring every worksheet?
                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                            Follow the required evidence list. Where selected samples are permitted, organize them by subject or period and retain context about support. Keep the larger archive accessible if needed. More paper does not automatically make the evidence more representative or easier to review.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                            What if the year included illness or a curriculum change?
                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                            Describe what happened and how instruction changed, using accurate dates and surviving work where available. Ask about the requirements and any available procedures for your situation. Do not assume that a difficult year either guarantees failure or excuses a particular legal requirement.

                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Plan a group trip by agreeing the essentials before anyone pays: dates, spending limits, who is definitely joining, who can book and what happens if someone withdraws. Then keep a booking list with one responsible person and the travelers actually included on each reservation.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • The person who starts the chat can become the unpaid answer desk. A shared page helps only if decisions and responsibilities are settled first. This guide is for a small group arranging its own trip, not a commercial tour or a promise that every friend will want the same holiday.
                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                              2
                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                              Agree boundaries before collecting deposits
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Ask each person privately or through a simple reply for their affordable total, including transport, lodging, meals and planned activities. Agree whether the group is choosing a shared maximum, separate options or a smaller core trip. Nobody should need to disclose their income to explain a budget limit.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Before a shared booking, write the price, payment deadline, cancellation terms and proposed cost split. Confirm consent rather than treating silence as agreement. A person paying the deposit may be accepting the supplier's liability even if friends intend to reimburse them.

                                                                                                                                                                                              true
                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Confirm dates and definite participants, with a response deadline for undecided people.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Agree a realistic spending range and which costs remain individual.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Identify essential accessibility, room, transport and dietary arrangements with the traveler's consent.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Give each booking one named handler and a backup contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Get explicit agreement before anyone commits other people's money.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Mark activities optional unless the group has agreed otherwise.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Choose one current itinerary location and a method for announcing changes.

                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                              Write names, not 'everyone'
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              • The car row matters because being in the group chat does not mean being on the booking. Confirm who is a passenger, authorized driver, named guest or ticket holder as appropriate. A reservation under one lead name may have separate rules for the others.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Record the provider and useful reference, but avoid exposing sensitive documents or payment details. Share only the personal requirements needed to arrange the trip. Someone can request step-free access without making a medical history part of a shared itinerary.

                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                              10
                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                              When somebody leaves or a plan moves
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Do not immediately remove a traveler from a paid booking or promise their money back. Check whether cancellation, name changes or transfers are allowed and what charges apply. Then apply the group's prior agreement and document any new one.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Notify the people affected by a change, not only the whole chat. If four arrive on a delayed flight and two travel separately, the two may still need to check into the lodging. Dependencies can involve other people's roles as well as times. Use [multi-stop planning](/guides/organising-a-multi-stop-trip-without-a-spreadsheet) where the route itself becomes complicated.
                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                              11
                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                              Close the planning loop
                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                              • Send a short current itinerary with local dates, meeting points, handlers and included travelers. Ask people to confirm the part they rely on rather than simply reacting to a message. Retain an offline version and make it clear which version is current.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • For international travel, each person remains responsible for checking their documents and entry eligibility. The [State Department checklist](https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/planning/checklist.html) is a starting point for US travelers, not a group-wide clearance. Stop a shared booking if consent, affordability or a critical access requirement remains unresolved.

                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                              12
                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                              faq
                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                Who should be the organizer?
                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                Choose a coordinator for the shared record, but distribute actual booking work to named handlers. The coordinator need not pay for everything, know every personal detail or make decisions for absent travelers. Agree the limits of the role before the trip becomes a stream of unanswered questions.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                What if somebody never confirms?
                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                Use the agreed response deadline and book only for people who have explicitly joined and accepted the relevant cost. Tell the undecided person what would need checking if they join later. Do not assume another person's silence authorizes a nonrefundable booking.
                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                How should we split cancellation costs?
                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                Read supplier terms and agree the group's arrangement before paying. Equal splitting, individual responsibility and replacement-traveler arrangements have different consequences. If someone withdraws, check actual refunds and transfer options before deciding what remains owed; the itinerary alone cannot settle a disputed obligation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    1
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • After a job change, move, separation or other major change, rebuild the dates first: money you can actually use, the next reliable income and every essential payment before it arrives. Then update payment routes and contact details. Keep larger legal, benefits and investment choices on a separate advice list.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The old monthly budget may look balanced while the next six weeks do not. A first paycheck can arrive later than expected, two homes can overlap or a shared payment route can stop working. This guide helps reconstruct the current administration, not decide how to divide assets or invest.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    2
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    Use the real transition period
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Choose a period ending at the next reliable income point, not automatically the end of the calendar month. Confirm the first pay date with payroll, including any partial pay or onboarding issue. Treat unconfirmed reimbursements, deposits and sale proceeds as uncertain until their availability is established.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Start from accessible money after checking pending transactions. Exclude funds you cannot use, money held for someone else and disputed shared assets. A total across several accounts may conceal access restrictions or a payment scheduled from the wrong one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                      • -$300
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Remaining planning margin
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • $36

                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    4
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    Read the example as a timing problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The figures are invented. The household has $336 after the listed fixed bills but only $36 after providing $300 for food and transport. Neither figure is a guarantee: the record still needs checking for omitted expenses and uncertain dates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • This is why a bank balance cannot simply become a shopping allowance during a transition. Add irregular costs such as moving charges, overlapping utilities and new work travel. If the margin is negative, contact relevant providers early rather than relying on a deposit whose arrival is only hoped for.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    5
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    list
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    Rebuild the administration
                                                                                                                                                                                                    checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                    true
                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Confirm income dates and which account will receive each payment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • List essentials and other bills falling before that income, including annual or quarterly items.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Record every automatic payment's source, amount and next withdrawal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Identify address, contact, payer or authorization details that changed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Ask institutions how to move or close routes without interrupting required payments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check unresolved old arrangements, including benefits, retirement plans and joint obligations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Save confirmations and recheck the first cycle under the new setup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    ordered

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    8
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    For a new job, separate payroll from plan choices
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Confirm direct deposit through the employer's verified process and check the first payment. Ask when old and new health coverage end or begin and obtain any continuation or special-enrollment information. Those rules are plan- and situation-specific; record the actual notice and deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Do not treat a retirement account as quick transition cash without understanding tax and other consequences. Ask the administrator what options are actually available and obtain qualified advice where needed. This guide does not prescribe a rollover, withdrawal or benefit election.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    9
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    For a move, update more than deliveries
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • List banks, card providers, insurers, payroll, retirement providers and other services that send consequential notices. Confirm utility account end and start dates, final bills and any deposit process. Keep proof rather than assuming mail forwarding updates the underlying account.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [IRS Form 8822 page](https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-8822) provides the home mailing-address change route. Read the current form instructions for your situation. A new address can also affect contracts or coverage, so notify relevant providers rather than treating the change as a postal task only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    11
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    For a separation, do not move shared money by default
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Inventory joint accounts, cards, loans and automated payments without assuming that a household agreement changes the lender's contract. Ask the institutions about their processes and get legal advice about ownership, obligations and any orders. Do not close, empty or redirect shared arrangements simply because a checklist suggests simplifying them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • If there is coercion, financial abuse or monitoring, seek confidential specialist support and consider device and correspondence safety. A shared document may expose a plan or new account. Immediate personal safety takes priority over a complete household money inventory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    13
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    Review withholding without guessing a tax result
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [IRS W-4 guidance](https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-w-4) says to consider a new form when personal or financial circumstances change. Review the current instructions or seek advice, especially where household income or filing circumstances have changed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Do not assume a change is tax-neutral or that the same withholding fits a new job. Keep the review as a dated action with a source or adviser, separate from the immediate bill-payment plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    14
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    When the gap cannot be covered
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Contact providers before the due date where possible and make an affordable proposal. The [CFPB credit-card guidance](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-should-i-do-if-i-cant-pay-my-credit-card-bills-en-1697/) recommends prompt contact when you cannot pay. It does not guarantee a changed date or hardship offer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For housing, essential utilities, secured debts or formal notices, get relevant advice rather than applying credit-card assumptions. If one payment has already failed, use [missed-payment recovery](/guides/you-missed-a-payment-what-to-do-next). Do not solve this week's shortfall by agreeing to a payment that makes next week's essentials impossible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    15
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                    Close the old picture only after checking the new one
                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For accounts you alone own and are entitled to change, verify final deposits, pending payments, residual charges and record access before closure. Shared, disputed or legally constrained accounts need their own route. Keep a dated note of what remains open and why.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Use [the monthly bills list](/guides/monthly-bills-list) to maintain the new pattern. The transition is finished administratively when the new payments work and old obligations are understood, not simply when you have filled in a new budget.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                    16
                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                    faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                      Should I close my old bank account immediately?
                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                      Not as a universal rule. Check ownership, pending transactions, incoming deposits, fees and access to statements first. Ask the bank about its process. A shared or disputed account may need legal advice, and closure should not interrupt essential payments or conceal unresolved obligations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can I use expected money in the plan?
                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                      Show it separately with its uncertainty and expected date. Do not use it as if it has already arrived when deciding what you can commit. Confirm the first paycheck or other consequential deposit directly and make a backup plan for any gap.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                      What should I do before changing retirement or health arrangements?
                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                      Get the actual plan options, coverage dates, notices and deadlines from the responsible administrator. Read current official instructions and obtain qualified advice about consequences where needed. A household cash-flow checklist cannot determine the right election, tax treatment or investment choice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ask permission to talk, explain the practical reason and begin with where documents are kept and who the trusted contacts are. You do not need to start with balances or who inherits. Agree what your parent wants recorded, who may see it and whether there will be another conversation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A parent may have everything organized and still not want to show it to an adult child. Another may welcome help but feel overwhelmed by the size of the topic. This guide is for a conversation with a parent who can participate and choose what to share. It is not a route to taking control.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        2
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Choose a small, honest purpose
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Say what you are trying to solve: knowing whom to call if they cannot respond, locating a current will or understanding who holds an established decision-making role. Avoid disguising a disagreement about inheritance as an emergency-preparedness chat.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Mention your own paperwork if that is genuinely what prompted the question. You do not need a fabricated story or a health scare to justify asking. Choose privacy, enough time and a moment without a financial transaction waiting to be approved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                        false

Would you like help arranging the appointment?

                                                                                                                                                                                                          line

Is there one contact you would be comfortable sharing, or would you prefer not to do that today?

                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Where is the current will, and who holds the original?
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who should be contacted first in an emergency or period of incapacity?
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Are healthcare or financial decision arrangements already made, and where are the relevant documents?

                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Is there a protected digital-access plan or provider legacy arrangement?
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who knows about care responsibilities or other immediate commitments?
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What may be written down, shared or followed up, and by whom?

                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        7
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        An answer can be useful without being complete
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 'My lawyer has the original' is a start. Ask whether your parent wants the lawyer's name and contact recorded and how an authorized person would obtain the document. Do not demand a copy as proof of trust. A contact card may solve the immediate job.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Similarly, a provider name can be enough for a first index. More information may be necessary later for an agreed task, but it should be requested for that task, with suitable privacy. 'Locations first' is an option for a gentle opening, not a rule that all families must avoid details forever.

                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        9
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do not confuse helping with authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Sitting beside a parent as they organize records is different from speaking to a bank, making transactions or signing for them. The appropriate process depends on the task, the institution and applicable law. Do not assume being a child, emergency contact or holder of a password grants powers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The [CFPB financial-caregiver guides](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/consumer-tools/managing-someone-elses-money/) distinguish roles such as agents under powers of attorney, trustees, court-appointed guardians and government fiduciaries. The distinctions matter because duties and authority come from the actual appointment and rules, not a family nickname for the helper.
