                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        When your parent wants formal arrangements
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Encourage independent advice about documents appropriate to their situation. Do not choose beneficiaries, draft instructions for signature or make yourself the gatekeeper. An attorney may be particularly useful for complex or disputed circumstances, but this guide does not say every valid document requires attorney drafting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ask the relevant institution how an existing appointment is recognized before attempting to use it. Healthcare, money, benefits and estate matters can require different documents or processes. A general 'we agreed you can help' note may not meet any of them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        If the answer is no
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A clear refusal is a boundary, not an invitation to recruit siblings to wear it down. You can explain the practical consequence once: without the information you may need to start by contacting known professionals or institutions if a problem arises. Do not threaten to withdraw care to obtain disclosure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Offer a private alternative, such as giving the location to an adviser or another trusted person. Then stop. If your parent chooses a follow-up, make it specific and limited. Repeated surprise conversations can turn a practical topic into a test of loyalty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        13
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Memory concerns need a different response
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Do not diagnose incapacity from a forgotten date, and do not rush signatures because you fear time is running out. Capacity is decision-specific and legally consequential. Seek appropriate clinical and legal advice where understanding, coercion or authority is genuinely in question.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If someone appears to be pressuring your parent, taking money or isolating them, use confidential safeguarding or professional help rather than staging a family confrontation. Do not investigate by accessing private accounts without authorization. Immediate danger requires appropriate emergency help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        14
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Close with consent and one action
                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Read back the agreed note: 'You would like me to keep the adviser contact, but not copies of the documents.' Confirm where it will be stored and who can see it. Let your parent correct the description and choose whether the conversation continues later.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Use [the short advance handover page](/guides/what-to-write-down-in-case-something-happens-to-you) only if it fits their wishes. The useful result may be one verified location, a professional appointment or a decision not to share yet. Do not call the whole estate plan complete because a conversation went well.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                        15
                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                          Should I ask what I will inherit?
                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                          That is a separate question from finding emergency contacts and records. Be transparent if inheritance is the real issue rather than using preparedness as a pretext. Your parent can choose what to disclose; this guide's practical opening does not create an entitlement to the contents of a will.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I help without power of attorney?
                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                          Some support, such as organizing papers at the parent's request, may not involve acting on their behalf. Transactions or communication with institutions can require particular authority or consent. Check the actual task and process; do not assume one document is either always necessary or sufficient for every kind of help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                          What if my siblings disagree?
                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                          Keep your parent's wishes and privacy central, avoid treating family consensus as legal authority and clarify who has any actual appointment. A neutral professional may help with planning or disputes. If coercion or misuse is suspected, seek confidential advice rather than expanding access to settle the argument.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                          limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Conversation guidance does not assess capacity, diagnose memory problems or establish legal authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No requirement that every power of attorney be drafted by an attorney is asserted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Coercion, safeguarding and disputed authority require confidential qualified help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • No keyword-volume dataset was available. Saved Reddit leads were qualitative only; Quora was blocked in the saved research.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For an inherited house with no maintenance records, first confirm who can authorize access and work, secure the property and check immediate risks. Then identify equipment, recover existing documents and arrange targeted professional assessment. Mark missing dates unknown rather than treating every service as overdue or every old system as failed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A house can arrive with keys but no explanation of the heating, water or previous repairs. You do not have to reconstruct its entire history before addressing an active leak. This guide covers the maintenance starting point, not title transfer, probate, taxes or whether to keep the property.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            2
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Confirm responsibility before changing the house
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identify the authorized estate representative, current owner or other person entitled to arrange work. Family agreement and possession of a key may not settle authority. Before large spending, disposal or changes to access, ask the appropriate legal adviser if there is uncertainty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Record urgent preservation concerns and communicate them promptly to the responsible person. An inherited home can still have a mortgage and other obligations. The [CFPB inherited-mortgage guidance](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/i-recently-inherited-a-house-the-mortgage-lender-said-its-required-to-determine-my-ability-to-repay-before-it-will-let-me-take-over-the-mortgage-loan-is-this-true-en-1939/) discusses successor documentation; inheritance should not be treated as automatic loan cancellation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            3
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            list
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            First safe visit
                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirm lawful access and who may authorize expenses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check whether anyone or anything depends on immediate care or safe occupation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Look for active water, fire, structural or other obvious hazards without entering unsafe spaces.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirm the insurance and essential-service position with the responsible person and providers, especially if the property is empty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Record access arrangements, emergency contacts and known utility controls without publishing codes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Photograph accessible equipment and visible conditions, keeping date and location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Leave hazardous or unfamiliar systems for the appropriate professional.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            6
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Do not turn a walkthrough into an inspection
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Stay within ordinary safe access. Do not remove electrical covers, enter an unsafe roof space, climb onto a roof or operate unknown gas controls to see whether they work. A visible label may identify equipment, but it does not tell you whether hidden wiring, combustion or drainage is safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If there is gas odor, a carbon monoxide alarm, dangerous electrical behavior, serious structural concern or water near energized equipment, leave the hazard and obtain appropriate help. Bereavement can justify simplifying the work, not ignoring a condition threatening people or property.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            8
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Recover documents before guessing dates
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Look for invoices, manuals, seller disclosures, prior inspection reports, warranties and service contacts in accessible records. Ask relevant providers what history they can lawfully share. Save the source of each date: an invoice, a label or a person's recollection are different kinds of evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Use [manufacturer identification guidance](https://www.geappliances.com/ge/find-model-serial-number/) for relevant GE products, or the actual maker's instructions for another brand. Keep model and serial separate. A serial-number pattern found online is not a universal age decoder. Manufacture, purchase and installation can all be different dates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            9
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use unknown as a request for assessment
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Missing service history means you need to establish the right next step, not repeat every service operation immediately. Some equipment needs professional evaluation before use; other items may simply need a manual check or routine observation. Ask what is appropriate for the specific system and condition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For HVAC, [ENERGY STAR](https://www.energystar.gov/saveathome/heating-cooling/maintenance-checklist) describes contractor pre-season checks and owner filter care. Its checklist is not an instruction to adjust refrigerant, inspect live wiring or service combustion equipment yourself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                            11
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Check alarms as their own task
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Follow [USFA smoke-alarm guidance](https://www.usfa.fema.gov/prevention/home-fires/prepare-for-fire/smoke-alarms/) for testing and replacement age, alongside device instructions and local requirements. Record the actual test and manufacture date rather than writing only 'alarms present.' Carbon monoxide alarms have their own manufacturer requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If a device is inaccessible or hardwired work is needed, arrange suitable help. Do not remove an alarm battery to stop a nuisance signal and leave the home without protection. A maintenance inventory is incomplete if it lists safety devices but never checks their condition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            12
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Commission a useful starting report
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Choose the appropriate professional for the question. A broad inspection can help identify issues, while a specialist may be needed for a particular system. Ask what is included, what is excluded and which findings require further evaluation. Save the written report and scope.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Do not treat a general inspection as proof of remaining lifespan or a guarantee that every hidden defect is absent. Record the recommendation and responsibility for follow-up. Avoid replacing equipment solely because a generic service-life table says it is old.

                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            14
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                            Build the history from today
                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For completed work, save date, findings, actual parts or adjustments, provider and open actions. A visit date alone is not proof every service item was performed. Keep the evidence with the system rather than scattered across an estate email thread.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Use [the repair-record guide](/guides/what-to-keep-after-a-home-repair) and then [the maintenance calendar](/guides/home-maintenance-checklist-by-month). The goal is a truthful baseline, a short risk list and assigned follow-ups. It is acceptable for much of the earlier history to remain unknown.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                            15
                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                              Does no history mean everything needs servicing now?
                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                              No. It means the appropriate next step has not been established. Check manuals, visible condition and professional recommendations, prioritizing hazards and systems needed for occupation. Unnecessary service or replacement can also cost money and introduce problems; missing records alone do not diagnose failure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can an appliance's age tell me whether to replace it?
                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                              Age is one planning input, not a condition assessment or automatic replacement deadline. Verify how the age was established, then consider safety, performance, parts, repair findings and actual guidance. Do not use an unverified serial decoder or generic lifespan as the sole decision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                              Is this the complete inherited-house checklist?
                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                              No. It intentionally covers maintenance triage and records. Authority, estate administration, title, mortgage, taxes and insurance need separate attention and may have real deadlines. Ask the appropriate court, adviser, servicer or insurer about the actual property rather than assuming the maintenance plan covers those duties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Look for the appliance's rating label or identification plate, usually around a door opening, inside an accessible compartment or on an exterior panel. Copy the field marked model, plus the serial separately, and photograph the whole label. Use the manufacturer's locator if it is not safely visible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A large logo on the front may identify a product family rather than the precise model. That distinction matters when looking for the correct manual or asking for service. This guide covers common household appliances, not every brand or permission to dismantle equipment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                Capture the identifier correctly
                                                                                                                                                                                                                checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Read the brand from the actual appliance, not only a detached remote or accessory.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Use the manufacturer's model-locator instructions for that product type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Open only ordinary user-access doors or lids that are safe under the manual.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Photograph the full plate and a readable close view, keeping all suffixes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Copy model and serial into separate labeled fields.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check likely confusions such as O and zero, I and one, or missing hyphens.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Save the label location so another person can find it without another search.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                Model, serial and part number are different
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The model identifies a product configuration or range; the serial identifies the particular unit. A replacement component can carry its own part number, which is not necessarily the appliance model. Some manufacturers also need product, service or revision codes. Preserve every label field when uncertain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The [GE locator](https://www.geappliances.com/ge/find-model-serial-number/) gives product-specific help and says GE and GE Profile model numbers begin and end with a letter. That is GE-specific guidance, not a test for whether another manufacturer's number is valid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                Invented example: the nearly right number
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A dishwasher label has MODEL DWX42A/02 and SERIAL SN77881. A handwritten note says only DWX42A. The household saves the photo and records the full model including /02, then asks the manufacturer which identifiers are required for the manual or service request.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • These codes are invented and do not identify a real product. The lesson is to retain suffixes and separate fields, not use this pattern as a universal format. An apparently minor ending can matter, so do not let an online search silently discard it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                If the label is missing or inaccessible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check the purchase order, retailer account, installation record, registration confirmation or past service invoice. Compare any found number against the appliance rather than assuming a manual left in the house belongs to it. A manual may cover several models.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Contact the manufacturer with clear exterior photographs and whatever paperwork exists. Mark an uncertain identifier unconfirmed until support verifies it. Do not scrape, repaint or dismantle an appliance to make a label readable, and do not order a safety-critical part by appearance alone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do not decode age by a generic rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A serial may contain a manufacturing code, but formats differ by brand and period. A manufacture date, purchase date and installation date are separate facts. Use the manufacturer's interpretation where needed and label estimates honestly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • If identifying the model requires moving a heavy unit, disturbing a gas connection, removing a microwave case or opening electrical equipment, stop and ask a qualified person. A phone camera is not worth creating an access hazard. Missing information is preferable to an unsafe search.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                Make the photo findable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Save the image under the appliance and location, not only as an unnamed camera-roll item. Keep the typed identifier beside it for searching. Link it to [the warranty record](/guides/appliance-warranties-what-to-track) and [the purchase record](/guides/what-to-record-when-you-buy-an-appliance) if those exist.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A model number helps select the right documentation, but it does not prove that a part is compatible or that a repair is safe. Ask the manufacturer or appropriate service provider to confirm the exact configuration before making consequential decisions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Is the serial number the same as the model?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  No. Keep the labels separate and retain both. The model helps identify the product configuration; the serial identifies your unit and may be needed for warranty, service or recall checks. Photograph the whole plate if there are additional product or service codes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What if there is no readable sticker?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Look for purchase, installation or previous service records and ask the maker for help. Photos and partial information may assist, but identification is not guaranteed. Mark guesses as unconfirmed and avoid ordering consequential parts from a visually similar product.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can I pull the oven out to see the label?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Do not do that just because a general guide suggests a rear label. Ranges can be heavy and involve electrical or gas connections and anti-tip restraints. Check the manufacturer's safe locator instructions or ask a qualified person if normal accessible locations do not reveal it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A homeschool attendance record should identify the child, the date, and the instruction actually completed. Add hours, subjects, or other fields when your applicable rules require them. There is no nationwide number of hours that makes every homeschool day count, and checking a box in an app does not establish compliance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • You may have taught all morning and still hesitate over the attendance column. A museum visit feels different from a workbook lesson; a day interrupted by illness feels harder to classify. Keep the factual record first, then apply the rule that governs your program. This guide concerns US parent-directed homeschooling, not attendance at an online public school.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Set up the attendance page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Find your current state education department guidance and the legal route under which you homeschool.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write the school year and child's name at the top; keep each child's totals distinguishable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Copy the applicable day, hour, subject, and documentation requirements into a separate rules note.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Add a dated line describing completed instruction, with actual time where needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Mark uncertain entries for review instead of silently including them in the compliance total.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Save supporting records and check totals before the reporting deadline.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                      5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not turn one state's example into a national rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [Colorado education department's family guidance](https://ed.cde.state.co.us/choice/homeschool/homeschool-for-families) is one official starting point for Colorado families. Another state's attendance definition may differ, and different schooling arrangements within a state may have different obligations. Use your own authority's wording rather than importing a friend's schedule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Questions to resolve include whether a minimum applies per day or across the year, whether time must be recorded by subject, and what evidence must be retained. If the page is unclear, ask the responsible office to identify the governing provision. Keep its reply with the rule, not buried in a conversation thread.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Keep outside an instructional total unless your specific rules say otherwise.
