                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Choose the smallest record that serves your rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A personal log can be brief: date, learner, activity, and a pointer to any sample. If hours are required, record the detail your rules call for. Do not replace necessary daily or subject information with a rough weekly estimate just because it is easier.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Shared lessons can share a description, but the record should still show which child participated. A child's absence, an unfinished activity, and a completed lesson should not become indistinguishable marks. Planned lessons belong in the plan; completed lessons belong in the record.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Missing days, disputed totals, and requests for records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Start today's log even if earlier entries are missing. Reconstruct older work only from evidence you actually have, such as dated assignments or a co-op record. Label the entry with its reconstruction date and evidence source. Do not turn a curriculum's intended schedule into proof that each lesson happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If your running total suggests a shortfall, check the rule and remaining calendar promptly. Do not fix the arithmetic by inventing days. If an official challenges your record, preserve the request, observe its deadline, and seek qualified local advice when needed. A transfer, custody dispute, or move can change what information you need to retain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For the routine that keeps entries manageable, see [a simple homeschool record keeping system](/guides/simple-homeschool-record-keeping-system). Keep attendance requirements separate from any tool's automatic count.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Does a field trip count as a homeschool day?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        It may contribute to your record, but its eligibility depends on the rules that apply to your program. Describe what was learned and any time required by those rules. A ticket or photograph documents a visit, not necessarily a complete instructional day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do I have to record hours if I count days?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Possibly. A day minimum and an hours requirement can coexist, so do not assume that counting days removes the need to track time. Check the applicable statute and current official guidance before deciding which columns to omit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I use one attendance calendar for several children?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes, if each child's participation and required totals remain clear. Use separate columns or identifiers rather than a single household tick. Keep child-specific samples and reports findable even when the family did the same activity together.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                        intent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Design a sustainable daily record habit distinct from attendance definitions and retention rules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use one daily lesson log, one evidence folder per child, and one weekly check. Write what happened where you already finish the lesson. Add any fields your state's requirements call for; this small system is a personal organizing method, not a claim that three columns satisfy every homeschool law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The problem often starts with two records of the same lesson: the planner you meant to follow and the tracker you meant to fill in later. By Friday they disagree. A workable system lets you distinguish intention from completion without rewriting the whole week.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Lengthy planning and unrelated family notes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Set up at the point of use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Choose a notebook or file you can reach when the books close. Give each child a clearly named section. Use the same headings consistently, but let a useful entry be short: 'November 5, Maya, fractions lesson 8, needed help comparing thirds; repeat with strips.' That tells you more than a green tick.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep the coming week's plan separate or visibly mark planned work as planned. Crossing something off a plan can work as a record only if you can still tell when it happened, who did it, and what the mark means. Do not let an automatic timestamp stand in for a lesson date when you enter something late.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Run the first week
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Add any legally required fields before you start, including time detail if applicable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Record one completed lesson immediately after putting its materials away.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use a clear status: completed, partly completed, or not done.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Name one next teaching step only when it will help your next session.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • File one relevant sample with its date and child identifier.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Choose a weekly review point and check that each child's record can be found.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Invented example: the interrupted Tuesday
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Maya completes reading and begins a math lesson before an appointment interrupts the morning. Her record says 'Reading chapter 4 completed; math lesson 8 started, examples 1-3 only.' Her brother's record says 'Co-op art class, leaf printing; photograph in art folder.' Neither entry describes a full day merely because something was logged.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At the weekly review, the parent notices the math lesson needs resuming. That is the benefit of recording position rather than awarding a general success mark. The family can also apply its attendance rules separately without changing the factual entries.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Give unusual work a findable home
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For a large project, save a photograph with the child's name, date, and a short description of the work. Link it in the daily entry with a filename or folder name. A phone camera roll alone may be hard to search later. Preserve any originals your requirements call for.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For shared lessons, use a common activity description but identify each child's participation. Keep private reflections out of a record you may hand to another person. Educational evidence, administrative correspondence, and family memories can live in separate subfolders even when they concern the same child.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Restart without rebuilding the whole system
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • After a gap, write today's entry first. Then make a separate list of missing dates that matter for required records. Recover only what dated evidence supports and label reconstructed entries. A gap is an accuracy problem to address, not permission to invent a tidy history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If the weekly review routinely takes longer than the lessons it records, remove optional fields before changing tools. Keep necessary compliance information. If a required report is overdue or you cannot establish whether records meet local requirements, contact the relevant authority or a qualified adviser promptly rather than waiting for a more attractive planner.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Is a notebook enough?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A notebook can handle the daily log described here if its entries are legible, identifiable by child, and easy to retrieve. Whether it meets a particular legal requirement depends on that requirement. Keep required reports and evidence alongside it, not only a notebook summary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What if I forget to record a lesson?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Resume with the next lesson, then recover the missing entry from work or other evidence where possible. Mark late reconstruction clearly. Do not copy a planned lesson into the completed column merely because you think it probably happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Should I record how the lesson went?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A short teaching note is optional but useful when it changes your next step. 'Needs another example with borrowing' is actionable. A daily mood score or long narrative is unnecessary unless you have a specific reason to collect it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • When brain fog makes paperwork difficult, put the details outside your head: keep one page per matter, write the next concrete action, and leave a stopping note before you pause. Check hard deadlines first. If one cannot wait, ask for help, a different contact method, or an extension instead of saving it for a clearer day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • You may know exactly what the insurance claim needs and still lose your place halfway through a call. The aim is to preserve the work already done, not squeeze a normal workload into a worse day. These are administrative suggestions, not treatment, and they do not depend on deciding what caused the difficulty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First separate familiar difficulty from a new emergency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [NHS advises immediate medical help for sudden confusion](https://www.nhs.uk/symptoms/confusion/). Do not treat abrupt disorientation or a sudden inability to think or speak normally as a filing problem. Use your local emergency service. Persistent, worsening, or concerning thinking changes also deserve a clinician's assessment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For an established condition, follow your own care team's advice about activity and rest. A short task is still a task; it is not necessarily suitable on a day when symptoms require rest. Stop if the activity is making you worse, and arrange help for time-sensitive work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Set up one live matter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Write the matter's name and deadline at the top of one page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Put the reference number and verified contact route directly below it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Name the next visible action, such as finding a policy letter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Gather only the documents needed for that action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Choose a way to record the outcome without holding it in memory.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Before stopping, note what happened and where to resume.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For a close deadline, assign a backup person or request an extension now.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Make the page easy to resume
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The stopping note is not an account of how productive you were. It is a handoff to your future self or to a helper. Include the document location, not just 'find documents.' If you sent something, record where and when, then save the acknowledgment. 'Submitted' and 'received' may be different states.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Use a dated note when facts change rather than rewriting the history so you cannot tell which answer came first. Keep private identity information secure. A note visible by the phone might use the last few digits of a reference with the full version stored elsewhere.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Match the task to today's capacity, within the deadline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Opening an envelope, copying a date, comparing figures, and negotiating a bill demand different things. Do not assume a task is easy because it is short. Keep financial decisions and important submissions for a time when you can check them, or arrange a second reader.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Set a manageable stopping point, such as identifying the missing attachment. You do not have to complete the entire claim to make a useful advance. If a call has a long hold, ask about callback or secure-message options where available. An institution may not offer every accommodation, so confirm the route and its response time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ask for bounded help
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A useful request is 'sit with me while I read this letter' or 'check that these two dates match.' Avoid sharing passwords or asking a helper to pretend to be you. Some organizations require your consent or formal authority before speaking to another person; ask what is needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Agree who owns the next action and when they will report back. Without that, two people can each think the other submitted the form. Keep a note saying exactly what the helper did and what you still need to do.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When a deadline overrides the low-demand plan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • If housing, benefits, utilities, insurance, or legal rights may be affected, contact the relevant organization or a qualified adviser promptly. A request for more time is not an extension until it is granted. Save the response and keep planning around the original deadline unless told otherwise.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • When nothing useful is possible today, preserve the page and reduce tomorrow's restart cost. For the appointment side, [doctor preparation](/guides/doctor-appointment-prep-checklist) can help organize questions about your thinking changes without attempting to diagnose them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What is the smallest useful task on a foggy day?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      It may be writing one deadline and where the relevant letter is kept. There is no universal minimum you must achieve. If symptoms make even that inappropriate, rest and use agreed help for urgent matters rather than forcing a productivity routine.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Should I wait for a better day to make calls?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Only when the deadline allows it. For a time-sensitive matter, ask about written contact, a callback, an extension, or an authorized helper. Confirm the actual response time. A message sent today may not be read before tomorrow's deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can these notes replace a medical assessment?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      No. They support paperwork and communication, not diagnosis or treatment. Seek medical advice for new, persistent, worsening, or worrying thinking problems, and immediate medical help for sudden confusion. Keep a short note of when the changes began for the clinician.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Executive dysfunction describes difficulty with skills such as planning, starting, switching, or finishing tasks. Procrastination describes delay. They can overlap, and neither guilt nor wanting to do the task tells you which explanation applies. A clinician evaluates persistent difficulties; a practical first step is to identify the obstacle in this particular task.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • You can spend the afternoon thinking about a form without touching it. That is frustrating, but it is not evidence that you are lazy, and it is not enough to diagnose ADHD. This guide helps you change the immediate conditions for action while keeping medical conclusions separate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The distinction is useful, but not a sorting test
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The [Centre for Addiction and Mental Health](https://www.camh.ca/en/professionals/professionals--projects/cognitive-adaptation-training/understanding/executive-functioning) describes executive functions as including making plans, starting activities, carrying out steps, and completing them despite distraction. Someone might know how to begin but lose the sequence; another might need a prompt for each transition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A delayed task can also involve fear of the answer, uncertainty, conflicting priorities, lack of money, fatigue, or unavailable information. More than one can be true. 'I care about it' versus 'I do not care' is not a reliable boundary between procrastination and executive difficulties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Check the real deadline and consequences before choosing a small step.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Name the obstacle in ordinary words rather than choosing a diagnostic label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Replace the project name with one action you can see yourself do.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Put the needed letter, file, or number within reach.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Reduce unrelated choices and interruptions if that helps you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Ask for a specific prompt or shared start if wanted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Record where you stopped; assess the setup, not your character.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Invented example: two different barriers to one form
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Sam needs to return a benefits form. The task says 'sort benefits,' and Sam cannot tell whether to find an account number, read the questions, or call the office. The revised action is 'open the letter and underline its deadline.' That produces a concrete next question rather than requiring the whole project to be mentally organized.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Lee has already completed the same form but avoids opening the envelope because the possible decision feels threatening. Lee asks someone trusted to sit nearby while they read it. Both situations involve delay. The useful support differs, and neither outcome tells us whether either person has a clinical condition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Make a shared start specific
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If another person's presence helps, agree what they will actually do. They might sit beside you while you open a document, read a question aloud, or check that the right file was attached. They do not need to supervise your whole day or take control of the matter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Use a start-and-stop agreement: 'I want company while I open this, and then I will choose whether to continue.' If you need the person to complete the process, discuss consent and any formal authorization. Do not share sensitive access details simply to get past the first obstacle.

Can you help me identify the first action without taking over?

Please tell me exactly what you need.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Preparing for a clinician
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line

Here are examples, when they began, and how they affect daily life.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When small steps do not solve the problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A tiny first step cannot create money for an unaffordable bill or make an inaccessible process accessible. If the obstacle is resources, unclear instructions, or another person's decision, seek the relevant assistance. If the deadline is near, ask for support or an extension now; a request alone does not change the deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If task difficulties persist across daily life, impair work or relationships, or change noticeably, discuss them with a qualified healthcare professional. [NIMH's ADHD guidance](https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/publications/attention-deficit-hyperactivity-disorder-what-you-need-to-know) explains why assessment considers history and possible alternative explanations. A checklist or a successful work session cannot settle that question.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Measure the experiment honestly
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • After trying the adjustment, ask whether it reduced the specific obstacle. Did writing the action make it understandable? Did company help you open the envelope? Did a short sequence stop you losing your place? Keep what helped, and change what added work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Do not turn the experiment into another streak you must maintain. If it fails, note what remained difficult. That observation is useful for a future attempt or a clinical conversation. For a ready-to-use next-action approach, see [first physical steps](/guides/first-physical-step-20-examples).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does caring about a task rule out procrastination?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. People can delay tasks they care about, including because the task feels threatening or confusing. Caring also does not establish executive dysfunction. Look at the pattern and obstacle, and seek assessment when persistent difficulties affect everyday functioning.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is executive dysfunction the same as ADHD?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. Executive function difficulties can appear in different circumstances and are not, by themselves, an ADHD diagnosis. A qualified clinician considers the broader history and possible explanations. Keep practical notes about your difficulties without trying to score yourself from one task.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What if breaking a task down still does not help?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Check whether the barrier is missing information, resources, access, exhaustion, or distress rather than task size. Ask for specific help or professional support as appropriate. If a deadline has serious consequences, pursue that help promptly instead of repeating the same technique indefinitely.
