                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Print a short contact and booking summary, plus any documents your carrier or destination specifically requires on paper. Keep passport or identity copies separately and securely. The contact summary helps when your phone fails; a photocopy does not replace an original passport or guarantee admission or boarding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The useful test is a late arrival with a dead battery. Can you show a driver the correct address, reach the property, and prove which dates you booked? A carefully chosen page solves that problem better than printing an entire inbox.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Build the contact summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write traveler names, trip dates, and the date this page was last updated.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Copy each accommodation's exact address in the local writing system where useful.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Add property phone numbers, booking names, references, and check-in dates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • List key flight and transfer details with the operator's contact information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Add your insurer's assistance number and policy reference if you have coverage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Include a trusted contact at home and an agreed way to share changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Store identity copies separately from this frequently handled page.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Give the address enough context
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Use the property's own address rather than a map pin you cannot interpret offline. Include its name and telephone number, not just a street. For multi-stop trips, put the next stay first or clearly label dates so a tired traveler does not head to yesterday's hotel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write numbers in internationally usable form with the country code, then verify them against the provider's information. Do not invent a telephone number to make the page look complete. A missing number marked 'verify before departure' is safer than a plausible-looking placeholder.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Keep two different kinds of paper
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The everyday page is for showing a driver or reading to an operator. Leave off card numbers, passwords, recovery codes, and detailed identity information. A reservation reference can also be sensitive, so share only the part another person needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identity copies belong in a more private packet, separate from your original documents. The [State Department's preparation brochure](https://travel.state.gov/content/dam/travel/cna_pdf/student-travel-brochure-pdf%20%281%29.pdf) recommends copies at home and a carried copy apart from originals. Protect the packet from casual access, and use secure disposal when you no longer need it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Make the backup survive a single loss
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Carry the contact page where you can reach it without opening every bag. Keep another copy with a travel partner or in a separate secure place. Two copies inside the same passport wallet do not protect against losing that wallet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Save the same summary offline on your phone and send the current version to your trusted contact if appropriate. Open the saved file with network access off before leaving. If the booking changes, update the paper or cross out the obsolete entry clearly. An old printed transfer time can create a new problem.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Two useful messages
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Confirming an arrival
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Our reservation is under [name] for [dates]. Please confirm the full arrival address, a number we can call from abroad, and the late check-in process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Updating the home contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              This version replaces the earlier itinerary. The changed stay is [name and dates]. Please keep this copy private.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            When the page is not enough
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check required originals, visas, child-travel permissions, and carrier document rules separately. Do not shrink identity copies to fit the contact sheet if that makes them unreadable. Different travelers may need different documentation, even on one booking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If an original document is lost or stolen, contact the relevant issuing authority or consular service and carrier for current instructions. Paper details can assist that conversation but cannot promise a same-day replacement. Use the [travel document checklist](/guides/travel-document-checklist) for the broader document task.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Do I need to print every booking email?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Usually you can make a shorter summary for everyday reference, but check any explicit carrier or provider requirements before discarding paper documents. Keep enough detail to identify the booking and reach the operator. Separate important conditions or tickets if the summary would omit them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Should I put passport numbers on the contact page?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Avoid putting them on a page you expect to show to strangers. Keep necessary identity copies or details in a separate secure packet. Think about what a person finding the page could do with it, not only how convenient it would be for you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Are screenshots enough?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Screenshots are useful offline backups but still depend on a working device and battery. Keep the highest-value contacts and arrival information on paper as well. Test that screenshots contain the relevant dates and addresses rather than only the top of an email.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Before bills come out, check the amount, collection date, funding account, and money needed for essentials until your next reliable deposit. Do the main check early enough to meet the bank's and biller's cutoffs, with room for weekends and holidays. A last-minute balance check is useful, but it may be too late to change a payment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Rent can fit comfortably in the balance while the next four debits do not. The problem is often sequence rather than the monthly total. This guide covers US consumer accounts and distinguishes bank-account transfers from subscriptions charged to a credit card; UK Direct Debit rules are different.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Check before the cutoff
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • List every scheduled debit through the next reliable income date, including annual charges.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Group them by the actual funding account, not by the person who pays them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Compare upcoming amounts with current bills and renewal notices.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Start with available funds; account for unposted commitments not already reflected.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Reserve groceries, transport, and other essential spending during the interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check transfer availability and the exact cutoff for changes or stop requests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • After any change, save confirmation and monitor the original collection date.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Fix the whole gap, not just the last debit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In this example, moving $33 would only cover the listed bills, not food and transport. A $153 transfer could address the arithmetic if the money is genuinely spare and available before collection. Do not assume a transfer is instant or that money in a savings goal is uncommitted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Alternatively, ask a biller about a payment arrangement or date change. Get the effective date, any cost, and confirmation about this particular debit. A new due date may not automatically change an already submitted autopay. Avoid making a manual payment until you know whether the automatic one will also run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Bank-account transfers have their own rules
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For covered preauthorized transfers from a US consumer account, [Regulation E](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/rules-policy/regulations/1005/10/) allows a stop-payment notice to the financial institution at least three business days before the scheduled transfer. The bank may require written confirmation within 14 days of an oral request. Ask exactly how to provide it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The rule also addresses notice of varying amounts, with exceptions for agreed ranges or differences. Read the authorization you gave. These rules do not mean stopping a debit cancels the debt or service contract, and they should not be presented as the procedure for every recurring credit-card charge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Credit-card subscriptions and card-bill autopay are different
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A subscription charged to a credit card is a merchant billing relationship. Cancel the service through its billing provider and contact the issuer about a disputed charge when appropriate. Separately, the payment that settles your card statement may itself pull from a bank account. Check its chosen amount: minimum, statement balance, or another figure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A replaced card, closed bank account, or stale payment instruction can also break an otherwise affordable payment. Check current payment details rather than assuming last month's success guarantees this month's result.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When the ordinary check is not enough
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If there is no way to cover essentials and upcoming commitments, contact billers promptly and seek qualified debt or local assistance advice. Protecting a monthly plan on paper is not the same as resolving a shortfall. Do not rely on overdraft coverage or a payment retry unless you have confirmed the terms.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • After collection, check both the account and the biller's record. Record failed payments, retries, charges, and any promised adjustment. If a payment already failed, use [missed-payment next steps](/guides/you-missed-a-payment-what-to-do-next) rather than waiting for the next monthly review.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How early should I check autopay?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Work backward from the earliest applicable bank or biller cutoff, then allow extra room for non-business days and processing. There is no universal two-day window that protects every payment. Keep a final funds check close to collection as a second check, not the first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I just move a bill to after payday?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You can ask, but the provider may refuse or apply the change only to a later cycle. Confirm this debit's status and any fees before spending the money elsewhere. Do not assume that a changed due date also changes autopay.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does stopping autopay remove what I owe?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No. Stopping a transfer and ending a contract are separate actions. Arrange another way to pay legitimate obligations, and cancel services through the correct provider when that is your intention. Keep records of both processes so they do not get confused.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • You can afford an everyday purchase only if its full cost fits after the bills, essentials, and money you intend to protect. Check the dates as well as the total. A balance, available credit limit, or small first installment does not answer that question by itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The tempting moment is checkout, when the price is clear but next week's groceries are not on the screen. This short cash test makes those commitments visible. It is for ordinary purchases, not a complete assessment of a mortgage, car loan, or other long-term commitment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Run the purchase check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Choose an interval through the next reliable income date and include commitments funded from today's money.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Start with spendable cash that is actually available, not credit or an unreceived payment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Subtract bills and unposted purchases not already reflected in that balance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Protect realistic groceries, transport, and other essentials for the interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Subtract emergency savings and other amounts you have chosen not to spend.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Add tax, delivery, accessories, and immediate operating costs to the price.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Test any later installments on their actual dates before deciding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Read what the answer means
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The $42 purchase fits this invented interval's stated commitments. That does not mean it is the best use of the money. The $180 purchase leaves no margin for an underestimated cost. The $480 purchase creates a gap unless something genuinely changes. Do not silently reclassify the repair reserve as free money to make the answer work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If your essential-spending estimate is uncertain, use actual recent spending and known changes. A week with a school trip, extra travel, or a prescription collection is not necessarily an ordinary week. If the item itself reduces an essential cost, count only the reduction you can reasonably establish.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tomorrow is payday: avoid misleading weekly arithmetic
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Do not divide by a rounded number of weeks that can become zero or exaggerate what remains. With one day until payday, subtract the actual costs before the deposit: tomorrow's commute, a grocery purchase, and any bills that will collect. Then review the next cycle after income arrives.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Waiting can give you time to compare prices or avoid a rushed choice, but payday does not automatically make the purchase affordable. That income may already fund rent or an annual bill. Recalculate with the new commitments rather than treating the entire deposit as extra.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Installments need a calendar, not just a cheaper first line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Use the schedule in the actual agreement. For an invented $180 plan with four $45 payments on November 18, December 2, December 16, and December 30, write all four dates down. Do not call them 'the next four paydays' unless your pay actually arrives on those dates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Test each collection against other spending in that period. Check fees, interest, payment method, and any consequences of a missed installment in the agreement. If the plan only fits by assuming overtime, a refund, or another uncertain receipt, record that dependency instead of calling the purchase funded.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Urgent needs change the choice, not the arithmetic
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A broken work tool may be necessary even when this check shows a shortfall. Identify the minimum workable replacement, ask about repairs or assistance, and check terms before borrowing. Do not turn necessity into an assurance that financing is harmless.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If the purchase would leave housing, utilities, food, or other essentials unpaid, stop the discretionary transaction and address the shortfall first. For a longer commitment, include ongoing ownership costs and seek suitable advice. Use [safe-to-spend calculations](/guides/how-much-of-your-money-is-actually-safe-to-spend) to establish the starting figure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Should I count savings as money I can spend?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Only if you deliberately decide to use that particular savings purpose. A balance earmarked for rent, repairs, or an emergency is not uncommitted merely because it is accessible. Record what would remain and how you would handle the obligation the savings previously covered.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does paying by credit card change the answer?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          It changes how payment is processed, not the resources available for repayment. Include the purchase in your plan once and make sure the card payment can be funded. If you expect to carry a balance, evaluate its costs separately before deciding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How much margin should I leave?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          There is no single amount that suits every household. Consider how uncertain your bills, income timing, and essential spending are. A calculation that leaves exactly zero is more vulnerable to a small surprise than one with room you have deliberately protected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep homeschool records for at least the period required by the rules governing your program. Separately, retain lasting academic evidence such as a final high-school transcript and the records supporting it. There is no universal two- or three-year rule that tells every US homeschool family when it is safe to discard everything.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A school-year box often contains three different collections: evidence you must keep, evidence you may need later, and things you love. Sorting those purposes before deciding dates prevents a large pile from hiding the one report you actually need.
