                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make three retention groups
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Group
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Examples
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Decision
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Required records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Attendance, portfolios, evaluations, notices, filing receipts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Follow the applicable rules; confirm the relevant period and accepted format.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Lasting academic evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Final transcript, course descriptions, credit calculations, graduation record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Retain long term as a practical recommendation, with reliable backups.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Routine samples and memories
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Duplicate practice sheets, project photos, first stories
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Select after checking legal and future-use needs; separate memories from compliance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use a state example without turning it into a national deadline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [Florida's home education statute](https://wwwo.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=1000-1099%2F1002%2FSections%2F1002.41.html%2F) requires the portfolio under that provision to be preserved for two years. Its contents include an activity log made contemporaneously with instruction, reading titles, and work samples. That is a specific legal example, not a disposal instruction for every kind of record or program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Read your current statute and education department guidance, checking the schooling route as well as the state. If the start of a retention period or the sufficiency of electronic copies is unclear, obtain a specific answer before shredding originals. Keep the answer with your retention note.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Review a year before discarding anything
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Identify the child, school year, and governing homeschool program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • List the records that were required and confirm their retention rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check for pending evaluations, official requests, transfers, or disputes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Select academic evidence that may support future transcripts or applications.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Separate sentimental material so it is not mistaken for required evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check scans for complete pages, legible dates, and readable annotations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Open the backup from a second location before disposing of originals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record what you discarded and the reason for the decision.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Invented example: one third-grade box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A parent finds 40 arithmetic worksheets, a reading list, an evaluation, filing correspondence, and a large model bridge. The family first checks which documents its program requires. It keeps the required set and filing proof intact, selects dated samples where permitted, and photographs the bridge with a note explaining the assignment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The photograph makes the project easier to store, but it does not automatically replace an original that a rule requires. Likewise, an unused teacher manual may be reusable, while a completed workbook or a list of reading titles may be evidence. 'Curriculum' is not a single disposal category.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  High school needs a different level of care
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A final transcript is easier to support if you retain the underlying course names, dates, credit decisions, grading methods, and relevant assessments. Keep final records in an openable format, with a private backup and a trusted person's knowledge of where they are stored. This is a practical preservation recommendation, not a claim that every document has a permanent legal retention requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Before graduation or a move, check what the intended college, employer, licensing body, or receiving school actually requests. Do not assume every institution wants the same documents. Preserve relevant originals until you have resolved the specific need.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  An app is not automatically an archive
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Know whether your tool limits visible history, exported entries, attachments, or access after account closure. Export before a limit could omit older work. Use a filename such as 'Child-school-year-export-date,' then check the earliest and latest entries and any attachment links.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A useful review point is term end and before changing tools, with an additional export whenever your tool's limits require it. Keep an independent copy. A PDF that points to photos in a closed account is not a complete archive of those photos.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ask before you discard
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Checking a rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    For [program and school year], which records must be retained, for how long, and may a legible electronic copy replace the original?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Checking an export
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does this export contain the complete record for [child and period], including older entries and attachments, or is any history excluded?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When to pause disposal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Stop if there is an unresolved official request, appeal, legal dispute, or uncertainty about a required document. Seek qualified local advice where necessary. Do not use an ordinary decluttering schedule to destroy potentially relevant evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For keeping new records manageable without deciding their final lifespan every day, use [the simple record keeping system](/guides/simple-homeschool-record-keeping-system). Retention decisions belong in a periodic review, not in the middle of teaching.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I throw away completed workbooks?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Sometimes, after preserving any required materials and useful academic evidence. Check the governing rules first. Keep enough context to identify the child, date, subject, and purpose of retained samples; a handful of anonymous pages may not serve the same job as the original book.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do I need to keep everything forever?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No universal rule requires that. Separate legal requirements from your own long-term preservation choices. Final academic records and filing evidence often deserve more care than repeated practice sheets, but pending requests or disputes can change an otherwise ordinary disposal decision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is scanning enough?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Only when the copy serves the needed purpose and your applicable rules accept it. Check readability, completeness, dates, and backup access before discarding originals. Keep attachments independently when an export only links to them, and preserve originals while a specific acceptance question remains unresolved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After an adult ADHD diagnosis, confirm the next appointment, who coordinates your care, and how to contact the team between visits. If medication is prescribed, ask the prescriber and pharmacy for your specific prescription and supply process. Put these answers on one page; you do not need to redesign your entire life or make every disclosure decision immediately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A diagnosis can arrive with relief, questions, or both. It can also arrive with a portal message, a referral, and three unanswered calls. This guide addresses that paperwork and follow-through, not which treatment to choose or how to change a prescribed medicine.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Before the next appointment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Save the assessment report or ask how to obtain it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm the name and contact details of the clinician responsible for follow-up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write the next appointment date, booking status, and what to bring.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask what to do about questions or problems between visits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If prescribed medication, get the prescription and supply process in writing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm who sends records to primary care and whether consent is needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Put requested forms and actual deadlines on the page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose one existing admin problem to support, not a whole-system overhaul.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Make a care-contact page, not a second medical chart
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep clinic contact details, appointment logistics, the report's location, and questions you need answered. Store diagnosis and prescription information privately. A general household task board does not need your full assessment report.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [NIMH's adult ADHD information](https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/publications/adhd-what-you-need-to-know) explains that adults can be diagnosed and that assessment looks beyond a single current difficulty. Once diagnosed, your practical task is to understand the plan agreed with your provider. You do not have to re-prove the diagnosis to every person helping with an appointment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Ask how this prescription process actually works
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Rules and workflows differ by medicine, country, clinician, insurer, and pharmacy. Ask whether a new prescription, appointment, authorization, or other step is required and who initiates it. Ask how far ahead to request the next supply, then use that answer rather than a generic reminder interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a pharmacy cannot supply what was prescribed, contact the pharmacist and prescriber for the appropriate next step. Do not change dose, borrow medication, substitute a product, or stop treatment based on an organizing article. Keep the contact attempt and response date so you can follow up without rebuilding the story.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Build reminders around actions, not just appointments
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A reminder at the appointment time does not help you arrange transport or complete a requested form. Add a preparation action and a departure time where useful. Keep the booking acknowledgment so a request does not become an appointment in your head before it is confirmed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For repeated administration, set a review date based on the actual office process. Check that someone has accepted a handoff before assuming responsibility transferred. This matters when moving between private and public care, clinicians, or insurers. A referral sent and a referral accepted are different states.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Separate disclosure choices from required questions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Telling friends or an employer is a different question from completing a particular insurance, licensing, or benefits form accurately. Do not assume a universal duty to disclose, or a universal absence of one. Read the question and the relevant current local guidance, and seek appropriate advice where the consequences matter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If you want workplace adjustments, ask the relevant workplace contact about its process and what documentation is needed. Share only what is appropriate for that purpose. This guide does not decide legal eligibility, confidentiality protections, or what an employer must provide.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Support one live difficulty
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose the admin problem costing you most right now: missed bills, appointment preparation, unopened letters, or starting a form. Give it a specific support, such as a funding-account check, an appointment page, or company while opening the envelope. A diagnosis does not clear a backlog automatically.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [Executive function and procrastination](/guides/executive-dysfunction-is-not-procrastination) can help describe a task barrier without treating every problem as the same. Keep medical questions for your clinician, and use the practical record to avoid losing agreed next steps.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When to contact someone sooner
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Do not wait for the routine review if you are unsure how to follow the treatment plan, cannot access prescribed care, or have a new concern. Ask the care team or pharmacist through the route they specified. For urgent or severe symptoms, use urgent medical services rather than waiting for an administrative reply.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [NICE's ADHD guidance](https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng87/chapter/Recommendations) addresses clinical follow-up and monitoring. It is not a reason to impose one appointment schedule on everyone. Write down the schedule and escalation instructions actually agreed for you.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What should I do first after diagnosis?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Confirm the care plan and the next follow-up with the clinician, then record the responsible contact and any preparation required. If a prescription is involved, ask about its specific process. Optional purchases, new planners, and broad disclosure decisions do not have to be your first jobs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How early should I request a repeat prescription?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask your prescriber and pharmacist for the process and lead time that apply to your medicine and location. There is no universal interval this guide can give. Put the confirmed action date in your calendar and check that a request was received.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I tell my employer?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        That decision depends on your goals, circumstances, and local rules. If seeking adjustments, ask about the formal process and documentation before sharing a full report. Obtain qualified advice for a consequential legal or employment question rather than relying on a general admin guide.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Life admin is the practical coordination that keeps ordinary life running: appointments, bills, renewals, forms, records, and following up when something has not happened. The visible action might be a phone call; the less visible work is noticing the need, gathering facts, and checking the outcome.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You can spend an evening doing this and have nothing new to show for it. The insurance stayed valid, the appointment moved, and the lost document was replaced. Naming the work helps you see what is open and agree who is responsible, rather than leaving the person who remembers first to manage everything.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The task is not always the whole matter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 'Call the insurer' describes an action. 'Update insurance after the move' describes a matter that may need several actions. If you cross off the call while a document is still missing, the list can look finished while the matter remains open.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Give a matter a current state: need information, ready to act, waiting for someone, or complete. A waiting state needs an expected response date or a follow-up point. That prevents the same unresolved issue from returning to your attention without any clue what to do next.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Make the work visible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Collect live letters, messages, and remembered obligations in one temporary inbox.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Name each matter in concrete terms, such as 'renew car insurance,' not 'car stuff.'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Record the actual deadline or mark it unknown until checked.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Choose the next action and put its needed reference beside it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Identify who owns the whole matter, including follow-up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Give waiting items a review date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Agree where confirmations and lasting facts will be kept.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Invented example: a move that is not one checkbox
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Alex and Jo have moved. Alex updates the bank, while Jo handles utilities. They agree that ownership includes checking the new details, not just sending the first request. The dentist and insurer are still unassigned, so these remain visible matters instead of becoming invisible assumptions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Their record has four lines: organization, owner, current state, next check. It is not a complete legal change-of-address list. It is a way to prevent 'I thought you did that' from being the household's operating process.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Share responsibility, not only the phone call
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • An owner should know the desired outcome, deadline, information location, and authority needed to act. Handing someone a number while continuing to remember every deadline is help with execution, not a full transfer of the matter. Either arrangement can be useful if it is explicit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Agree a completion signal: a confirmed appointment, updated account details, or a saved receipt. Respect private information and legal authority. Household membership does not automatically allow someone to access another adult's accounts, health information, or official records.
