                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When should I winterize?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Complete relevant work before your property is exposed to freezing conditions, allowing time to resolve unknown systems and book help. Check local forecasts rather than using one calendar date. Pipe exposure, insulation, wind, and heating conditions make a single universal damage threshold unreliable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is a faucet cover enough?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not necessarily. It does not automatically drain water left in the pipe or correct an unsuitable installation. Follow the faucet and plumbing system's instructions and ask a qualified person when the setup is unclear. Disconnect hoses as part of the appropriate preparation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I leave the heating off while away?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do not assume an unoccupied home can safely go without heat or other winter protection. The correct plan depends on the building, plumbing, climate, and applicable policy or management requirements. Arrange appropriate advice and a response plan before leaving.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A useful home maintenance log records which item was worked on, the date, what actually happened, who did it, and the cost. Add the evidence location and any unresolved follow-up. It is a history of completed work, not proof that equipment is safe or a substitute for its maintenance instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The question usually arrives after something fails: which filter did we buy, what did the technician find, and was that recommendation ever completed? A short entry with a clear asset name answers more than a folder of invoices with no index.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Actual completion date; label an estimate if uncertain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Work completed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Inspection, cleaning, replacement, or repair, with useful detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Person or provider
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Name and a retrievable contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Cost
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Known amount and status; use 'awaiting invoice' if needed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Invoice, service report, photo, or manual location
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Follow-up
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Unresolved finding, responsible person, and next action

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Create the first reliable entry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose one completed job with a receipt, report, or clear recollection.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Identify the exact system, appliance, or location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Describe the work without upgrading an inspection into a repair.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Enter the actual date and provider, marking unknowns honestly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record cost accurately or flag that the invoice is pending.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • File the evidence and write a location you can retrieve.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Create a separate open task for any unfinished recommendation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Check that the entry and its evidence can both be found.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A maintenance history is strongest when it distinguishes completed work from recommendations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Invented example: inspection is not replacement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • On November 12, a heating technician inspects the upstairs unit and replaces its filter. The report also recommends further investigation of a noise. The log says 'inspection and filter replacement completed; noise investigation remains open,' with the service report location and the invoiced amount.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It does not say 'heating fixed' or record a part replacement that was only quoted. The follow-up task says who will seek clarification and when. If later work happens, it receives its own dated entry rather than overwriting what occurred on November 12.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Write useful unknowns instead of guesses
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use 'date uncertain, invoice dated November 12' when that is all the evidence supports. Use 'awaiting invoice' rather than entering zero to fill a cost field. A zero cost should mean you know no payment was made, not that you have not checked.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a contractor gives verbal advice, label it as advice and record who said it. Ask for important findings in writing. Keep estimated costs and approved quotes distinct from final invoices. That makes later comparisons more meaningful than a column containing mixed guesses and actual bills.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The log is an index, not the whole repair file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Link or describe where supporting material lives: the original invoice, parts details, warranty information, photos, and service findings. Use stable filenames or a physical folder label. If a link requires an account that may close, keep an appropriate independent copy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For equipment identification, record the model or serial number in the asset record, then refer to that asset consistently. Avoid retyping a long identifier in every line if a clear asset name already points to it. See [what to keep after a home repair](/guides/what-to-keep-after-a-home-repair) for the broader evidence set.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Ask for an entry you can actually use

Please note it on the report.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not let an entry invent the next interval
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Recording a job does not automatically establish when it is due again. A full service, partial inspection, and failed attempt should not all reset the same maintenance schedule. Use the manual, relevant professional advice, and the work's actual scope.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep urgent faults out of a routine future reminder. If there is an active hazard or unexplained leak, seek the appropriate professional or emergency help now. An unresolved safety issue should not become a harmless-looking note scheduled for next year.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Make it workable for the property you have
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • One chronological log can work for a small home. A larger property may benefit from asset-specific views, provided you can still find the complete history. Choose the arrangement that makes the question 'what happened to this item?' easy to answer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Renters should distinguish work they performed from reports to the landlord and landlord-arranged visits. Preserve communications separately. The log helps organize facts but does not settle liability, deposit disputes, warranty coverage, or legal record requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do I need to record DIY work?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes, when it will help you or a later professional understand the history. State what you actually did and which materials or parts were used. Do not imply qualified servicing or a safety certification when you performed a limited household task.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I use one log for the whole house?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Yes, if each entry clearly identifies the item and you can find its history. Separate views may help when there are many systems or repeated faults. Avoid multiple records that disagree about whether the same job was completed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if I stopped recording maintenance?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Begin with the next completed job and recover older entries from real evidence where useful. Mark uncertain dates and missing details. A concise honest history is more useful than an apparently complete one built from assumptions about what usually happens each year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Inspect your furnace or central HVAC filter regularly and replace or clean it according to the equipment and filter instructions. ENERGY STAR recommends monthly filter attention. The correct replacement schedule depends on the actual filter, system, use, and conditions; do not assume every filter should be replaced exactly every three months.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The useful first question is not which generic interval to put in a calendar. It is which filter your system uses and how its manufacturer says to maintain it. A deep media filter, disposable panel, washable filter, and specialist cleaner can have different instructions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Establish your filter routine
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Find the equipment manual and identify the filter location and type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Confirm the approved dimensions and specification, not only the old filter's label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check the recommended inspection and maintenance method.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use the manual's safe access and shutdown procedure before handling it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Inspect for dirt, damage, fit, and the conditions described by the instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Replace disposable filters or clean reusable ones only as directed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record the installed item, date, and next inspection.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask an HVAC professional when access, compatibility, or system behavior is unclear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Inspection and replacement are different actions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [ENERGY STAR's checklist](https://www.energystar.gov/saveathome/heating-cooling/maintenance-checklist) calls for monthly inspection, cleaning, or changing. That is a prompt to give the filter attention, not a claim that every filter in every home has the same life. Use the manufacturer-specific instructions to decide what maintenance is due.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Heavy use and unusual dust may justify checking sooner, but a visual judgment alone may not answer every maintenance question. Do not extend an interval solely because a house is empty, or wash a disposable filter to keep using it. Keep a new inspection date visible even when no replacement was needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Size and rating both matter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The size printed on an existing filter is a useful lead, but it may not establish that someone previously installed the correct part. Confirm against the equipment instructions or a qualified technician. Avoid forcing a filter into a slot or leaving gaps around an undersized one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The [EPA's air-cleaner guidance](https://www.epa.gov/indoor-air-quality-iaq/guide-air-cleaners-home) discusses choosing an appropriate HVAC filter. A higher filtration rating is not automatically an appropriate upgrade for every system. Ask about compatibility rather than choosing the highest number on the shelf.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Handle access as an equipment task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Follow the unit's access and power instructions and the filter's airflow markings. If the location or required orientation is unclear, ask someone qualified to show you. Do not remove service panels, reach near moving parts, or bypass safety switches to make a routine filter task possible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep the cabinet properly closed when finished, following the instructions. If you rent, ask the landlord or building manager which maintenance is yours to do and which filter is approved. A shared-building system may not have an occupant-serviceable filter at all.
