                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When the filter is not the whole problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Weak airflow, recurring system faults, unusual noises, or a filter that loads unexpectedly can need professional investigation. Do not keep installing filters while assuming that repeated symptoms are normal. Record the dates and what you noticed so the technician has a useful history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Filtration also does not remove every indoor pollutant or replace addressing a moisture or pollutant source. Do not treat a new filter as a health guarantee or as a response to a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm. Leave a dangerous situation and use the appropriate emergency help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make the reminder specific enough to act on
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use 'inspect upstairs return filter' instead of 'house maintenance.' Put the specification and purchase reference in the equipment record, and record what you actually did in [the home maintenance log](/guides/home-maintenance-log-template). A reminder should point to the verified information, not force a new search.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If an inspection shows that no maintenance is needed, record that result without pretending a replacement occurred. That keeps a service history honest and prevents an automatic next-date calculation from starting from the wrong event.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is every three months a safe rule?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not universally. It may resemble instructions for some filters, but others differ. Inspect regularly and follow the actual equipment and filter guidance. Confirm the schedule when the filter type or household conditions change rather than relying only on an inherited calendar reminder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I use a higher-rated filter?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Only after checking that it is appropriate for the system. Size is not the only compatibility question. Ask the equipment maker or an HVAC professional about the suitable specification, especially if you are considering a change from the established type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I clean and reuse my filter?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Only if that filter is designed to be cleaned and reused, and then only by its specified method. Disposable and reusable filters are not interchangeable maintenance tasks. If you cannot identify the type, obtain the instructions or professional help before proceeding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Look near where the water supply enters the home, such as a basement entry point, utility area, or another location identified in the property records. Then confirm that the valve controls your domestic supply and that you are allowed to operate it. Do not assume the nearest valve, water-heater valve, or curb box is the right one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The best time to find it is before water is escaping. You need more than a photograph of a handle: you need the location, which supply it controls, safe access, and who to call if it will not work. In apartments, shared buildings, well systems, and homes with fire sprinklers, ask the responsible professional or manager before experimenting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Find and document the correct valve
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Check the inspection report, plumbing records, or building information for the supply entry point.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask the landlord, building manager, utility, or plumber which valve serves your unit or house.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Follow accessible visible pipework only where it is safe to do so.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm whether domestic water and fire sprinklers have separate branches.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record which valve occupants may operate and which belongs to the utility or building.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask for a demonstration if its operation or condition is uncertain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Photograph the confirmed location and write directions from a familiar doorway.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Share the record with appropriate household members and keep access clear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use common locations as clues, not a guarantee
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [WSSC Water's valve guide](https://www.wsscwater.com/customer-service/report-problem/find-and-operate-your-main-water-valve) describes several layouts, including valves near entry points, utility equipment, and other locations depending on construction. Its instructions concern its service area and typical arrangements there. They are not proof that every home everywhere has the same setup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A valve beside a water heater may control only that appliance. A small valve under a sink may control that fixture. Trace and confirm the supply rather than labeling the first handle you find 'main.' If doing that would require opening walls or entering an unsafe space, stop and ask for help.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Identify before operating
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Valve or location
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What to verify
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Domestic customer shutoff
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It serves the intended domestic supply and is safe to use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Fixture valve
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It isolates the specific sink, toilet, or appliance, not the whole home.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Curb or meter valve
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Your utility's ownership and permitted operating procedure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Fire-sprinkler branch
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The correct response without disabling protection unnecessarily.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Shared building supply
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who is authorized and which other units would be affected.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Invented example: two handles by the meter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A homeowner finds two valves near a meter and is unsure whether one also affects the fire sprinklers. Instead of following an online rule to turn the first handle, they ask a qualified plumber to identify the domestic shutoff. They record 'domestic valve confirmed by plumber, November 17' and keep a labeled photograph.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The record also identifies a separate valve that must not be treated as the everyday domestic control. The point is not that two handles always mean the same layout. It is that the actual configuration must be understood before a rushed choice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Learn the actual operation, not just a handle stereotype
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Wheel and lever handles often have different operating actions, but appearance alone is not enough to justify forcing an unfamiliar valve. Have the correct valve and direction confirmed. Record any instruction about closing slowly, stopping position, and restoring service for your installation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Do not add a pipe or large wrench for leverage on a stuck or corroded valve. If it leaks, will not move, or is in doubtful condition, arrange professional attention. Do not make annual exercise of every old valve a universal task without considering its condition and the responsible professional's advice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A safe confirmation test needs context
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a qualified person has confirmed a test is appropriate, follow the instructions for your installation and verify the result as directed. Residual water can remain in pipes, and continued flow may have more than one explanation. Do not keep tightening a handle to chase every last drip.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Water heaters, boilers, pumps, treatment equipment, and sprinkler systems can introduce additional requirements when water is isolated or restored. This article is not a drain-down or restart procedure for those systems. Ask about them before a planned shutdown rather than assuming opening a faucet makes every installation safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If water is escaping now
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use the confirmed occupant-operated valve only if you can reach and operate it safely. If the leak is clearly at a fixture and its correct local valve is known and safe, isolating that fixture may be appropriate while help is arranged. Otherwise call the plumber, building emergency contact, or utility as relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Do not enter standing water near electrical equipment or go beneath an unstable wet ceiling to reach a valve. Move away from danger and use appropriate emergency assistance. Utility-owned valves, unfamiliar fire-system components, and inaccessible spaces are not an invitation to improvise.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep a record someone can actually follow
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write directions such as 'utility closet beside the kitchen, lower access panel' rather than 'by the pipes.' Add a photograph of the confirmed valve in its surroundings, the responsible contact, and any limits on use. Avoid publishing sensitive access information where strangers can see it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Review the page after plumbing work or a move. Keep it with [your home binder](/guides/how-to-make-a-home-binder), but make sure the relevant people know where it is. An accurate private record is more useful than a bright label on an unverified valve.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Is the main shutoff always inside?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No universal location applies. Construction, supply arrangement, and local practice differ. Use records and the relevant utility or building guidance to identify the correct customer-operated valve. Do not assume an outside meter or curb valve is yours to use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if the valve is stuck?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Stop rather than forcing it. Contact a plumber, building manager, or utility according to which valve it is. If a leak is active, explain that it is an emergency. Record the failed condition so others do not assume the shutoff is ready for use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I just turn off the water heater valve?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        That may isolate only the heater, not the home's cold supply or a leak elsewhere. Confirm what the valve controls. Planned isolation or restoration can also involve appliance-specific requirements, so obtain the correct instructions rather than treating a nearby handle as the main shutoff.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Make a home binder by collecting five kinds of information: emergency contacts and locations, equipment details, service contacts, completed repairs, and upcoming dates. Start with one reference page. Keep passwords, access codes and sensitive originals somewhere more restricted than the binder you hand to a sitter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The useful test is not whether every divider is full. It is whether someone can find the right phone number while you are away, or buy the correct filter without calling you from the store. This guide covers the house itself, not meal plans, family schedules or an estate file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Write the property address and the name of the person responsible for updating the binder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Add emergency and routine reporting contacts, clearly distinguished.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Record only shutoff locations you have actually identified; mark uncertain entries as unverified.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Choose one frequently serviced appliance and copy its model and serial number from the label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Add the last completed repair with a pointer to the invoice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Enter the next confirmed renewal or appointment in both the binder and a reminder system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Put a last-checked date on the reference page and tell another household member where it lives.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Keep a reference, not a portable identity file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A contractor may need a boiler model number, but not a mortgage statement. A sitter may need a utility emergency contact, but not an insurance document containing financial information. Make a shareable reference section and a restricted archive. In the reference section, write 'policy copy in locked file' rather than including the full document.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep ownership papers, signed contracts and records needed for tax or legal purposes according to the requirements that apply to them. A binder index is not permission to discard originals. A scan may be convenient without replacing a required original. Do not assume all home paperwork has the same retention period.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Paper can be useful during a device failure. Digital copies can help when you are away. Neither is infallible: a paper binder can be lost, and a cloud folder can require power, connectivity or a login. Keep a dated offline emergency reference if another person may need it.
