                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Check safety notices separately
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The [CPSC recall search](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls) lets you look up product recalls and safety warnings. Match identifying details against the notice rather than relying on a similar-looking product photo. If there is a match, follow that notice's instructions; a warranty calendar does not tell you whether an item is safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Do not operate an unfamiliar gas valve, remove an electrical panel cover or enter an unsafe area merely to complete a page. Mark the field 'needs professional confirmation' and use the appropriate utility or qualified contractor. An immediate danger takes priority over record keeping.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Make updates follow real events
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • After a repair, replace the old contact or equipment entry while the invoice is still open. After a move, review every property-specific fact rather than carrying it forward automatically. After someone tests the binder and cannot find an answer, improve that page rather than adding another decorative section.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If the project stops after one page, leave that page accessible and dated. Next time, add one real equipment record. For the ongoing work history, use the fields in the [home maintenance log guide](/guides/home-maintenance-log-template). The binder is useful before it is complete.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What belongs in a home binder?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Put in the facts you repeatedly need about the property: emergency contacts, equipment identifiers, service contacts, repair history and confirmed dates. Use location pointers for restricted documents. Add household routines only if someone will actually use them; they are not necessary for a home-systems binder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Should I keep the binder on paper or online?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Choose the format the household can reliably access. Paper is easy to hand over; digital files are searchable and accessible away from home when the necessary device and access work. A short offline reference plus a restricted digital archive is one workable combination, not a requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How often should I update it?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Update entries when the underlying fact changes: a new appliance, repair, contractor, lease or insurance renewal. Put a last-checked date and responsible person on the key reference page. A periodic review can catch missed changes, but there is no universal review schedule for every household.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When moving into a rental, document the property's condition before your belongings cover it. Take original photos, complete the required move-in inventory, report existing problems in writing and keep proof you sent it. Photos support a condition checklist; they do not automatically replace a signed form or local submission requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Moving day already has enough decisions. You do not need a professional inspection report to notice a chipped worktop or stained carpet. You do need a record that identifies the room, the defect and when you reported it. This is a US organizing guide, not a statement of every state's rental law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Before the boxes cover the evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Read the lease and move-in instructions for the inventory form, delivery method and deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Photograph each room in wide view, then photograph existing defects close up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Include cupboards, appliance interiors, windows, flooring and fixtures where safely accessible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write room names and factual descriptions on the inventory; avoid guessing the cause of damage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record keys, fobs, access devices and relevant meter readings without publishing access codes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Send the inventory and repair requests through the required channel and retain the sent copy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask for acknowledgement and a signed copy where applicable; save those separately from your own notes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Back up original files and store the signed lease, deposit receipt and contact details together.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make photos easy to connect to the inventory
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep the original files, including their metadata, rather than relying only on a messaging app's compressed copies. A visible date is not essential to the usefulness of a photo; preserve the original and record the inspection date in the inventory. Take a wide shot showing where the defect is, then a close-up showing its detail.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use simple file names or an index such as Kitchen-01, Kitchen-02 and Hall-01. Describe 'dark mark beside refrigerator, approximately palm-sized' rather than 'landlord's leak damage.' If the cause is unknown, say so. A video walkthrough can add context but can make individual defects harder to locate later.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Reporting the inventory
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I collected keys for [address] on [date]. Attached is my move-in condition inventory with indexed photos. Please confirm receipt and send a signed copy if that is part of the process. These entries record the condition I observed before unpacking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Asking for a repair
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The bathroom extractor did not operate using its normal switch on [date]. I have attached the relevant inventory entry. Please confirm how to report this formally, the next step and any access arrangements needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Save the financial and date records too
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep the deposit amount, payment receipt, payee and any required protection or holding information. Record the lease start and end, any renewal process, and notice requirements from the actual lease and applicable local rules. Do not copy another tenant's notice period into your calendar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The [California Department of Real Estate guide](https://www.dre.ca.gov/publications/ResourceGuidebook/gb07_when.html) discusses rental agreement terms and pre-move-in inspection records. Its California-specific rules are not national rules. For help finding the relevant agency or legal assistance where you rent, use [USAGov's tenant-rights page](https://www.usa.gov/tenant-rights).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When documenting is not enough
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A dangerous condition is not a photography assignment. If there is an immediate threat, leave the unsafe area and contact the appropriate emergency service or utility. Do not touch exposed wiring, dismantle appliances or investigate a suspected gas leak to get better evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If the manager refuses to acknowledge the inventory, keep the sent record and seek local advice about the correct notice procedure. Do not assume silence means agreement. Likewise, do not withhold rent or pay for repairs expecting reimbursement without checking the law and procedure that apply to your tenancy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Wear, damage, cleaning charges and deposit return deadlines depend on local law and the facts. A record helps describe and challenge a claim; it does not guarantee a particular result. At move-out, repeat the same room sequence so the two records can be compared.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Are photos enough without a signed checklist?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do not assume so. Photos are useful supporting evidence, but your lease or local law may require a particular inventory, signature or submission process. Complete that process and keep a copy. Ask for acknowledgement of delivery even if the landlord has not agreed with every observation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if I notice damage after unpacking?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Record it as soon as you notice it, with the actual discovery date and any relevant earlier photo. Report it in writing through the required channel. Do not alter dates or describe it as definitely pre-existing if you are unsure; explain what you know and what you cannot establish.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should I label marks as normal wear and tear?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Describe the condition first. Whether it counts as ordinary wear or chargeable damage depends on local rules and circumstances, including the item's condition and use. An exact observation and a linked photo are more useful than a confident legal label that may be wrong.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Debt snowball directs extra money to the smallest balance. Debt avalanche directs it to the highest interest rate. Both keep required minimums paid on every account. Under a simple fixed-rate model with the same total payments and no special fees, targeting the highest rate reduces interest cost; snowball prioritizes clearing a small account.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • When three statements arrive together, the difficult decision is often not knowing the definitions. It is deciding whether one closed account matters more to you than a lower interest bill. Compare those outcomes separately rather than treating either method as a character test. This guide covers ordinary repayment planning, not debt settlement, insolvency or student-loan program selection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      left
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Snowball
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Order targets by starting balance, smallest first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Direct extra money to the first target.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After payoff, move its payment to the next target.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      right
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Avalanche
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Order targets by interest rate, highest first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Direct extra money to the first target.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After payoff, move its payment to the next target.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • List each current balance, APR, required minimum and due date from the statement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record promotional end dates, deferred-interest terms, fees and any prepayment restrictions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Set aside essential living costs and decide what extra amount is genuinely available.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Check that every required minimum is covered before directing extra money anywhere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose a target order and write down the reason so you can review it later.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After each payment, check that it posted and update the account balance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Follow one payment month all the way through
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The total budget is $390: $190 in minimums plus $200 extra. The model adds $9, $50 and $20 interest respectively, leaving $609, $2,050 and $3,020 before payments. With snowball, payments are $230, $60 and $100. End balances are $379, $1,990 and $2,920.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • With avalanche, payments are $30, $260 and $100. End balances are $579, $1,790 and $2,920. Both end the first month owing $5,289. The difference is where the remaining debt sits: avalanche has $200 less exposed to the 30% rate and $200 more exposed to 18%. In the next model month, that allocation produces $2 less interest, before any later payoff changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This is a reproducible first-month comparison, not a complete payoff forecast. It does not establish how large the final gap will be. Real cards may calculate interest daily and change minimums; loan payment allocation can differ. Do not attach exact payoff dates to this simplified example.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Compare cost, milestones and cash-flow relief
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For a full comparison, hold the total payment budget constant, declare when interest and payments occur, and decide how leftover money in a payoff month moves to the next account. Apply the same rule to both schedules. Check total interest, the first account payoff and the last payment separately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A closed account removes its required minimum, but the plan only accelerates if you keep directing that freed money to debt. You may instead need it for essentials after an income change. That is a cash-flow decision, not a failure of arithmetic. A hybrid approach can be reasonable if you understand its cost; it is not automatically the best of both methods.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [CFPB explanation](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/archive/blog/how-reduce-your-debt/) describes both approaches and their tradeoffs. It does not supply a universal dollar threshold for choosing motivation over interest savings. Decide using your own priorities and circumstances, not a claim that everyone abandons one particular method.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Pause the comparison when the assumptions fail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If minimums are unaffordable, choosing a target is not the next problem to solve. Contact creditors about available arrangements and seek reputable debt advice. Do not use money needed for food, housing or essential services simply to preserve a repayment chart.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A promotion expiring soon, deferred interest, a delinquent account, a secured debt at risk or a legal notice can require a different priority. Read the actual terms and get qualified help where needed. Review the plan when rates, balances or income change. For a payment already missed, start with [what to do next](/guides/you-missed-a-payment-what-to-do-next).
