                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Room size is an option, not a fairness law
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • One roommate convention weights the entire rent by bedroom size. Another splits a chosen common-space portion equally and weights only the remainder by private room size. An ensuite, parking space or an unusually small room may justify a negotiated adjustment. These are agreement options, not legal formulas.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For example, with $2,400 rent, roommates could agree that $1,200 covers shared space equally and $1,200 is allocated by bedroom size. Choosing the common-space portion is itself a negotiation. Utilities may use a different split. Keep the final amounts in writing rather than expecting the measurements to answer every question.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Can we list what counts as shared, compare two splits and choose payment dates before the next bills arrive? I want the agreement to show amounts rather than leave either of us guessing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A temporary shortfall
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            I cannot transfer the full amount on our usual date. Can we agree what is covered now, whether any difference is repayable, and when we will review this? We also need to check the provider's deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Income privacy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            I do not want to share my full financial details. Can we compare an equal or fixed-amount arrangement that we can both afford instead?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A joint account is not required
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • You can keep separate accounts and use a shared settlement record: bill amount, agreed shares, payer, contribution received and provider payment confirmed. Do not mark a bill paid merely because one roommate sent their share. That transfer and the provider payment are different events.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If using a joint account, ask the bank about access, withdrawals, overdrafts, disputes and closure before opening it. The [CFPB notes](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/can-i-remove-my-spouse-from-our-joint-checking-account-en-1097/) that removing a spouse generally requires consent, subject to law and account terms. Do not assume you can unilaterally remove another owner later.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If discussion involves threats, withheld access to money or coercion, prioritize safety and confidential qualified support over joint budgeting. If a bill is unaffordable or a household member leaves, check the underlying contract and seek local advice where responsibility is disputed. Start the common inventory with a [monthly bills list](/guides/monthly-bills-list).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Should couples split bills 50/50?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Only if both agree it works for their circumstances. Compare the actual amounts and what each person has left for essentials. Income-based or negotiated fixed shares are alternatives, but none automatically accounts for care work, disability costs or other responsibilities. Revisit the agreement when circumstances change.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Should we use gross or take-home income?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use the same clearly defined basis for everyone. Take-home income reflects incoming cash but can be affected by voluntary deductions; gross income leaves tax and benefit differences unresolved. Discuss those differences and choose an agreed method rather than mixing bases or presenting one as universally correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Does our split change what we owe the landlord?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Not by itself. The lease and applicable law determine obligations to the landlord, while your split records arrangements between household members. Check the actual agreement before assuming you owe only your private share. Obtain local advice if someone leaves or a payment is disputed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A useful subscription tracker records the service, charge, billing cycle, next charge date, actual cancellation cutoff, billing channel and your next decision. Keep 'plan to cancel' separate from 'cancellation confirmed.' A renewal date is not automatically the last safe day to act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The problem is rarely remembering that streaming costs money. It is finding out that an annual plan renews tomorrow, or discovering that the account is managed through an app store rather than the service's website. This guide organizes subscriptions you already know about. For discovery, use [how to find every subscription](/guides/how-to-find-every-subscription-you-are-paying-for).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Verified account date
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • That last year's date still applies

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Verify the billing channel and next charge in the actual account.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Read the cancellation terms and record any cutoff separately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Enter the full upcoming charge even if you also calculate a monthly equivalent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Choose keep, review or cancel, and assign an action date before the cutoff.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Set a reminder where you will see it and confirm it was saved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Record who will act if the service is shared.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • After cancellation, save the confirmation and check the next relevant statement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Invented example: two dates prevent one mistake
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A fictional annual learning app shows a $96 charge on December 10. Its account terms specify that cancellation must be completed by December 8. The tracker therefore records December 10 as the charge date, December 8 as the cutoff, and December 3 as this household's action date. December 3 is a chosen buffer, not a rule for all subscriptions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The action owner opens the correct billing account on December 3, cancels and saves the confirmation. The row changes to 'confirmed; access ends December 10.' It remains in an archive pending a charge check. If the provider's terms are unclear, the next action is to ask for clarification, not invent a cutoff from the previous charge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Make the review window reach the next review
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If you review monthly, looking ahead only two weeks leaves a gap. Review through your next scheduled review plus a practical buffer, or use more frequent reviews with verified individual reminders. The right buffer depends on the service's terms and the time you need to act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Add trials on the day you start them, including the conversion price, trial end and cancellation instructions. The [FTC subscription guidance](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/getting-and-out-free-trials-auto-renewals-and-negative-option-subscriptions) advises checking terms, using reminders and retaining cancellation evidence. Do not assume that every trial can be cancelled by the same method or at the same time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • An active subscription belongs once in your overall recurring-payment total. Keep detailed decision notes here and the payment in your [monthly bills list](/guides/monthly-bills-list), without adding both records together. For shared plans, track the full provider charge and expected contributions separately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Keep evidence when a service ends
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Do not delete a row as soon as you press cancel. Record the request date, confirmation reference, stated access end and where the evidence is stored. Check whether the next charge stopped or a promised refund arrived. Archive the record once the outcome is understood, retaining it as long as a dispute or other relevant need remains.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If you are charged after cancelling, contact the provider through its official channel with the evidence. Contact the payment provider promptly if the charge is unauthorized or the dispute is unresolved; deadlines depend on the payment and situation. Replacing a card or stopping a payment is not the same as ending a contract.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Store account-owner names and management links, not passwords or card security codes. If the tracker is shared, remove unrelated personal services before sending it. A practical list should not become a shared credential file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Is the renewal date the cancellation deadline?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Not necessarily. The provider may require action earlier or through a particular channel. Record the next charge and actual cutoff as separate fields, then set your own action date before the cutoff. Confirm uncertain terms rather than treating a reminder as proof you can still cancel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Should I remove cancelled subscriptions?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Move them to an archive rather than deleting the evidence. Keep the request, confirmation and next charge check together. If cancellation failed or the next payment still appears, that record helps explain the problem and gives you something specific to send when following up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can paper work as a subscription tracker?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes. The format matters less than accurate dates, a named action owner and reminders outside a page you may not open. Paper can hold the record; a calendar can carry the action date. Update both when the service changes its price or terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • To use a bank statement CSV for a budget, keep the original download, import a copy with explicit date and amount formats, reconcile its totals and review transfers before categorizing. Then add current balances, future income and unpaid obligations. A transaction file describes a period of activity; it is not a complete forward-looking budget.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A grocery payment shown as income can make a neat chart completely wrong. So can counting both a card purchase and its later card payment as spending. Before choosing categories, establish what each column means and which accounts are included. Banks export different layouts, and some exports include pending entries rather than only posted transactions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Download through the bank's official website and record the account, date range and export settings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep the original untouched and work from a copy in a restricted location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Preview the file without enabling formulas or active content.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Identify the date format, currency, delimiter and amount or debit/credit columns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Map transaction amounts, not the running balance, to the amount field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Compare transaction count and inflow/outflow totals with the same bank activity period.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Resolve duplicate candidates, transfers, refunds and pending-to-posted changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Categorize the reconciled data and add future commitments separately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Check formats before trusting the preview
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [Microsoft import guidance](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/get-started/import-or-export-text-txt-or-csv-files) explains that opening a CSV directly uses default interpretation settings. A controlled text/CSV import gives you a chance to inspect formats. Check an unambiguous date against the bank account and preserve identifiers with leading zeros as text.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A file using 03/05 needs more evidence to establish whether that means March 5 or May 3. Amounts may use decimal commas, thousands separators, parentheses for outflows or separate debit and credit columns. Do not assume every positive value is income, particularly in credit-card exports.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a row has shifted columns, stop and inspect the delimiter and quoting. Do not drop a malformed row simply to make the import succeed. Re-export, consult the bank's format help or record a documented correction in the working copy, preserving the original for comparison.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Reconcile the scope before removing duplicates
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record the first and last included dates for every account import. Calendar months are convenient, but explicit non-overlapping ranges matter more than the name of the month. Some exporters use inclusive boundaries; check the actual rows. An overlapping file can duplicate an import even if each file is valid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Compare totals for the same account, dates and posted/pending status. Where the bank provides matching opening and closing balances, test whether opening balance plus inflows minus outflows reconciles, while accounting for the bank's display conventions. Investigate a mismatch instead of inventing an adjustment to force agreement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Two equal purchases on the same date may both be real. Use transaction identifiers when available and compare the official activity details. A pending authorization may later post with a different amount or description. Keep an exception list until you understand it; do not count both versions blindly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Avoid counting your own money twice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • When both accounts are in scope, a transfer to savings is an outflow from one and inflow to another, not new income or consumption. Match the two sides. A card payment is also movement between your accounts if the underlying card purchases are already counted. If only one account is imported, label the transfer clearly rather than pretending missing detail is known.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Refunds should be connected to the original category where practical. Do not classify every positive row as wages. If a refund relates to an earlier month, choose and document a consistent reporting approach so comparisons remain understandable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • CSV files contain sensitive transaction details. Review the destination's privacy and retention terms before uploading, share the minimum needed, and remove unnecessary copies securely. A manual download avoids supplying a bank login for that transfer, but does not make the data harmless. For the next planning layer, use a [monthly bills list](/guides/monthly-bills-list).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I build a budget from a CSV alone?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        It can show historical spending and income for the exported scope, but not every future obligation or current available balance. Add upcoming bills, essential spending and confirmed incoming money. Also check for accounts, cash transactions or annual expenses outside the file before calling the budget complete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I delete matching transactions automatically?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No. Matching date, description and amount make a useful review flag, not proof that a row is duplicated. Two genuine purchases can match. Compare transaction identifiers, import ranges and bank activity before excluding a row, and keep a record of what was excluded and why.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Why did my dates change in the spreadsheet?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The spreadsheet may have interpreted them using its default locale or date format. Re-import the original copy with explicit column settings and compare unambiguous entries with the bank. Do not repair dates by guessing from a chart or by changing display format after an incorrect conversion.
