                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Refusing a request
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Thank you for asking. I cannot host the weekend. I wanted to tell you now so you can make another plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Changing a commitment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              I said I would send this Friday, but I cannot meet that date. I can send the completed section Tuesday. Is there an immediate consequence we need to address today?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Sharing personal news
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Are you somewhere you can talk privately for a few minutes? I need to tell you [the fact]. We can pause after that if you need time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Money shortfall
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              I cannot make the payment I previously proposed. I can discuss what is realistically available, but I do not want to agree to another amount I cannot meet.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Invented example: a refusal is not a negotiation by default
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Suppose Alex has been asked to host a family visit. Before calling, Alex writes: 'I cannot host overnight guests, including a shorter stay.' The opening is, 'I cannot host this visit. I wanted to tell you before travel plans are made.' When asked about one night instead, Alex replies, 'I understand why you are asking, but I cannot host overnight.'
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The example is fictional and does not guarantee a smooth reaction. Its useful feature is consistency: the smaller proposal still crosses the boundary Alex identified. Alex does not offer a hotel booking or another favour merely to soften the refusal unless that is something Alex actually wants and can provide.

My answer is still no, and I do not have another arrangement to offer.

Give me a moment to look at my notes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use enough explanation, not a rehearsed apology quota
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A brief reason can make a decision understandable. Some conversations need more context, accountability or an apology, especially if another person relied on a promise. There is no useful universal rule about apologizing once or refusing all explanation. Keep the facts accurate and the limits clear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A pause gives both people room to respond. It is not a technique for forcing agreement. Listen for practical information you may have missed, such as a deadline or someone needing another contact, without treating every request as an obligation to change your answer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If you genuinely do not know, say so. Do not replace uncertainty with a reassuring date or promise. If the matter affects a contract, payment arrangement or formal complaint, check the applicable terms or seek qualified advice before making an admission or agreement you do not understand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Confirm facts, not imaginary agreement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • At the end, distinguish your message from mutual agreement: 'I have confirmed I cannot host; you said you will look at other arrangements.' Do not say 'we agreed' if the other person objected. For practical commitments, write who will do what and by when.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A short follow-up can prevent confusion: 'To confirm today's call, I cannot host overnight. I have not made any replacement booking.' Keep confidential details out of voicemail or a shared inbox. If you do not know who receives the message, leave only a safe callback request.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A call is not automatically kinder or safer than writing. Consider privacy, accessibility, the recipient's preference and your need for a record. If there is coercion or a safety concern, use a safer channel or appropriate support. For a routine written alternative, use [the email first-line guide](/guides/the-email-you-keep-not-sending-and-how-to-chase-a-reply).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How do I say no without sounding uncertain?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              State what you cannot or will not do in a complete sentence. Offer a reason or alternative only when it is true and useful. Avoid 'maybe' if the answer is no, but allow yourself time if you genuinely have not decided. Clarity does not require being abrupt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What if they become upset?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              You can acknowledge disappointment without withdrawing a genuine boundary. Listen if it is safe and useful, and pause or end the call if necessary. Upset does not prove your wording was wrong, but threats or abuse change the priority from good phrasing to safety.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Should I leave bad news in a voicemail?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Consider confidentiality, urgency and who might hear it. For sensitive everyday news, a neutral callback request may be more appropriate than detailed voicemail. Urgent or formal matters may require another procedure or channel. Do not delay a serious notification merely to follow a preferred communication style.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Scripts and preparation sequence are editorial examples, not empirically guaranteed techniques.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • No medical bad-news protocol or contract interpretation offered.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Official phone-call lead blocked; sources intentionally empty rather than falsely verified.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Quora blocked in saved research.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Start the email you keep not sending by writing what the recipient needs to do, know or decide. Add only the facts needed for that purpose, check the recipient and attachments, then send. Record a follow-up date based on the actual deadline or stated response time, not a universal rule about how many days politeness requires.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A draft can grow while the request remains missing. You add the history, soften the opening and explain the delay, but still have not asked for the appointment date or corrected invoice. Work on that sentence first. This guide covers ordinary correspondence, not formal service of notices, emergency reporting or legal submissions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Invented example: the ask comes before the history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A fictional customer needs an invoice corrected before submitting an expense claim on Friday. The subject is 'Invoice 482: please confirm corrected address by Thursday.' The first line is 'Please send a corrected invoice showing [correct address], or confirm what you need from me to amend it.' The customer then gives the invoice date and points to the incorrect field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The message does not include every earlier purchase or an accusation about why the mistake happened. It does include the real expense deadline as context, without pretending that the recipient has already agreed to Thursday. If the deadline is not feasible, the customer asks for an alternative plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Put the request, answer or decision near the start.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm the recipient is the right person or official reporting address.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Include a relevant reference and accurate dates without unnecessary personal information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Attach the intended file and check it is the correct version.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Distinguish a deadline you must meet from a response date you are requesting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Remove claims about motives, promises or earlier conversations you cannot support.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose a follow-up date and record where the sent message will be found.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Choose follow-up timing from the situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If the organization publishes a response period, use it as one input while also considering your own deadline. If someone promised an answer Tuesday, a check after that missed commitment may be appropriate. If there is no stated timeframe, choose a reasonable date for this specific task and record why. There is no single five-day or ten-day schedule for every message.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [BBC Office English discussion](https://downloads.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/office_english/240205_OfficeEnglish_ChasingPeople_Transcript_.pdf) offers examples of reminder language and increasing clarity. It is language guidance, not evidence that a particular phrase or channel produces faster replies. The scripts here are original starting points, not guaranteed persuasion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep follow-ups in the existing thread when useful so the recipient can see the request and evidence. Change channel if the published process, urgency or repeated delivery problem calls for it. A phone call is not automatically better: some matters require a portal or written notice to create the right record.

Can you confirm whether it reached the right team and when I should expect a response?

I have not received it. Please confirm the next step and revised expected date, or tell me what is still needed from me.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Know when not to wait for email
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Do not use ordinary email for an immediate safety issue or urgent medical concern. Use the appropriate urgent service or designated reporting route. For legal, contractual or complaint deadlines, verify the required method and do not assume a sent email satisfies it or pauses the deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Before adding another recipient, consider confidentiality and whether they actually own the next step. Avoid copying a wider group merely to create pressure. Keep the escalation factual: dates, request, responses and the outcome needed. If the situation is disputed or high-stakes, obtain suitable advice rather than escalating through increasingly forceful wording.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If sending itself remains difficult, save the request sentence as a first step and schedule a short return. For a consequential deadline, ask someone to help check the message now. Persistent difficulty handling messages may warrant broader support; one writing template cannot explain or treat its cause.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How long should I wait before chasing an email?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use the actual deadline, the recipient's stated response period and any promised date. When none exists, choose a proportionate check-back date for that task. Do not apply an etiquette rule that risks a real deadline, and do not assume repeated same-day reminders will help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I apologize for following up?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A routine follow-up does not need an apology just for existing. Acknowledge a delay you caused when relevant, then make the request clear. There is no useful apology quota; accuracy, proportion and the relationship matter more than counting how often you say sorry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if I receive another vague update?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask what concrete step remains, who owns it and when a response is expected. A date is useful planning information, not a guarantee. If the process is failing, check the official escalation route and keep the message history rather than endlessly rewriting the same request.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A first physical step is a specific action you can carry out and recognize as done: open the form, find the reference or write the question. It makes the starting point concrete. It is not a guarantee that a task becomes easy, and completing it is not the same as completing the obligation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 'Sort out the insurance' names a project but does not tell you what to do with your hands or screen. 'Find the renewal notice and read its date' supplies a starting point and useful information. Choose an example below that matches your barrier, then adapt it. These are everyday admin examples, not treatment or instructions for urgent situations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 3.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               • 4.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               • Write the exact question in one sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 5. Book a repair
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Find the equipment model label without dismantling or entering an unsafe area.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 11. Send an avoided email
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Type the request sentence before adding background.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 12. Follow up
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open the sent message and note its date and promised response.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 13. Decline an invitation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Draft the sentence saying you cannot attend, without sending yet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 14. Ask for help
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Write the exact part you need another person to do.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 15. Correct a misunderstanding
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Copy the factual sentence that needs correcting into a private draft.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Home and routine admin: five starting actions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • First physical step

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 16. Sort mail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open one item of your own mail and identify sender, action and date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 17. Return a purchase
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Find the order confirmation and check the return policy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 18. Resume a project
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open the last saved version and write where work stopped.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 19. Record maintenance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Place the latest invoice beside a blank log entry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 20. Check a subscription
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open its billing account and locate the renewal and cancellation terms.
