                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A four-day homeschool week puts planned instruction on four days and leaves another day for something else: a co-op, appointments, a project, or simply less rushing. It works only when the calendar, curriculum and your child's needs fit together. Four days across 36 weeks gives you 144 planned teaching days, not 180.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The schedule usually looks lovely on Sunday. By Wednesday, the experiment needs another afternoon, the library books are due, and someone needs a slower start. The point of a spare day is to leave room for life without quietly losing the work you meant to do.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This is a planning guide for US homeschool families, especially parents arranging elementary-level work. The examples are invented, not a curriculum, a grade-level recommendation or a legal compliance check. Older courses, credits, laboratory work and individual support needs may require a different rhythm. Your curriculum and current local requirements come first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Before you move Friday off the calendar
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check your current state or district requirements. Find out whether your situation requires days, hours, subjects, records or another measure. A lesson count is not an attendance record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Open the curriculum, not just the planner. Count the lessons or units remaining in each subject and read the publisher's pacing guidance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Decide what the spare day is for. If it is full of co-op classes, it is not also an empty recovery day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Try the rhythm for two weeks, then compare the plan with what actually happened. Keep evidence of learning as well as a tick beside a task.

No signup needed. It has room for your weekly rhythm, lesson calculation and a small record of what you actually covered.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A four-day homeschool schedule you can actually use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            intro
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            An invented elementary-level rhythm. These are learning blocks, not prescribed hours. Use the same sequence with different weekdays if the middle of your week needs to stay open.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Teaching day
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Steady practice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Longer block
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Day 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reading and maths at the child's current level
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Writing, then history or a read-aloud
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Day 2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reading and maths at the child's current level
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Science investigation, with time for setup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Day 3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reading and maths at the child's current level
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Writing, then history or geography
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Day 4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reading and maths at the child's current level
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Science follow-up, unfinished project, and a short review

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How many days should each homeschool subject get?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Start with what the course and the child need, not a rule that science gets two days and geography gets one. A reading programme may depend on frequent practice. A science course may need a long session plus time to write up the result. Those are different jobs, even when both occupy one square on a planner.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In the sample above, reading and maths recur on each teaching day. Writing and longer projects take turns in the remaining blocks. That is a shape to test, not evidence that those frequencies are enough for your child. Check the actual lesson sequence, revisit difficult work, and make room for support or practice outside this example when needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For several children, shared read-alouds or topics may help with logistics, but the pace and evidence still belong to each child. A completed family activity does not mean everyone learned the same thing. Use [checking whether learning stuck](/guides/how-to-check-if-your-child-learned-something) when the planner says done but you are not sure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Does a four-day homeschool week finish the curriculum?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            intro
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Run the calculation for one subject at a time. Lesson lengths vary, so this is a capacity check, not an instruction to double up difficult work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Planning question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Worked example
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many lessons remain?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 180 lessons, as an invented example
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many teaching weeks?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 36 weeks after breaks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • How many sessions per week for this subject?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 4 sessions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • At one lesson per session
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 36 × 4 = 144 lessons; 36 remain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Alternative pacing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • 180 ÷ 36 = 5 lessons per week; or 180 ÷ 4 = 45 teaching weeks at one lesson per session
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A 180-lesson course does not become a 144-lesson course because Friday disappears. You can use a curriculum designed for four days, add teaching weeks, arrange additional sessions if they are manageable, or adjust content with informed guidance. Which option works depends on the material and the child. Do not skip unfamiliar concepts just to make the calendar balance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • There are genuinely different publisher options. [Sonlight's four-day schedules](https://www.sonlight.com/pages/4-day) describe a 144-day programme with fewer books than its five-day option. [Beyond the Page's schedule guidance](https://www.beyondthepage.com/curriculum/schedule/) offers its own pacing choices. Those are examples to inspect, not endorsements or a guarantee that another course fits the same pattern.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Year-round schooling can create more teaching weeks, but it does not make missed lessons disappear. Count the weeks you will actually use after holidays, illness, appointments and other breaks. A plan that assumes every available day will go perfectly has already spent its spare time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            callout
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Lessons, days and hours are not interchangeable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            body
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Completing 180 lessons is not proof of 180 attendance days. Four sessions on one day are still on one calendar day. The calculator is arithmetic only: it does not decide what your state counts as instruction or confirm compliance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Can you homeschool four days a week and meet attendance rules?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Possibly, but not because a weekly layout says so. You need to check the current requirements that apply to your child and your route into homeschooling. If you are following a day-based requirement, a 36-week, four-day plan starts at 144 planned days. Any other qualifying instruction must actually happen and be recorded under the applicable rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For one official example, the [New York City home-school attendance calendar](https://www.schools.nyc.gov/docs/default-source/default-document-library/home-school-attendance-calendar.pdf) cites the substantial equivalent of 180 days. That is not a national standard, nor a complete explanation of New York requirements. Use the authority responsible for your situation; do not substitute a publisher's schedule or a social-media comment for the rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Our [days or hours guide](/guides/do-you-have-to-count-homeschool-days-or-hours) explains the questions to ask. Keep curriculum pacing and legal record keeping as two separate checks. Getting one right does not automatically settle the other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What to do when the four-day plan stops fitting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The spare day fills up
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              List what already happens on that day. Choose whether it is a class day, a project day or a recovery day. Stop assigning it all three jobs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A subject keeps slipping
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Check whether the block is too short, badly placed or asking for too much at once. Change one thing and review what happened, rather than adding a whole extra day immediately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              One day goes missing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Move the next unfinished lesson forward. Review deadlines and annual capacity, then choose what changes. Do not automatically squeeze an entire lost day into the next morning.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Keep a small record before you plan next week
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Plan: write the next lesson, task or question for each child. Use a page or unit reference you can find again.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Record: note what was actually completed and when, with a sample or observation where useful. Record required days or hours using the applicable rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Revisit: name what needs another try. A tick for completing a worksheet is not the same as evidence of understanding.
