                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The questions behind a four-day school week
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can a four-day homeschool week work for high school?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              It may, but this elementary-level example is not a high-school course plan. Check each course's workload, laboratory requirements, assessments and any credit or graduation requirements. Four days of scheduled meetings can still involve work at other times. Start from the course, not from the attractive empty Friday.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Does a co-op replace a subject at home?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Only if its actual teaching and expected work cover what your child needs for that subject. Ask what the co-op teaches, what is expected between meetings and how you will check progress. A meeting on the calendar does not automatically replace the rest of a course or count under local attendance rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Should the free day be Friday or Wednesday?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Choose around your real constraints. Friday can create a longer open block after four teaching days. Wednesday can break the week around appointments or a co-op. Neither fixes a lesson-capacity gap. Try the pattern, record what happened and move the day if the practical fit is poor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            15
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A week you can find again later
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You can run this on a sheet of paper. The [free worksheet](/guides/print/four-day-homeschool.html) gives you a weekly rhythm, a pacing check and somewhere to note what changed. Keep it with the records you already use rather than starting a second system you will have to maintain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If keeping each child's subjects and learning records straight is the part that keeps slipping, [Homeschooling Companion](/shop/homeschooling-companion) is an optional next step. It is a handbook and app for organising the work and records, not a curriculum. It does not choose what your child should learn or make a four-day plan legally sufficient. The schedule, calculator and worksheet here work without buying it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A spare day is useful when it gives the week room to hold. Keep the room. Just make sure the lessons and records have somewhere to go, too.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A homeschool notice of intent tells the responsible authority that you are establishing a home education program. Whether you need one, where it goes, when to send it and whether acknowledgement must come before withdrawal depend on your state and your chosen legal route. Do not copy another family's filing sequence without checking those details.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The difficult moment is often not filling in the form. It is deciding whether you can stop sending your child to their current school on Monday. This US guide helps you identify the correct paperwork and ask a precise question about that transition. It does not establish your eligibility or replace state-specific legal advice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Three documents with different jobs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Document
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Purpose
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • What to confirm
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Notice or declaration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Registers or notifies the home education arrangement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Correct authority, required contents, timing and renewal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Withdrawal record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Ends enrollment at the current school.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Permitted effective date and school process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Records request
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Obtains existing educational records.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Recipient, delivery method and what records are available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Start with the legal route, not a downloaded letter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • An online public school, a private umbrella arrangement and a parent-directed home education program may have different procedures. First identify what you are actually starting. Then use the current state education or responsible nonpublic-education agency page and the law it links to. A district form can be useful, but distinguish legally required information from optional requests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Florida provides one concrete example: its [home education statute](https://leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=1000-1099/1002/Sections/1002.41.html) requires a signed written notice to the district superintendent within 30 days of establishing the program, identifying enrolled children by full legal name, address and birthdate. That is a Florida home education rule, not permission to wait 30 days anywhere else.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • North Carolina illustrates why the order matters. Its [opening guidance](https://www.doa.nc.gov/divisions/non-public-education/home-schools/faqs/opening-closing-reopening) says an enrolled child should continue attending until home school registration is complete. It also describes one notice for the household, rather than a separate annual notice for every child. Neither example can be substituted for your own route.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Before you submit anything
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Write the state, county or district, child's age and legal education route at the top of your notes. Age and enrollment status can change the process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Locate the current official instructions and record the page address and date you read it. Follow its link to the applicable law where provided.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Copy the exact recipient, permitted submission method, required information and deadline. Identify whether a household or an individual child is registered.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Check the sequence explicitly: submission, acknowledgement or approval if applicable, withdrawal, and the first instructional day. Do not treat those as interchangeable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Ask whether you need a new filing after a move, another child, a program change or the next school year. Put each confirmed trigger in your calendar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Keep the completed submission and its receipt together. A blank form, a draft email and a successful portal submission are three different records.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example: a start date that changes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Invented example: Jordan plans a Friday withdrawal and a Monday home education start. On Tuesday, Jordan learns that the applicable registration process must be completed first. The family keeps the existing enrollment in place while confirming the sequence, saves the acknowledgement when it arrives, and agrees the withdrawal date with the school. The planned Monday date moves; the records show what actually happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The useful record is not a confident-looking letter dated before everything was ready. It is a short chain: instruction checked, notice submitted, acknowledgement retained where required, withdrawal confirmed, teaching begun. Keep each item with its actual date. Do not backdate a missing filing to make the sequence look complete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If you have already started or received conflicting advice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If you may have missed a required filing, contact the responsible office promptly with factual dates. Ask how to correct the record and whether any additional action is required. An unanswered search, a neighbor's experience or an informal assurance cannot establish that no notice is needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If there is a truancy warning, an existing custody order, a dispute about which state governs, or disagreement between official instructions and a demand you received, get state-specific help from legal aid or an education attorney. Keep the written notice and response deadline. Do not let a general organizing checklist delay a response.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Is a notice of intent the same as withdrawing from school?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No. The notice concerns the home education arrangement; withdrawal concerns existing enrollment. They may go to different offices and may have a required order. Ask both the responsible home education authority and the current school how the transition should be documented before setting the final attendance date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I write my own notice instead of using a form?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Possibly, but it depends on the applicable rule. Some routes specify required information without requiring a particular template; others use a portal or prescribed form. Check the official instructions before substituting a letter. Keep a copy of exactly what you submitted, not just a reusable template.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do I submit a notice every year?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                There is no national annual filing rule. Confirm whether your arrangement requires one initial notice, annual renewal, or updates after particular changes. Record the trigger as well as the date. A continuing registration does not necessarily remove separate testing, evaluation, instruction or record-keeping duties.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • You may need to count homeschool days, hours, either one, or a combination. The answer comes from the rules for your state and education route, not from a national school-year number. Finding no result in a search means the question is unresolved, not that you are exempt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A parent can keep a beautifully detailed hourly log and still miss a required day count. Another can spend evenings timing lessons their route does not require them to time. Before choosing a tracker, establish which measure matters and what evidence must accompany it. This is a US verification method, not a legal opinion about your family.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Different rules produce different records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pattern
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Verified example
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record implication
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Either days or hours
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Pennsylvania home education: 180 days OR 900 elementary/990 secondary hours.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Select the permitted measure and document it consistently.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Days with an hours condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Colorado nonpublic home-based program: at least 172 days averaging four instructional contact hours daily.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A tick for each date alone does not show the whole requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Unresolved lookup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • You cannot locate the applicable instructional-time provision.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Ask the responsible authority; do not record no requirement as a conclusion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Read the small connecting words
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In the [Pennsylvania guide](https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/education/documents/instruction/home-education-and-private-tutoring/home%20education%20and%20private%20tutoring%20guide.pdf), the alternatives are connected by "or." In the [Colorado law](https://www.cde.state.co.us/node/773), instructional days are combined with an average contact-hours condition. Turning either into a generic 180-day calendar loses information. These examples apply only to their described programs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check the age or grade range, school-year definition, part-year entry provisions and whether prior school attendance can be included. Do not automatically prorate a full-year figure when you withdraw midyear. Ask how the rule applies and retain the answer. Testing, subjects, portfolios and notice requirements remain separate questions.
