                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Identify the state, legal route and each child's relevant age or grade. Do not assume siblings necessarily have identical duties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Find the official instructional-time or attendance section. Search the law linked by the agency as well as its overview page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write the exact measure: days, hours, either, or combined. Include any minimum, average or definition the rule uses.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Confirm what activities may count, how shared teaching is recorded and whether travel, independent work or outside classes need additional evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Find out whether the record is retained, submitted or reviewed and by whom. A required count is not necessarily a required monthly filing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep the rule, URL, checked date and any written clarification beside the log. Review after a move or change of route.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: why the same calendar can mislead
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Invented example: Avery marks 172 dates on a calendar and assumes the number alone proves compliance. On rereading the applicable Colorado provision, Avery sees the average instructional contact-hours condition. The family keeps the date record but adds actual qualifying time and activity notes, then asks the responsible office how to handle a previously incomplete period.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The correction is not to manufacture four hours on every old date. It is to distinguish existing evidence, reasonably reconstructed information and unknown time. A log that identifies its limits is more useful than a total no one can explain. If a submission is already due, ask for help with that situation before spending days redesigning the log.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Count actual participation, not planned lessons
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use your schedule to plan and your log to record what happened. A canceled class does not become completed instruction because it remained on the calendar. For a shared field trip, identify each participating child rather than adding the outing to a household total that cannot be separated later.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • An hour cannot be counted twice for the same child merely because an activity touches two subjects. How an interdisciplinary activity is categorized and what time qualifies are questions for the applicable rules. Keep your description factual rather than adjusting it to reach a target. For an ongoing routine, [homeschool attendance records](/guides/homeschool-attendance-what-to-track) addresses the day-to-day record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When to stop guessing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask for written clarification if an agency overview conflicts with the statute, your child begins midyear, you are switching routes, or an evaluator requests something you cannot trace to the applicable requirements. Where legal compliance or a truancy concern is at stake, contact qualified state-specific help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A voluntary count can still help you plan when no count applies. Label it as your planning tool rather than a compliance measure. Do not turn a private target into a claim that you have met every education duty. Record quality and educational progress are related to, but not the same as, time totals.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does a homeschool day have to last a set number of hours?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    That depends on the applicable rule. A day-count requirement may have a duration condition, an averaging condition, or no separately stated hourly measure. Colorado is one example combining days and average contact hours. Read the actual definition rather than assuming that any short activity creates a qualifying school day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I choose hours instead of days?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Only if your route permits that alternative. Pennsylvania home education provides an either-or example, but it does not establish a choice elsewhere. Record which option you are using and what evidence supports it. Do not switch measures simply to make an incomplete record appear to reach a target.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if I did not track time from the start?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Keep the records you do have, such as dated work, calendars and class confirmations. Label reconstructed entries and uncertainty rather than inventing precision. Ask the responsible authority or a qualified adviser how to address a missing required record, especially if a filing or review deadline is close.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Start homeschooling by confirming the legal route and start conditions for your child, completing required filings in the correct order, documenting withdrawal if enrolled, and keeping an actual instruction record from the start. Do not assume withdrawal always comes before notice or acknowledgement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • When the decision has been made, the temptation is to order everything at once: books, planner, printer and folders. The paperwork has a smaller job. It should make the transition traceable and prevent a missed obligation while you work out how teaching will look. This US guide focuses on that first month, not curriculum selection or a guarantee of legal compliance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Build the transition file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write down your state, child's age, present enrollment and chosen education route. Confirm which authority handles that route.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Read its official start requirements, including subjects, instructional time, notice, qualifications and assessment obligations where applicable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm what must happen before withdrawal. Save any required acknowledgement and the school's withdrawal confirmation with their actual dates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Request useful existing records through the school's accepted process: report cards, transcript, assessments and relevant support or health documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Create one place for submissions and another for actual learning evidence. Start with dated entries rather than a blank annual portfolio.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • List each confirmed future obligation with its trigger, due date, recipient and evidence needed. Do not rely on a generic school-year calendar.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The order must fit your state
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [North Carolina's official guidance](https://www.doa.nc.gov/divisions/non-public-education/home-schools/faqs/opening-closing-reopening) instructs families to continue current attendance until the registration process is complete. That is why a national checklist cannot safely say "withdraw, then file." Other routes differ. Ask the specific sequence question before agreeing a final attendance date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use the school's accepted withdrawal and records-request channels. That may be a portal, form, email or letter, not necessarily two hand-delivered letters. Withdrawal and a records request do different jobs even when one message addresses both. Retain evidence that each request was received.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Confirmed route and filing sequence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Check any required acknowledgement or approval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • At withdrawal
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Effective date and records-request receipt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Clarify anything outstanding with the school.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • First teaching days
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Dated activities and child-specific evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Cover applicable instruction duties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • First review
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Missing-record list and forward calendar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Resolve unknown obligations rather than assuming none.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Example: a workable first file
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Invented example: Morgan is moving a nine-year-old from school to parent-directed home education. Morgan creates a folder called Transition, saves the official instructions and submits the required registration. Only after confirming the permitted sequence does Morgan finalize withdrawal. A records request asks for the last report, assessment information and existing support documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The first learning entry is specific: November 18, fractions, compared halves and quarters using paper shapes; explained equivalence with prompting. It is evidence of that activity, not a claim that every subject or requirement has been satisfied. The family adds other mandated subjects and starts the relevant attendance measure immediately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not postpone support arrangements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If your child has an IEP, disability-related services or an evaluation underway, ask how changing education routes affects those arrangements before withdrawing. Do not assume services transfer unchanged or automatically disappear. Keep the current documents and the contact for the responsible office.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a custody order or agreement governs education decisions, resolve the authority question before changing enrollment. If you receive an attendance warning or a filing rejection, seek state-specific legal or administrative help promptly. A later portfolio cannot by itself repair an unmet start condition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        School records

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Please confirm the withdrawal process and send the available report cards, assessments and relevant support records. Which request channel should I use, and how will I know it has been received?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Unclear annual obligation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For this legal route and my child's age, what record or assessment is required after we start? Please point me to the current published instructions and the date trigger.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep the first system deliberately small
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use a folder, notebook or spreadsheet you can open after a busy teaching day. Record actual work, not just planned lessons. Where required, keep the appropriate time or day measure alongside it. [Multiple-child record keeping](/guides/homeschool-record-keeping-for-multiple-children) explains how to avoid mixing siblings' evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • An adjustment period may be useful for your family, but there is no universal month-per-year deschooling formula. A lighter routine still needs to meet applicable duties. Buy materials when you can identify the need they serve, rather than using purchases as proof that the transition is complete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I start homeschooling tomorrow?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Only if the applicable start conditions are met. Check the route, age rules, required filings and withdrawal sequence first. If acknowledgement or another condition is outstanding, do not assume a planned start date overrides it. Ask the responsible office how to handle an urgent transition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do I need a complete curriculum before the first day?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        You need a workable way to provide whatever instruction your route requires. That is not necessarily a large boxed curriculum. Check mandated subjects and your child's needs, choose appropriate materials, and record what happens. A notebook alone is an organizing tool, not an education program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if the school records have not arrived?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep the request receipt and follow up through the school's published process. Ask which records are available and who handles the request rather than inventing a national response deadline. Work from the information you have while avoiding guesses about past achievement or support arrangements.
