                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep homeschool evidence attributable to each child. You can use separate notebooks or one master log with child identifiers and child-specific exports. Shared teaching does not require duplicated typing, but a household entry must show who participated and what each child actually did.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At the end of a shared science morning, "we did plants" may feel sufficient. Months later, it does not show whether both children participated or whether one drew a diagram while the other wrote an explanation. This guide helps organize those differences without turning a shared lesson into twice the administrative work. State-specific requirements still determine what must be retained or submitted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example: one event, two different records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Those rows are an invented example, not a developmental benchmark. Maya and Leo share the activity description but not the observation. Watching quietly, asking for more and enjoying the lesson describe engagement; they do not establish understanding. A short response, demonstration or work sample gives the entry more useful detail.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A master log can store the shared event once and link each child's participation and observation to it. When you filter or export Maya's record, the event must still make sense without Leo's page. If your paper system cannot do that easily, separate pages may be simpler.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Choose a consistent child identifier, usually a name, and put it on every loose work sample before it joins the pile.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Create a folder or filter for each child and school year. Keep shared resources in a household folder rather than copying every source file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For each shared event, identify actual participants. Add a child-specific response where useful instead of assuming the same outcome for everyone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep attendance or time data separate enough to meet each child's applicable requirement. Do not count a sibling who was not present.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • File sensitive notes with restricted access. Include only what belongs in the record you intend to hand to an evaluator or school.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Test a child-only export or assemble one child's paper file now. Fix missing labels before the year becomes difficult to untangle.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Separate outcomes, not necessarily every input
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The [Pennsylvania home education guide](https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/education/documents/instruction/home-education-and-private-tutoring/home%20education%20and%20private%20tutoring%20guide.pdf) provides a jurisdiction-specific example of a portfolio containing a log and work samples developed or used by the student. It does not establish that every household must maintain physically separate binders. The useful organizing principle is that a reader can identify the student and the supporting evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Twins may use the same curriculum and still need different notes. A child in public school may need a lighter home file than a homeschooled sibling. Equal page counts are not the goal, and easy or difficult ratings are not a ranking between children.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Four checks test whether a household log can produce a clear, private record for one child.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Test the output before you rely on the archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Make the weekly review a file test
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • At a review, choose one shared entry and ask: could I explain this child's work from this record alone? Then choose a loose sheet and check that its name, date and context are present. Correct the file while the memory is fresh.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check any app's export coverage, entry limits and backup process before using it as your only archive. An attractive household dashboard does not prove that a complete child-specific record can be produced. Save and inspect exports periodically, particularly during a busy year. The general [record-keeping template](/guides/homeschool-record-keeping-template) can supply the underlying daily columns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ask an evaluator about the output
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For before compiling the year, you could say: "I keep one master log with each participating child identified. Would a child-filtered record with that child's dated work samples meet the format you need? Please distinguish required evidence from your preferred presentation."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          If the records are already mixed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Start with a small recent period and sort confidently identified work first. Do not assign an anonymous worksheet to a child because it looks like their handwriting unless you label that uncertainty. Shared photographs may establish participation but not who completed each task.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Seek local guidance if a required report is imminent, a child's evidence cannot be reconstructed, or you are unsure what must be disclosed. Keep incomplete information separate from confirmed entries. Fixing labels prospectively is useful even if earlier gaps remain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Do I need a different binder for every child?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Not necessarily. Separate binders are one practical choice, but a master system with reliable child-specific records can also work. Confirm the required output for your route. The test is whether each child's evidence can be identified and presented without another sibling's private or unrelated information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Can I log a field trip once for the whole family?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            You can enter the shared event once if your system also identifies each participating child and preserves that context in individual records. Add different observations or work references where appropriate. A family outing title alone should not be mistaken for proof that every child completed the same instruction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What if one child has far fewer entries?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Look first at what happened, what is required and whether entries were missed. Different ages, programs or activities can produce different records. Do not add invented entries to equalize the totals. If the difference reflects a learning or instruction concern, address that concern separately from the filing system.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Pennsylvania is an example of student-specific portfolio evidence, not a national format rule. No app capacity or export feature was assumed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Saved search leads were reviewed for reader language only, not authority or prevalence. Quora was blocked in saved research. No search-volume or ranking estimate is available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A useful homeschool reading log records the title, date or date range, and whether the book is in progress, finished or stopped. Add the author to identify the book reliably. Where the log supports a review, an optional format and assistance note helps distinguish independent reading, shared reading and listening.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The book you remember vividly is easy to log. The library book returned half-finished, the reread and the audiobook heard in the car are easier to lose. A small record can include all of them without turning reading into a daily paperwork test. This is a practical format, not a national portfolio requirement or a measure of reading ability.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What the example can and cannot show
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The entries are invented examples. They identify what was used and how, but do not prove decoding skill, comprehension or time spent. The incomplete author entry is a reminder to check the borrowing record, not a model of perfect documentation. Do not invent a detail just to fill a column.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A completed book may have been enjoyed, skimmed, difficult or read with substantial help. Keep the factual status separate from judgments about understanding. If you want to examine learning, use a short conversation or another appropriate activity and record that evidence separately. [Checking what a child learned](/guides/how-to-check-if-your-child-learned-something) addresses that different job.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Start a log you can continue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Choose one place for this child's reading record: a notebook page, spreadsheet or simple document. Avoid parallel lists that disagree.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Write the title and author when the book starts or enters regular use. Mark an approximate start date as approximate if necessary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Use plain status words: in progress, finished, stopped or reread. Keep stopped books rather than silently deleting the entry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Add a format or support tag when it matters: independent print, shared print, adult read-aloud or audiobook. Include accessibility formats without treating them as lesser participation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Check any state, evaluator or course requirements before omitting fields such as dates, pages or minutes. A low-burden default cannot override a requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Review the list against the current book stack and library history occasionally. Resolve a few missing titles while they are still recoverable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Keep compliance questions separate from preferences
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The [Pennsylvania home education guide](https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/education/documents/instruction/home-education-and-private-tutoring/home%20education%20and%20private%20tutoring%20guide.pdf) requires a contemporaneous log naming reading materials used as part of its portfolio provisions. That supports keeping identifiable titles in that setting; it does not make this article's columns sufficient everywhere. Check your own route before deciding the log is complete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A reading program may request minutes, a particular response or pages completed. You can add those fields for that purpose. Ratings, stickers and cover images are optional preferences unless a specific program requires them. Keep them only if they serve the child or the reporting job, rather than because a template includes them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              How to handle books that do not fit neatly
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For anthologies or short selections, identify the collection and the particular piece where that is useful. For reference books consulted repeatedly, record the relevant dates or topic rather than pretending the whole book was read. For a reread, add a new date range or a clearly marked repeat entry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If several children listen to one read-aloud, one household event can link to each participating child's record. Keep an individual response only when you actually observed one. Do not copy a sibling's comment as evidence for everyone. A format tag tells a later reader what the activity involved without excluding listening or shared reading.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              When the log reveals a concern
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Repeatedly stopping books may reflect choice, access, interest or difficulty; the log alone cannot tell you which. Ask the child what is getting in the way. Check whether print size, language, format or the material itself is a mismatch before interpreting the pattern as unwillingness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Seek appropriate educational or clinical advice when there is a persistent difficulty, distress, or a sudden change in reading access or performance. Do not diagnose from a completion tally. Keep dated examples of what the child could do and what help was needed so the conversation is specific.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Should I include audiobooks?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes, if you want a record of materials used, and where permitted for the particular reporting purpose. Mark the format so listening comprehension is not confused with independent print decoding. The same title can support different activities, so describe what actually happened rather than assigning a general ability label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do stopped books belong on the log?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                They can. Mark stopped and the date or approximate range, without inventing a reason. That preserves the record of materials used and may help you discuss choices later. A stopped book is not by itself evidence of poor motivation or a reading problem.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do I need pages and minutes?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Add them if the applicable rules, evaluator, course or your own useful purpose calls for them. Otherwise they can be optional. Do not assume every reviewer wants the same format, and do not reconstruct precise minutes from memory merely to make a reading log look more complete.
