                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When a homeschool subject is not working, first describe the difficulty precisely, ask the child what is hard, and check for an obvious access or placement mismatch. Then try one relevant change and compare what happens across actual sessions. You do not have to work through a mandatory sequence before changing unsuitable materials or seeking help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A lesson can fail for several different reasons: the child understands but cannot sustain the volume, the instructions are unclear, a prerequisite is missing, or the resource is inaccessible. Buying another book without identifying the problem may simply move it. This guide offers an editorial troubleshooting method, not a diagnostic test or a proven order for every age and subject.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Match the change to the observation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What you see
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A possible check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • One change to try
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Accurate work followed by exhaustion
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Amount or timing may be difficult.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Shorten the session or move it, not both initially.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Same error from the first problem
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check prerequisite understanding and instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Model a smaller step and ask for an explanation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Can explain aloud but written work breaks down
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check the writing or access demand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Allow an appropriate alternative response format.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Material is clearly inaccessible or wrongly placed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check publisher placement and access options.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Change the resource or level directly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Run a small, observable trial
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Name the exact task that is breaking down. "Cannot explain why these fractions are equal" is more useful than "bad at math."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask the child to show where they get lost. Separate not understanding instructions from not understanding the subject.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check obvious access needs, resource placement and prerequisites. Do not insist on a timing experiment when the material is clearly wrong for the child.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose one change with a reason. Write what you expect to observe, such as fewer prompts or a clearer explanation, not just a happier session.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose a manageable number of actual sessions and a review date. This is a practical trial length, not an evidence-based threshold.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record the task, help provided, response and next decision. Keep what worked, adapt it, change materials or ask for outside help.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: division without changing everything
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Invented example: Nia completes long-division steps with reminders but repeatedly confuses the place value of the quotient. Her parent stops treating the issue as a fifteen-problem endurance test. The trial uses a few carefully chosen problems, a worked model and a place-value representation. The parent records which step still needs prompting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • After several actual sessions, Nia is more comfortable but still cannot explain the quotient position independently. That is useful information, not proof the problem is solved. The next step is targeted teaching or advice about that concept, rather than restoring the original volume because the argument has stopped.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use evidence without overstating it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The [IES elementary mathematics intervention guide](https://ies.ed.gov/ncee/wwc/PracticeGuide/26) supports systematic instruction, clear mathematical language and well-chosen representations for struggling mathematics learners. It does not establish that every homeschool difficulty should be addressed by changing time, then quantity, then prerequisites in that order.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • That distinction matters outside mathematics too. A spelling problem, inaccessible reading text and unsuitable science resource need different questions. Use the curriculum's scope and placement information where relevant, and seek subject-specific teaching advice rather than treating this table as a universal intervention.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ask for targeted help
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Tutor or teacher
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Here is the task, the repeated error and the support I tried. Could you help identify the prerequisite or explanation we should work on next?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Child conversation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Show me the first point where this stops making sense. Is the difficult part understanding it, remembering the steps, writing the answer or keeping going?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What counts as improvement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose a sign tied to the original problem. Independent explanation, a successful demonstration with less support, or a more accurate response to a comparable task can be informative. One easier worksheet does not necessarily show the same skill, so note when task difficulty changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Enjoyment and willingness matter, but keep them separate from understanding. A child may enjoy a new activity while the underlying concept remains uncertain. [Checking learning](/guides/how-to-check-if-your-child-learned-something) can help frame that separate question. A short before-and-after note is more useful than a general easy or difficult rating alone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Do not make help the last resort
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Persistent difficulty, significant distress, sudden change or suspected vision, hearing or other access concerns justify appropriate professional advice without finishing every experiment. A qualified teacher, tutor, evaluator or clinician can address different parts of the problem. This record helps explain your observations; it does not diagnose a condition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If replacing materials is the sensible response, keep the last completed topic and the first intended topic in the new resource. Check gaps and overlap. You do not need to restart an entire subject simply because the cover or publisher changed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How long should I try a change?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Choose a review point based on actual sessions, your schedule and the concern. No universal week or session count fits every learner. Record enough comparable observations to make a useful decision, but seek help promptly for significant distress or access concerns rather than waiting for an arbitrary trial to end.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should I change the curriculum first?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You can if there is an obvious resource, access or placement mismatch. Otherwise, a smaller targeted change may help reveal what is wrong before a larger purchase. The important step is identifying the problem, not proving that you have exhausted every cheaper option in a prescribed order.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if the child says they hate the whole subject?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Take that statement seriously and ask what happens during the work. It could involve difficulty, workload, access, interest or the interaction around teaching. Do not assume a hidden prerequisite is always the cause. Keep the conversation specific and seek additional support if distress persists.

Quora was blocked in saved research. No search-volume or ranking estimate is available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A life admin binder should tell a trusted person who to contact, what needs attention and where the supporting documents are kept. Start with a current contact page, a document-location index, essential household arrangements and a review date. Treat it as a map to information, not a substitute for signed legal documents or authorized account access.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The binder becomes useful when someone other than you can answer a practical question from it: who collects the children tonight, where the insurance policy is, or which bill needs attention. This guide covers that emergency handoff, primarily in a US context. A household planner for cleaning, meals and maintenance is a different tool.
