                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Eight sections with a specific job
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Useful contents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Keep separately
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Contacts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • First call, backup, professional contacts and each person's role.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Unnecessary private details about other people.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Documents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Location of will, ID, directives and authority documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Originals needing secure storage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Money administration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Institutions, essential bills, payment method and whom to ask.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Full account numbers and authentication secrets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Home
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Occupancy details, insurer, utilities and spare-key contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Entry codes on a widely shared page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Dependents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Agreed caregivers, school and routine information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Sensitive records not needed by the recipient.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Animals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Caregiver, vet, feeding information and records location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Old medication instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Devices and accounts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Provider names and approved recovery or access arrangements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Passwords and recovery codes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Preferences and business
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Relevant wishes, document locations and continuity contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Confidential client files or unsupported legal wording.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Build the first usable version
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Write the first call and a backup, ask their agreement and check how they can be reached without your phone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • List essential document locations precisely enough to find them. Mark missing, unsigned or outdated documents honestly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Separate finding information from acting on it. Record who has verified authority, what document supports that role and where it is held.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Identify practical tasks for the first day and the next two weeks: dependents, animals, housing, employer and essential payments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Keep access secrets in a separate protected arrangement, and explain how the authorized person learns the approved access process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Walk one trusted person through the binder, then record the review date and the event that should trigger the next update.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Four binder layers distinguish contact details, document locations, formal authority and practical actions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A name on a page does not grant permission to transact.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Example: an entry that can be acted on
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Invented example: a binder says, "Home: rented apartment. Manager contact on the lease cover page in the desk file. Backup key held by my sister, who has agreed to help. Rent payment schedule is in the bill list. Bank authority still to be arranged." That final sentence matters: it prevents an organizing note from looking like permission to transact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Compare "my sister handles everything." It does not say whether she has agreed, has a working key, knows which institution to call or can legally act. A useful entry can be short while still exposing unfinished arrangements. Put a named next action beside a gap rather than hiding it behind confident wording.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Where copies belong
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • An index-only binder reduces what is exposed if someone sees it. A more restricted emergency file may appropriately contain selected copies, such as a signed advance directive. Choose the contents according to who will receive it and why. "Never include any document copies" is not a universal rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The [National Institute on Aging](https://www.nia.nih.gov/health/advance-care-planning/choosing-health-care-proxy?form=MG0AV3) recommends sharing signed health care documents with the proxy and care team. A binder entry can identify those copies and the current version; it does not make a person your legally appointed agent. Witnessing and execution rules must be checked for your jurisdiction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Four steps build a usable emergency binder from contacts through documents, essential tasks and a handoff test.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A short tested file is more useful than an unexplained collection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep the secure layer separate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Do not put passwords, recovery codes, full financial identifiers or a safe combination in an ordinary handoff binder. A document-location map is still sensitive, so store it privately and share deliberately. For digital copies, consider both access control and whether the intended person can reach them during an outage or device loss.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The [FDIC storage guide](https://catalog.fdic.gov/catalog/sfc/servlet.shepherd/document/download/069t000000BciamAAB) distinguishes documents needed quickly from items suitable for a safe deposit box. Ask an attorney where an original will should be held rather than keeping the only route to essential papers inside a box no one can readily access.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Test the binder without sharing secrets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For handoff test, you could say: "If I could not answer for two weeks, could you find the current contact page, identify what needs attention and tell where the supporting papers are? Please mark anything that depends on information only I know."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When the binder is not enough
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Pause and get qualified help where the gap concerns legal authority, contested guardianship, a disputed will, benefits, a business duty or someone pressuring you to grant access. Do not add someone to an account simply to make the binder feel finished. The right arrangement depends on your circumstances and its risks.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If coercion, estrangement or a safety concern affects who can enter the home or see information, limit distribution and ask an appropriate professional about secure planning. A family relationship is not itself a reason to share every section. You can provide a task-specific handoff rather than the entire file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Maintain it by changes, not page count
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Review after a move, new dependent, job change, separation, death of a named helper or change of document storage. An occasional scheduled review is also useful, but it is an organizing choice rather than a legal requirement. Put the checked date on the contact page and retire obsolete copies when an arrangement changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • [Personal Life Affairs Companion](/shop/personal-life-affairs-companion) is an optional way to record locations and produce a handoff book. The published listing explicitly excludes password storage and legal-document drafting. The paper structure above works without a purchase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Should a life admin binder contain original documents?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Not automatically. Use the binder to identify originals and their secure locations. Include selected copies only where the recipient needs them and privacy is appropriate. Ask a qualified adviser about original wills and other legally important papers; ordinary emergency access and secure long-term storage are different concerns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is writing someone's name enough to authorize them?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. An emergency contact, a proposed caregiver and a legally appointed agent are different roles. Record the actual status and supporting document, including anything not yet arranged. If the intended helper needs to make transactions or decisions, confirm the appropriate authority with the relevant institution or qualified adviser.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          How much do I need to finish before sharing it?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Share a useful first version once the recipient and privacy boundaries are clear. Contacts, immediate responsibilities and document locations can already help. Mark unknowns and uncompleted arrangements explicitly, date the file, and agree how the recipient will know when an updated version replaces it.
