                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Open the conversation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Asking the person
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Would you be willing to speak for my medical wishes if I could not? I want someone who can ask questions and represent what matters to me, even if their own choice would be different. You do not need to answer today.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Checking the care record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Please confirm who is recorded as my emergency contact and who is recorded as my health care agent. Where should I provide the signed document, and how can we check the current version is on file?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example: contact and proxy are different people
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Invented example: Elena wants her nearby brother called immediately because he can secure the house. She chooses a longtime friend as health care agent because they have discussed her priorities carefully. Her brother knows that being the first contact does not itself make him the appointed agent. The record identifies the friend, the alternate, the document date and where copies are held.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • That arrangement still needs proper execution under the applicable law. Elena's contact page does not turn an unsigned intention into an appointment. She also asks the care team how it will identify and contact the agent if needed, rather than assuming a document stored at home will be discovered automatically.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Four steps make a proxy choice practical through agreement, discussion, correct paperwork and shared copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Choosing a name is only the first part of the arrangement.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Discuss values without inventing medical instructions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • You can start by explaining what makes life meaningful, what worries you and whom you want involved in discussion. Ask your clinician to explain medical terminology or likely decisions if you have a specific condition. A proxy conversation should not depend on guessing treatment outcomes from a general article.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Keep the conversation open as circumstances change. A person can remember your priorities better when they understand the reasoning, not just a list of unfamiliar treatment names. Written instructions and an agent may complement each other, but their scope and legal effect depend on the applicable documents and law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If you have not appointed anyone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Do not assume the emergency-contact field settles who decides. Default surrogate rules vary, and a hospital may need to establish the appropriate decision maker under local law. Ask the care team or patient advocate how that works in the actual situation. This guide deliberately does not publish a national priority ladder or a supposedly current list of states without one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If you remain able to make your own decisions, ask how to complete the appropriate planning documents correctly. If someone already lacks the relevant decision-making ability, do not try to solve the situation by having a relative sign a new appointment for them. Ask the clinical team and an appropriate legal adviser what process applies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              When to get specific help
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Seek advice for conflicting documents, family dispute, coercion, a move or regular care in multiple states, uncertainty about eligibility, or difficulty communicating wishes. A qualified attorney or legal aid service can address execution and authority; the treating team can address clinical questions. The boundaries overlap but are not interchangeable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • After changing the agent or instructions, tell the relevant people and providers and follow the proper process for replacing or revoking old documents. Label copies with their dates. An old copy circulating in a family group chat can create confusion even when a new form has been correctly signed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Keep the practical record separate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • On your emergency page, write the agent's name, contact, alternate, document date and location. Mark whether the discussion has happened and whether copies have been shared. Avoid writing "all sorted" if you have only chosen a name.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For the broader household file, [the hospital handoff guide](/guides/hospital-for-two-weeks-what-would-someone-need-to-find) covers bills, dependents and access. Those arrangements do not follow automatically from appointing a health care proxy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can my emergency contact also be my proxy?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Yes, the same person may fill both roles if eligible and appropriately appointed, but the emergency-contact label alone does not create the appointment. Record both roles explicitly and complete the relevant document. Ask the provider to confirm that the contact information and signed authority document are both on file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Does a proxy decide while I can still decide?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Your own decision-making remains central. When an agent may act depends on the governing document, law and applicable clinical determination, so ask how your form works. Do not treat a general article as a substitute for understanding the activation conditions in the document you actually signed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What if I cannot choose between two people?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Consider who can best represent your wishes and handle the practical work, then ask about an alternate arrangement permitted by your form. Do not assume naming multiple equal decision makers makes disagreements easier. Discuss any uncertainty with a qualified adviser before creating documents that might conflict.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose a willing person to raise your children, identify a backup, and have the nomination documented correctly for your jurisdiction. Also arrange who would help immediately if neither parent could be reached. A nomination is not an automatic custody transfer, and a practical care note does not replace the legal process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The difficult question is often not who loves the children most. It is who could realistically provide daily care, maintain important relationships and take on the responsibility over years. This US planning checklist helps prepare that decision and the conversation with a lawyer. It cannot determine custody, override another parent's rights or guarantee a court's choice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Work through the guardian decision
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Consider the child's existing relationships, stability, cultural and language connections, support needs and the effect of moving.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Assess the proposed caregiver's willingness and practical capacity, not just their finances or family position. Ask how the change affects their household.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Discuss siblings explicitly: whether they could remain together, what space is available and what support would be needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask the first choice and backup separately, explain the role and allow time for a considered answer. Do not record silence as agreement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Take the choice and any custody documents to a qualified adviser. Confirm how to nominate someone and how the actual appointment would work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Prepare an immediate-care plan and a short routine note. Review the arrangement after family, health, residence or relationship changes.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Four distinct planning jobs cover immediate care, guardian nomination, court appointment and inherited funds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A practical helper, nominated guardian and money manager may be different people.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Nomination and appointment are different
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [California Courts](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/guardianship) provides a clear state example: guardianship of the person involves a court order giving an adult responsibility for a child's care and legal decisions. Its [statutory will form](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2026-02/6240-Statutory-will-form.pdf) includes a parental nomination. These are related steps, not interchangeable ones, and California's form is not a national template.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not assume that writing a name means a court will "almost always" approve it. Parental rights, applicable standards, objections, eligibility and the child's situation matter. A surviving parent's role must be addressed under the applicable law, not treated as displaced by another parent's preference in a binder.
