                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Three jobs that need separate answers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Job
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Planning question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Evidence to keep
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Immediate care
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Who can reach and care for the children tonight?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Agreed contact, pickup arrangements and locally appropriate authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Longer-term upbringing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Who would you nominate if a guardian is needed?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Proper legal nomination and location of the document.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Managing inherited money
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Who would manage funds for the child and on what terms?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Relevant estate-plan documents and professional contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: two people doing different jobs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Invented example: two parents prefer a sister who lives several hours away as their long-term nominee. A nearby friend agrees to collect the children in an emergency through the school's approved pickup process. A backup nominee is asked too. The parents discuss legal documentation with an attorney instead of assuming the pickup permission appoints a guardian.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The sister would not necessarily manage inherited funds. That question is considered separately, with advice about the appropriate arrangement. The care page records school contacts, allergies and current care-plan locations, while financial and legal documents remain securely held. It does not contain improvised medical instructions or a promise that the sister will receive custody automatically.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ask about daily life, not an idealized role
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Discuss where the children would live, school changes, existing support, sibling relationships and contact with important adults. Ask what resources would make the arrangement feasible. A person can be loving and still unable to take several children, manage specialist needs or relocate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Avoid turning age, income or marital status into a single deciding score. The practical question is capacity for this child in this family. Where appropriate, seek professional guidance on considering the child's views without making them feel responsible for an adult legal decision.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Four steps connect a guardian preference to agreement, legal documentation and review of practical capacity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A recorded name needs agreement, proper documentation and a workable supporting plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Give the person room to answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    First choice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If a guardian were needed for the children, would you consider being our first choice? We want to discuss what it would involve, including school, housing and support. Please take time; an honest no is useful information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Backup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Would you consider serving as the backup if our first choice could not? We would like you to know the practical plan and the document location, not just appear as a name on a page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Cover a short absence separately
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A work trip, hospital admission or temporary inability to collect a child may call for a different authorization than full guardianship. Ask the school, clinician and a qualified local adviser what permissions are required for the actual task. Do not assume school pickup authority includes medical consent or custody.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep an emergency contact list where the appropriate people can use it. Make sure the first responder to the practical problem knows who is expected to help next. If there is no safe adult available now, use appropriate emergency or child-welfare support rather than waiting to finish an estate-planning checklist.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When legal advice should come first
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Get specific advice for co-parent disagreement, existing custody orders, family violence, interstate or international placements, tribal-law issues, significant disability-related needs or disputed parental capacity. Do not use this checklist to persuade a school to ignore a custody order or to remove a child across a jurisdictional boundary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Where parents disagree, document questions and concerns for counsel rather than assuming competing private nominations will settle the conflict. If someone is pressuring you to sign, pause and seek independent help. A plan intended to protect a child should not be built on hidden disagreement about legal authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keep the supporting note practical
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A routine note can explain school, transport, important relationships, current health-plan locations, food needs and what helps the child through unfamiliar days. Keep sensitive information limited to those who need it. Date the note and distinguish a settled arrangement from a preference still being discussed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Review the nominee's willingness after a major change. A conversation from years ago does not establish present capacity. Tell the relevant people where current documents are held and who can explain them. Do not distribute multiple unsigned drafts as if they are operative instructions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does naming a guardian in a will automatically give custody?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No. A nomination records your choice, but the applicable court and legal process determine appointment when needed. Another parent's rights and the child's circumstances still matter. Ask a qualified adviser how your jurisdiction treats nominations and what additional emergency-care arrangements are appropriate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should the guardian also manage inherited money?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Not necessarily. Daily caregiving and managing property are different responsibilities. They may be handled by the same person or through separate arrangements, depending on the plan and law. Discuss the options with an estate-planning professional rather than assuming a care nomination also settles every financial question.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if nobody can agree to take the children?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do not invent a settled choice. Identify trusted adults, discuss realistic support and ask a qualified adviser about available planning options. Make an immediate-care plan where possible and record the unresolved long-term question. If children lack safe care now, address that urgent situation through appropriate local services.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • After a death, first notify the people needed for immediate care and practical arrangements, confirm Social Security reporting where relevant, and identify benefits, insurance or household services that need prompt attention. Then work through institutions using a notification log. There is no universal rule that every bank or utility can safely wait a week.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The same news has to be repeated to people who ask different questions. A short record of whom you contacted, what they require and what happens next can prevent repeated calls. This guide focuses on US notifications, not the full probate process. Local deadlines and the person's circumstances may change the order.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Start with a manageable notification pass
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Tell close family and the people responsible for children, dependents, animals or an unattended home. Delegate personal messages if helpful.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask the funeral director whether the death has been reported to Social Security, if relevant. Record who is reporting and what remains to be done.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Identify active benefits, pension, employer and insurance contacts. Ask about ongoing payments, survivor options and any deadlines that apply.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Contact financial institutions through verified channels. Ask what a notification does to access and what evidence is required for the next action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Preserve essential household services while asking about transfer or closure. Do not cancel every payment or service indiscriminately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep a dated log of requests, reference numbers, documents sent, response dates and the authorized person handling each task.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.
