                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Four notification states distinguish reporting a death from documents, authorized action and completion confirmation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A completed phone call may leave several administrative steps open.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Who belongs on the working list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Reason to notify
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Question for the first contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • SSA and relevant benefits agencies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Stop or correct benefits and ask about survivor processes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Has a report already been made, and which payments need review?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Employer or retirement provider
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Pay, benefits, pension and possible dependent coverage changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Who handles bereavement administration and deadlines?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Bank, card and investment providers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Protect accounts and establish the next authorized process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What does notification change, and what documents are needed?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Insurers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Claims and continuity of property or other necessary cover.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What notice and evidence does the policy require?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Credit bureaus
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Deceased-account reporting and identity concerns.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is the current reporting procedure and how is it confirmed?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Utilities, phone and memberships
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Transfer, preserve or close services as appropriate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Will closure affect residents, security or other accounts?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tax and motor-vehicle authorities
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Final filings, identification and ownership procedures.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which process applies and who may complete it?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Verify the government notification chain
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [USAGov](https://www.usa.gov/report-a-death?_hsmi=330340981) says the funeral director should report the death to SSA; if that does not happen, it should be reported promptly. SSA notifies Medicare. Other benefit programs can need separate contact. Record the actual reporting status instead of assuming every agency is informed by one death certificate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Do not spend or return a benefit deposit based only on the date it arrived. Ask the payer which benefit period it covers and what repayment or correction procedure applies. Notification is also an opportunity to ask about survivor benefits, but eligibility and applications are separate from stopping the deceased person's payment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Example: the order changes with the household
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Invented example: a daughter is helping after her father dies. She confirms that the funeral director will handle SSA reporting, then prioritizes his employer because her mother's health coverage may be affected. She also calls the home insurer because the house will be unoccupied. A seldom-used club membership waits while those questions are resolved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Her log distinguishes "death reported" from "claim submitted" and "account closed." When a provider asks for authority documents she does not yet have, she records the request and refers it to the person handling the estate. She does not represent herself as executor solely because the will names her.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A risk-based notification sequence covers care, benefits, financial providers and household services.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A policy deadline or immediate risk can change the order.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use one factual opening
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Provider notification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        I am reporting the death of the account holder. Please explain your bereavement process, what happens to the service or account now, and what evidence the authorized representative needs for the next step.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Delegating personal news
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Could you let these people know and tell them who to contact about arrangements? Please do not share private financial details or forward documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Notification is not permission to close or transfer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A family member may be able to report a death without having authority to transact, distribute property or sign closure instructions. Ask each institution to distinguish those steps. Joint ownership, beneficiary claims and estate assets may follow different processes. Do not use the deceased person's online identity to make changes as if they were still acting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Before shutting a phone number or email service, consider how remaining account recovery and correspondence will be handled through permitted provider processes. That is not a reason to bypass access rules. Similarly, keep water, heating or security services appropriate for any occupied or vulnerable property until the responsible person agrees the next step.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Documents: ask before ordering or sending
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • There is no universally correct number of certified death certificates to order. List institutions, ask what evidence they need, whether a certified copy is returned and whether a permitted alternative works. Keep copies and dispatch records where appropriate. Do not send an irreplaceable original document without understanding the process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use official portals, verified postal addresses or numbers taken independently from statements and provider websites. A caller who knows the deceased person's name is not thereby legitimate. Limit the personal details in obituaries and broadly shared messages, and avoid sending identity documents in an unverified reply.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Stop when the request becomes a liability question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/debts-and-deceased-relatives?mod=article_inline) explains that relatives usually do not pay a deceased person's debts from their own funds, but exceptions exist. Do not promise personal payment because a collector is insistent. Ask for written information and direct estate matters to the authorized representative.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Get qualified help for a shutoff threat, disputed debt, unclear authority, benefits overpayment, an unoccupied property risk or a deadline notice. Do not let a suggested ordering list override a real notice with a response date. Keep that document and obtain advice specific to the situation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do I need to tell every government agency separately?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Not necessarily, but do not assume a single report reaches every program. Confirm SSA reporting and identify each other benefit or public service the person used. USAGov provides a useful starting list. Keep the reporting status and any separate application or repayment request distinct in your notes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I close all accounts immediately?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No blanket closure rule is appropriate. Ask what notification changes and what the authorized representative should do next. Some accounts support an occupied home or another person's needs. Closing, transferring and making a beneficiary claim are different actions and may require different evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How many death certificates should I order?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Build the institution list and ask what each one currently requires before choosing a number. Some need certified copies and others may use different verification. Note whether documents are returned. A fixed national recommendation can cause unnecessary cost or still leave you short for your actual circumstances.
