                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • After a major life change, check time-sensitive coverage and legal obligations first, then review beneficiaries, decision makers, contact details and document locations. Do not assume one notification updates every organization, or that every health plan gives you 60 days. Build a list by institution and confirm each deadline directly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A new baby or move creates urgent everyday work before the paperwork even becomes visible. The useful task is not to rewrite every document tonight. It is to identify which arrangements the event actually changes, which have a clock and which need professional advice. This guide uses US examples and does not determine your tax, insurance or estate position.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Start with the event
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Change
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • First checks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Do not assume
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Marriage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Health enrollment, names if changing, beneficiaries and medical contacts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A new spouse automatically replaces every old designation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Divorce or separation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Coverage loss, court orders, account permissions and decision makers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • You can freely change every asset or beneficiary during proceedings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Birth or adoption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Dependent enrollment, care planning and beneficiary arrangements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Every plan has the same enrollment window.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Move
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Insurance location, official address updates, school or vehicle duties.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Forwarded mail updates the underlying record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Job change
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Coverage dates, new benefits and old plan contacts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A former plan or policy follows you automatically.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Death of a named person
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Contact, agent and beneficiary arrangements using that name.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A backup exists on every form.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Make the update list actionable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Write the event and actual date, then identify any notices or agreements already received. Keep them together.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Contact the health plan or benefits administrator promptly. Ask the exact enrollment deadline, documents, effective date and submission method.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Review beneficiaries and ownership arrangements account by account. Check restrictions and required consents before requesting changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Review emergency contacts, health care agents, financial helpers, caregivers and backups. Ask whether the people named remain willing and able.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Update names or addresses through each institution's official process, retaining required identity evidence and confirmation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Record requested, submitted and confirmed separately. Replace obsolete handoff pages once the underlying arrangement is actually changed.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three separate deadline checks distinguish employer coverage, Marketplace coverage and other life-change paperwork.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do not apply a 60-day Marketplace window to every health plan.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The health-coverage clocks differ
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The [Department of Labor](https://www.dol.gov/agencies/ebsa/about-ebsa/our-activities/resource-center/publications/life-changes-require-health-choices) describes job-based special enrollment requests generally within 30 days of marriage or a new child. [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/coverage-outside-open-enrollment/special-enrollment-period/) describes Marketplace household-event windows commonly based on the past 60 days, with event-specific conditions. These are not interchangeable clocks.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For example, divorce without loss of coverage does not by itself create the Marketplace special enrollment opportunity described on that page. Ask which event and coverage arrangement apply. Confirm the deadline with the actual plan and act promptly rather than waiting until the longest window you found online.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example: one new child, several separate updates
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Invented example: an employee welcomes a child and makes three entries: dependent enrollment with the employer plan, emergency contact updates, and a legal-planning appointment about guardianship and beneficiaries. The employee contacts the benefits administrator immediately, obtains the applicable deadline and submits through the required channel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The family does not assume the hospital notified the employer or that a payroll update added insurance. The tracker retains submission confirmation and a later coverage confirmation. A discussion of who would care for the child is recorded as planning in progress until the relevant legal documents are completed correctly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Beneficiary review is not a blanket legal conclusion
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Review each retirement plan, life policy and payable-on-death arrangement directly. Ask who is currently named, whether a contingent beneficiary exists, and what consent, court order or plan restriction applies. Do not assume a will alone changes a designation or that marriage and divorce have identical effects across all accounts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A new spouse may have rights under some plans, while divorce-related changes may be constrained by law, plan terms or orders. If any of that is unclear, ask the plan administrator and a qualified adviser. The organizing action is to obtain the current record, not to predict who would legally receive the money.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Four update stages separate reviewing, submitting, confirming and replacing an outdated personal record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Track the underlying change before marking your own list complete.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Get a precise answer
