                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Update the chain, not just one line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If a flight or train changes, inspect transfers, lodging arrival, rental pickup and reservations built around it. Mark what is still awaiting a reply. The [flight-change guide](/guides/flight-changed-what-else-is-affected) covers that check in more detail.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [Travel Companion](/shop/travel-companion) is an optional place to record bookings and dependencies. Its published listing does not claim live flight status or notifications, so operator checks remain your job. The one-page format above works in an ordinary document.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should an itinerary contain every activity?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No. Prioritize confirmed movements, stays and time-specific commitments. Keep flexible ideas separately unless someone needs them to coordinate care or access. An itinerary should make the next action clear, not suggest that every unfilled hour is a booking you forgot to make.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        How should I show time zones?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use each event's local date and time and label the location when needed. Check overnight journeys against the actual confirmation. Do not assume an arrival belongs to the departure date, or silently convert everything into home time and create a mismatch with the booking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Is a printed itinerary enough to travel?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No. It is an information backup, not a substitute for required documents or accepted tickets. Check the operator's presentation requirements and keep actual travel documents accessible. Reprint or replace the itinerary when arrangements change, retaining the current version rather than several contradictory sheets.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Saved search leads were reviewed for reader language only, not authority or prevalence. Quora was blocked in saved research. No search-volume or ranking estimate is available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For a week away, pack documents, payment options, required medicines and aids, phone power, daily toiletries and clothes matched to the forecast and laundry plan. Separate personal items from shared items and name the person packing each shared essential. Clothing counts are a starting estimate, not a rule for every traveler.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The easy items to pack are usually the ones already in sight. The charger still plugged in beside the bed and the medicine needed tomorrow morning are more likely to remain behind. A written list should catch those exceptions, not simply describe a generic suitcase. This guide covers an ordinary week, not expedition equipment or destination-specific medical advice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          table

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example: one adult, mild weather, no laundry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Category
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Starting quantity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Adjust when
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Underwear and socks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Seven daily sets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Your needs or activities require spares.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Tops
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Four
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Heat, formal events or limited rewear changes the plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Bottoms
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Two
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Activity or weather requires specialist clothing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Layer and outerwear
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • One useful layer plus weather protection as needed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The forecast or destination changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Sleepwear and footwear
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • One sleepwear set; worn shoes plus another pair if needed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A specific activity needs different footwear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Treat the example as a decision, not a challenge
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Those counts are invented planning choices, not hygiene guidance or a claim that everyone can rewear the same amount. If your week requires uniforms, daily changes, sensory accommodations or bulky equipment, make those needs explicit. A smaller bag is not more important than having what you actually need.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If you rely on laundry, confirm the machine, opening arrangements, cost and drying time. "There is probably a laundry nearby" is not a dependable plan for a late arrival. Without confirmed laundry, do not reduce essential clothing on the assumption that everything can be washed on day three.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          4
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Pack in an order that catches omissions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Write the dates, likely weather, activities and laundry arrangement before selecting clothes. Check the forecast again near departure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • List documents, payment access, medicines, glasses and other essential aids first. Identify what cannot readily be replaced at the destination.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Lay out clothing by its actual use. Count what you wear in transit as part of the total rather than packing an unnecessary extra outfit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Assign shared items such as an adapter, first-aid supplies or laundry bag to a named person. Keep personal health items with the person who needs them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Mark items packed only when they are in the bag. Put still-in-use items on a separate morning list with their location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check bag limits and item restrictions for the actual transport. Keep essential accessible items in the bag that stays with you.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Flying adds a restriction check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The [TSA travel checklist](https://www.tsa.gov/sites/default/files/tsa-travel-checklist.pdf) states the ordinary US carry-on liquids rule: containers of 3.4 ounces or less, fitting one quart-size bag per passenger. That is about the container and bag, not whether a large bottle is mostly empty. Check exemptions and special items separately with the responsible security authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • [FAA guidance](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/airline-passengers-and-batteries) requires spare lithium batteries and power banks in the cabin, not checked baggage. Check the device rating and airline restrictions. If your carry-on is taken for gate checking, remove items that cannot be checked before handing it over.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What stays accessible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Keep documents, necessary medicines and aids, a usable payment method and critical contact information within reach. A small personal bag can also hold a change of clothes appropriate to your circumstances. Do not assume a replacement is easy because the item is common at home.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For international travel, check destination rules for medicines and other restricted items before packing them. A travel-size container or prescription label does not settle every country's import rules. Ask the appropriate authority or qualified health professional if the requirement is unclear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Finish with the missing-item pass
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check three places: bathroom, charging area and the surface where tomorrow's essentials are waiting. Have each traveler confirm their own personal list where practical. For children or someone needing assistance, make the responsible adult explicit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use [the night-before checklist](/guides/night-before-you-travel-checklist) for final timing and home checks rather than reopening every clothing decision. If a required document, medical supply or access arrangement is unresolved, address that first and contact the relevant provider; do not bury it under optional packing improvements.
