                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How many outfits should I take for seven days?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Base the number on activities, weather, personal needs and confirmed laundry. Four tops and two bottoms can be a starting example for mild conditions, not a universal minimum. Count what you wear while traveling and add specific clothing only where the trip actually calls for it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            How do I stop two people packing the same shared item?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Keep a shared list with one named owner for each item. Confirm suitability, such as the correct plug adapter or enough charging ports, rather than merely ticking charger. Each traveler should still have the personal items they need if bags or people become separated.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What belongs on the morning packing list?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Anything still being used: medicines, glasses, phone, charger, daily toiletries and a document taken out for check-in. Write the item and its current location. A short explicit list is more reliable than promising to remember the few things you could not pack last night.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • To pack carry-on only, confirm the allowance for every flight on your itinerary, choose a bag within the applicable dimensions and weight, then pack essential items before clothes. Plan laundry if your quantities depend on it. Keep a removable set of documents, medicines and restricted batteries in case the main bag must be checked at the gate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • A bag sold as cabin size is not a promise that your fare includes it or that every operator accepts it. The practical challenge is meeting the actual allowance while retaining access to what cannot go in the hold. This guide uses US security and battery sources; other departure airports and airlines may have different or stricter rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Check the allowance before the packing list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open the current baggage terms for your fare and each operating airline. Distinguish an under-seat personal item from an overhead cabin bag.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Measure the bag as required, including wheels, handles and any packed expansion. Weigh the packed bag rather than relying on its empty specification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Identify essential medicines, aids, documents and devices before deciding how much space clothes can use. Ask the airline about special equipment where needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Choose clothing for the actual conditions and a realistic laundry plan. Use a small rotation rather than assuming every possible activity needs another outfit.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Separate ordinary liquids from items needing a specific exemption or screening arrangement. Check unusual items with the responsible authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Pack a removable essentials pouch and battery-safe arrangement. Review it again if staff require a gate check.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Four steps connect fare and operating-airline rules to essential supplies and a feasible clothing rotation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example: a week with confirmed laundry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Item
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Chosen total including worn items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Reason
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Tops
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Four
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A mix of rewear and one planned wash.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Bottoms
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Two
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • One worn and one packed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Underwear and socks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Five sets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Confirmed wash and drying before supplies run out.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Layer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • One
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Suited to the forecast and worn where useful.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Shoes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • One worn pair; second only for a real need
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Footwear is bulky and must justify its space.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The example is not a universal capsule wardrobe
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • These are invented choices for one adult in mild conditions. They are not suitable for every body, climate, medical need or activity. If laundry cannot be confirmed, revise the quantities or baggage plan. Do not create an unrealistic wash schedule merely to make the bag close.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Compression can reduce clothing volume but not weight. Leave enough space to close the bag normally and move through the trip without repacking every pocket at each stop. If required items exceed the allowance, change the baggage arrangement rather than hiding weight or risking loss of necessary supplies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Liquids and batteries need different checks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The [TSA checklist](https://www.tsa.gov/sites/default/files/tsa-travel-checklist.pdf) gives the ordinary US carry-on liquids rule: containers no larger than 3.4 ounces in one quart-size bag per passenger. Exceptions require their own check. Decanting is not appropriate for every medicine or product, and a small container does not establish that the destination permits the substance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The [FAA battery guidance](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/airline-passengers-and-batteries) treats power banks and spare lithium batteries as carry-on only. Installed batteries have different rules. Protect the relevant terminals, check ratings and ask the airline about stricter limits or specialist equipment. Do not generalize "all electronics are forbidden in checked bags."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              If the main bag is gate checked
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Keep with you
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Check before handing it over
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Travel documents, payment method and valuables
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • They are not trapped in the checked bag.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Required medicines and essential aids
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • You retain needed access and follow relevant restrictions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Power banks and spare lithium batteries
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Remove them from the bag going into the hold.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Arrival information and a suitable spare outfit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • You can manage if baggage delivery is delayed.
