                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Example: the gate-check fallback
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Invented example: a traveler meets the airline's size limit but staff need the bag in the hold. The traveler removes the essentials pouch and power bank before handing it over, asks where the bag will be returned and keeps the tag. This is a contingency, not a prediction that compliant luggage is always guaranteed cabin space.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Do not assume a tiny personal item can hold everything you need to remove. Test the fallback at home, especially with assistive equipment or temperature-sensitive supplies. Ask the airline and relevant professional about those needs in advance rather than improvising at boarding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Make the last edit about usefulness
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Remove duplication before removing essentials: extra chargers that do the same job, shoes with no planned use or clothing that does not suit the forecast. Keep the [week-away list](/guides/packing-list-for-a-week-away) for the personal-versus-shared distinction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • If your itinerary changes, review the baggage rules again, including any replacement flight. A new operator or fare can change the allowance. Stop and contact the airline where equipment, batteries or required supplies do not clearly fit its rules.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Does carry-on only mean one bag on every fare?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No. The phrase describes your plan, not an included allowance. Some fares permit only an under-seat item, while others include an overhead bag under particular limits. Check your actual booking and operating airlines before choosing the bag or assuming a second item is included.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I bring a power bank?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Check its rating and the airline's current restrictions. FAA guidance requires power banks and spare lithium batteries to remain in the cabin, not checked baggage. If the bag is gate checked, remove them first. Larger, damaged, recalled or specialist batteries need their own assessment rather than a generic yes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can I pack for two weeks without a checked bag?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Possibly, if essential equipment, climate and a dependable laundry plan fit the actual allowance. The clothing rotation may be similar to a shorter trip, but washing and drying become important dependencies. Do not treat carry-on travel as a requirement when checked baggage is the practical choice.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When traveling with children, prepare three things first: supplies that stay accessible during a delay, documents and permissions for each child, and transport or sleep equipment confirmed for the actual journey. Build the day around feeding, rest and realistic transfers rather than adding a full adult itinerary around them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A checked suitcase may contain everything a baby needs while being unavailable at the exact moment it is needed. The packing question is therefore not just what to bring, but who holds it and when it can be reached. This guide covers family logistics, with US air-travel sources where relevant. It is not feeding, medication or child-development advice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Prepare per child, not just per suitcase
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • List each child's documents, relevant permission evidence and transport booking under their own name. Check the actual route and operator.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pack accessible changes of clothes and necessary hygiene supplies, scaled to the child and realistic journey duration plus a considered delay margin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Plan food and feeding supplies around the child's established needs. Check storage, screening and destination access before relying on them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep required medicines, aids and current care instructions accessible. Ask the appropriate professional about uncertain travel or storage needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Confirm the stroller, car seat or other equipment arrangements for every stage, including the transfer after arrival.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Name the adult responsible for each shared task and essential bag. Keep a backup if the group is separated or one adult is occupied.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Three luggage stages distinguish accessible family supplies, main luggage and equipment needed after arrival.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Plan access across the whole journey, not only the flight.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Example: what stays accessible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Traveler
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Chosen supplies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Dependency to check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Baby
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Usual feeding equipment, hygiene supplies, changes and carrier.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Safe storage, screening and actual transport equipment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Toddler
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Change, familiar comfort item, appropriate snacks and hygiene supplies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Reachable bag and realistic rest opportunities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • School-age child
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Change if useful, required supplies, book or suitable activity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Individual documents and who holds them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Responsible adult
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Spare clothing as needed, documents and essential contacts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Can manage the items while supervising children.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A delay plan is not a fixed diaper count
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • These are invented packing categories, not age-based medical guidance or a complete list. Estimate supplies from your child's actual routine and the door-to-door journey, not just flight time. Think through an unplanned wait or overnight stop, and what could realistically be obtained locally.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not reduce necessary supplies to meet a minimalist bag target. If food, medicines or equipment require particular storage, handling or access, confirm those arrangements before departure. If a required item cannot be safely transported or replaced, seek advice from the relevant professional and operator rather than assuming the airport will solve it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Confirm child documents and permissions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The [State Department minors guidance](https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/planning/personal-needs/minors.html) emphasizes destination-specific entry and exit rules. Some countries require formal consent from a non-traveling parent or evidence of sole legal custody. Check the actual nationality, itinerary and family circumstances; a general consent letter from a blog may not meet the relevant process.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Domestic airline proof-of-age or identity policies and international border requirements are different questions. Ask the operator what is needed for the specific booking. Where a custody order, dispute or cross-border consent concern exists, obtain appropriate legal advice before travel rather than relying on a packing checklist.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Gear needs an end-to-end plan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For aircraft use, the [FAA child-restraint guidance](https://www.faa.gov/travelers/fly_children/about-child-restraint-systems) requires appropriate certification and use according to manufacturer instructions. Confirm suitability and seating arrangements with the airline. Do not assume that every car seat, booster or carrier can be used as an aircraft restraint.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Confirm what happens to a stroller or seat at boarding and where it is returned. Then check the destination car transfer, rental vehicle or public transport plan. A child seat checked into the hold may not be available for an unexpected connection or immediately at the point you expected to collect it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
