                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Different losses expose different things
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Missing item
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Immediate focus
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Next question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Passport
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Official report and consular replacement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What is required for the actual travel date and route?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Wallet or cards
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Block the affected payment access through the issuer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • What replacement or emergency access is available?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Phone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Protect device, carrier account and exposed sign-ins.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • How will you receive codes and be contacted now?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Several items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Delegate secure parallel calls if possible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Which backup identity, funds and contact routes remain?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Passport replacement: contact first, collect what you can
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [State Department lost-passport page](https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/help-abroad/lost-stolen-passport.html) says to contact the nearest embassy or consulate and appear in person for replacement. Bring the available identity and citizenship evidence, a suitable photo, itinerary and application material as instructed. Tell staff if you cannot provide everything rather than assuming you cannot ask for help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The current official guidance asks for detailed loss information in the replacement application and may request a separate lost-passport statement if necessary. Use the embassy's current instructions rather than assuming every applicant must complete the same online sequence. Police reports can help document the incident, and local law or an insurer may separately require one, but they are not a prerequisite to contacting the consulate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Understand what reporting changes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Once a U.S. passport is reported lost or stolen and canceled, it is not valid for international travel, even if you later find it. Do not plan to use a found canceled passport at the airport. Ask the consulate about the appropriate replacement and any urgent travel issue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • An emergency passport may be offered when a regular replacement cannot arrive in time, but issuance, timing and onward acceptance depend on the circumstances. Ask about transit and destination requirements, not only the flight home. A passport photocopy helps establish information; it is not automatically an accepted travel document.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Example: passport and phone lost together
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Invented example: Priya discovers her passport and phone are missing after a train journey. From a safe place, a companion helps locate verified consular and bank contacts. Priya establishes a reachable number, starts the official lost-device process and tells consular staff she is scheduled to fly in two days.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • She has a passport copy stored separately and can explain the itinerary. She does not wait for a police appointment before contacting the consulate, and does not promise the hotel she will definitely leave on the original flight. She asks the airline, accommodation and transfer provider what can be changed while replacement timing is unresolved.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Four stages connect consular contact, evidence gathering, document confirmation and changes to affected bookings.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A copy or a found canceled passport does not replace a valid travel document.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Wallet: ask about access as well as replacement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Report the affected cards promptly to their issuers and ask what action has been taken. Check recent transactions and ask how to report anything unauthorized. Do not assume a temporary app lock is the final response for a stolen card, or that a replacement can reach every destination.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask what identity evidence, delivery address and contact method an emergency replacement or cash arrangement needs. The answer belongs to the issuer, not a general travel guide. If you have no funds or identity evidence, explain that to the consular staff and insurer where relevant, without assuming either will guarantee payment or a particular service.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Phone: protect it without helping a thief
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Follow the device maker's current instructions. For an iPhone, [Apple's stolen-device guidance](https://support.apple.com/en-ie/120837) says to mark it lost promptly and not remove it from Find My. Erasing and removing a device are different actions. Do not follow a message that asks for your passcode or tells you to disable its protection because it has supposedly been found.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Contact the carrier about the mobile account and replacement access. Consider the email, banking and other accounts the phone could expose, especially if the passcode may be known. Do not attempt to retrieve a suspected stolen device from a map location yourself; contact local law enforcement. Use a trusted device where possible and sign out of borrowed sessions afterward.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep the first message factual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Consular contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        My U.S. passport is missing and I am scheduled to travel on this date. I am reachable at this temporary contact. Please tell me the replacement process and what to do if some identity documents are also missing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Person waiting for you
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        I am safe, but my passport or phone is missing. My arrival may change while I follow the official process. Please use this contact for now; I will confirm the next update when I have reliable information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Close the travel dependencies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep a short call log: institution, time, reference, promised next action and how they can reach you. Contact the providers affected by a possible delay and check cancellation or change terms. Save evidence for insurance through its permitted process, without assuming all costs are covered.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For future preparation, [the paper travel backup guide](/guides/what-to-keep-on-paper-when-you-travel) helps reduce dependence on one phone. Right now, prioritize safety, account protection and the official replacement route rather than trying to rebuild the entire trip file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Must I get a police report before calling the embassy?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No. Current U.S. State Department guidance says a police report is not mandatory for passport replacement. It may still help document a theft or be required by local rules or insurance. Contact the consulate promptly and explain the situation, including any difficulty obtaining documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Can I travel if I find the passport after reporting it?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        If it has been canceled after a lost or stolen report, it is no longer valid for international travel. Do not try to use it because it looks intact. Contact the relevant passport authority or consulate about replacement and the documents needed for your itinerary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I immediately erase my missing phone?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use the manufacturer's current process and consider the exposure. Locking or marking lost, erasing and removing account protection are different actions. For Apple devices, do not remove the device from Find My just because it is missing or erased. Secure exposed accounts and contact the carrier as appropriate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Identity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
