                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Before booking your first international trip, check every traveler's passport and the entry, exit and transit requirements for the actual route. Then confirm practical health access, payment options, phone service and the first arrival. Do not apply a blanket six-month passport rule or assume a visa-free destination means no authorization is required.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The first unfamiliar checkpoint often comes before departure: a booking form asks for a name, passport details or a connection choice you have never had to consider. Deal with requirements that could prevent travel before polishing the packing list. This checklist is primarily for U.S. citizens leaving the United States; other passports and statuses can produce different requirements.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check the passport identity page, condition and expiry for every traveler, including children. Verify requirements for the actual passport and itinerary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Read destination and transit-country entry and exit guidance from the responsible authorities. Check visa or authorization, validity, blank pages and other required evidence where relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Check current passport or visa application procedures and realistic lead times if anything is missing. Do not rely on a processing estimate remembered from another trip.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Match traveler details to the required booking and identity documents. Resolve a name or status question before paying rather than hoping the airport will fix it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Review cancellation terms and dependencies such as separate-ticket connections. Know what could be lost if an upstream booking changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Identify any health, accessibility, child-consent or equipment requirement that needs advance arrangements. Ask the relevant professional or authority early.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Four feasibility checks connect traveler status, route rules and documents before booking a first international trip.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          An attractive fare does not establish that the traveler can use the route.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A first-trip order, not a universal countdown
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Stage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Output
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Where to confirm
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Feasibility
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Documents and permissions for every traveler.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Issuing and border authorities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Bookings
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirmed names, dates and arrival chain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Actual providers and booking terms.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Practical access
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Health, funds and communication arrangements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Insurer, clinician, bank and carrier as relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Departure backup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Current references, addresses and document copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirmations and official requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Return
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Required declarations and valid return documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Relevant border and transport authorities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Use country information, then verify the actual rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The [State Department checklist](https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/planning/checklist.html) directs travelers to destination information covering entry, exit, visas, passport validity and local conditions. Use that as a starting point, then confirm consequential details with the relevant destination authority. Check every country where your itinerary creates an entry or transit requirement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Do not generalize one regional rule to a continent, or another traveler's nationality to yours. A passport can be unexpired yet fail a destination's validity condition. Conversely, six months is not a universal requirement. Record the precise rule, relevant date basis and when you checked it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Example: a route check changes the purchase
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Invented example: Sam finds an attractive fare with a long connection in another country. Before buying, Sam checks whether the itinerary requires an airport change, collecting baggage or entering that country, and what documents those steps require. The destination alone does not answer the transit question.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Sam also checks that the first lodging can accept the planned arrival. A flight landing late at night can make a cheap room impractical if access closes early. The decision is based on the route and provider terms, not on assuming the lowest fare creates the lowest total risk.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Arrange health access rather than guessing treatment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ask your health insurer what is covered abroad and how assistance, payment and claims work. If considering travel insurance, read the actual exclusions, covered reasons, assistance terms and any relevant timing requirements. Do not assume a policy automatically covers every cancellation, existing condition or transport home.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Discuss health preparation with an appropriate clinician or travel service where needed. Check destination rules for your medicines, equipment and documentation. Keep required supplies accessible and plan storage. This article does not recommend vaccines, treatment or doses for a particular traveler.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Four arrival-backup components cover lodging, transport, essential contacts and separately held document copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Backups support recovery but do not replace required travel documents.
