                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 09:10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Scheduled flight departure
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Current booking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 07:10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Chosen airport arrival target
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Illustrative planning assumption, not universal advice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 06:25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 45-minute journey before any additional margin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 06:10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Revised leave time
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Adds a chosen 15-minute journey margin.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • 05:20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The arithmetic is only as good as the inputs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The example is invented and uses consistent times. The chosen airport target, journey duration and buffers are not a recommendation for your airport or flight. Check the actual operator deadlines and your needs, including assistance, baggage or document checks. A delay to the flight does not necessarily move every cutoff or mean you should arrive later.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check the route to the terminal, not just the flight time. A parking transfer, early-morning transit gap or road closure can consume a margin you thought you had. If a ride is essential, confirm the booking and a realistic fallback rather than relying on an old message.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Separate in-bag from still-in-use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Use two statuses: packed and to collect in the morning. The second list should name the item and its location, such as glasses on the bedside table or medication in its appropriate overnight storage. Do not tick something packed while it is still charging elsewhere.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Invented example: Lee leaves the phone charging and writes "phone, charging cable, glasses" on the morning list. The passport is checked and already in the accessible bag. At departure, Lee checks the three remaining items instead of opening the entire suitcase and restarting the clothing decision.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Restrictions are not all the same
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [FAA battery guidance](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/airline-passengers-and-batteries) distinguishes power banks and spare lithium batteries, which stay in the cabin, from installed-device rules. Check your actual battery and airline restrictions. If a bag is gate checked, remove cabin-only items before handover.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The [TSA checklist](https://www.tsa.gov/sites/default/files/tsa-travel-checklist.pdf) covers ordinary US carry-on liquid limits. Required medicines, specialist equipment, infant supplies and departures from other countries need their own current checks. This article does not claim that a domestic identification issue or a missing passport can always be resolved at the airport.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Leave the house in the state it actually needs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Confirm doors and windows, safe appliance settings, waste that cannot wait and any agreed sitter access. Keep heating, cooling, alarms or water arrangements appropriate for the property, climate and systems. Do not switch off a critical system solely because a generic checklist says empty house.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Give the helper the information needed for their task, not your entire private file. Check who is covering the first visit and how they report a problem. A message saying "the neighbor knows" is not the same as an agreed date, working key and backup contact.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Resolve the last dependency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Ride confirmation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Please confirm the pickup date, time, address and destination terminal, plus how I should contact you if the driver has not arrived.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Home handoff
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Can you confirm the first visit and that the key works? Here is the task list and backup contact if something prevents you coming.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    If something important is wrong tonight
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Prioritize a missing required document, unconfirmed necessary assistance, inaccessible medicine or changed departure over cosmetic packing. Contact the relevant official provider and ask what options remain. Do not rely on a photocopy, workaround or expired instruction without verifying it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • For a moved flight, inspect connected transfers and lodging arrival, not just the alarm. [The flight-change guide](/guides/flight-changed-what-else-is-affected) explains that chain. Once essentials and the morning list are settled, stop adding optional tasks that undermine the rest needed for the journey.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Should I repack everything the night before?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Usually a targeted check is more useful than restarting the whole list. Verify essentials, restrictions and still-in-use items, then change only what a real problem requires. A forecast change or new baggage rule may justify an edit; general uncertainty does not require reconsidering every shirt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      How early should I leave for the airport?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Work backward from the operator's actual cutoff and recommended arrival instructions, then add your transport, access needs and realistic uncertainty. There is no single number for every trip. Recheck the departure location and date, and do not assume a flight delay automatically changes check-in deadlines.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What if a required document is missing tonight?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Contact the relevant issuing authority or travel provider promptly and explain the departure date. Ask what lawful options remain and what evidence is accepted. Do not assume a photograph or an airport identity process replaces every document. If travel is not possible, check affected bookings and change terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The item is physically in the accessible or main bag.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      New article structure

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. paragraphs (paragraphs; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. Work out the status one task at a time (list; new or rewritten block)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      4. figure (figure; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      5. Example: one car on November 17, 2026 at 52,300 miles (table; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      6. The table is arithmetic, not a service schedule (paragraphs; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7. The manufacturer schedule is the starting point (paragraphs; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8. figure (figure; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      9.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       11.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       12.
