                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13. faq (faq; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A maintenance task is due when it reaches the mileage or time limit specified for your vehicle, whichever applies first where the schedule gives both. Compare the current reading and date with reliable last-service evidence. If that evidence is missing, mark the task unknown, not safe to postpone. Warning signs and safety concerns need assessment even when a schedule says a task is not due.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The reminder sticker, manual and shop recommendation may each describe something different. Your first job is to identify the correct vehicle schedule and the facts behind the last service, then calculate what remains. This guide explains that administrative check; it cannot diagnose the vehicle, supply universal intervals or certify that it is safe to drive.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Work out the status one task at a time
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Identify the exact year, model, engine or powertrain and relevant schedule. Use the manufacturer's information, including applicable driving-condition provisions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Read the current odometer and record the date and units. Do not combine a kilometer reading with a mileage interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Find the last-service date, odometer and task description on the receipt, your record or the servicing shop's evidence. Distinguish inspection from replacement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Copy the actual applicable interval or manufacturer service-life instruction. Some systems use a monitor rather than a simple repeated arithmetic interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Calculate mileage and date thresholds where the schedule provides them. Reaching either applicable limit makes the task due; both do not have to be reached.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Separate due, upcoming and unknown tasks, then discuss uncertainty or symptoms with a qualified mechanic. Save the completed work and evidence for the next check.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • [Open the free maintenance due and unknown-history check](/guides/print/library/what-is-due-on-my-car-right-now.html). Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Four maintenance states distinguish mileage due, time due, upcoming and unknown history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use the vehicle's actual instructions; the worked numbers are not recommendations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Example: one car on November 17, 2026 at 52,300 miles
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Invented interval and last service
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Thresholds
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Oil and filter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 5,000 miles or 6 months; May 1 at 48,100
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 53,100 miles or November 1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Due by time, even with 800 miles remaining.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Tire rotation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 7,500 miles; January 15 at 44,900
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 52,400 miles
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 100 miles remaining under this example interval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Cabin filter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 15,000 miles or 12 months; January 10 at 40,000
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 55,000 miles or January 10, 2027
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2,700 miles and the stated date remain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Brake fluid
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Service evidence missing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Cannot establish the last-service baseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Unknown; ask about assessment and the correct schedule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The table is arithmetic, not a service schedule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Every interval and service record in the table is invented. Do not copy these numbers to your car. The oil example is already due by the date limit even though mileage remains. The cabin-filter example gives both remaining thresholds; it does not predict which will arrive first without knowing future use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Add the mileage interval to the last recorded mileage to find the next mileage threshold. Add the applicable calendar interval to the actual last-service date to find the date threshold, following the manufacturer's instructions. For one-limit tasks, use the specified limit rather than inventing a second one.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The manufacturer schedule is the starting point
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The [FTC auto-repair guide](https://www.bulkorder.ftc.gov/system/files/publications/pdf-0078-auto-repair.pdf) recommends following the manufacturer's maintenance schedule for your type of driving. Confirm which conditions and schedule apply to the exact vehicle. Do not automatically shorten every interval because one journey was dusty or assume a generic normal schedule covers sustained demanding use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If a shop recommends earlier work, ask whether it is based on a schedule, an observed condition, a diagnostic result or shop policy. Those can all be different from a factory interval. Record the explanation and proposed work before authorization. An inspection finding may require action even when the scheduled replacement point has not arrived.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Four record components connect the manufacturer schedule, last service, current reading and completed-work evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A tracker cannot establish facts that were never entered or verified.
