                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Unknown is not the same as not due
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A missing receipt does not prove work was never performed, but it also does not establish that the task can wait. Ask prior shops or the seller for records and keep estimates clearly labelled as unverified. Do not reset a service clock to today just because today is when you began using a tracker.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For unknown safety-critical maintenance, ask a qualified mechanic how to establish an appropriate baseline now. Some tasks cannot be verified merely by looking at the component. Keep the distinction between history recovered, condition assessed and work actually completed. The [used-car records guide](/guides/used-car-no-service-records-what-to-do) addresses that broader history problem.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask why work is recommended
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Schedule versus finding
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is this task due under the manufacturer schedule for this vehicle and driving, or are you recommending it because of a specific finding? Please show me the interval or explain the finding and the consequence of waiting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Unknown history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          I do not have reliable evidence of the last service. What can you establish, what remains unknown and what baseline work or inspection do you recommend before I rely on the vehicle?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do not calculate past a warning sign
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A date comparison is not a diagnosis. A warning light, leak, braking or steering concern, overheating, unusual vibration or other safety issue needs the response described by the owner's manual and appropriate professional help. Do not continue driving merely because the maintenance table looks green.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • For tire pressure, [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips) points to the vehicle placard or manual, checked cold, not the maximum marked on the tire. That is a separate practical check, not something the last oil receipt settles. If the vehicle may be unsafe, arrange assistance rather than driving it to meet an appointment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep the next check auditable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • After work, record the date, odometer, exact task and receipt location. Note whether an item was inspected, adjusted or replaced. Refresh the current reading before another due check or a long trip; stale mileage can make an apparently upcoming task already due.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • [Vehicle Maintenance Companion](/shop/vehicle-maintenance-companion) can organize entered intervals and history, but its published listing does not claim live vehicle data or a factory schedule lookup. Whatever tool you choose, the schedule and evidence you enter determine the usefulness of the result.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is service due only when both miles and months pass?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No. Where the manufacturer specifies either limit, reaching either one makes the task due. A low-mileage vehicle can reach a time limit first. If the manufacturer provides only one limit or uses a service-life system, follow that instruction rather than forcing it into a two-number template.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can an unknown task be overdue?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          It may be, but missing history prevents a reliable scheduled comparison. Mark it unknown and seek records or professional advice rather than calling it not due. Do not wait indefinitely for a future service to create a baseline where a safety-critical task needs assessment now.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Should I use the shop's interval or the manual?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Start with the correct manufacturer schedule and ask why the shop recommends a different action. A specific condition or diagnostic finding may matter independently of routine timing. Keep the schedule, finding and authorization distinct, and get another qualified opinion where the explanation is unclear or consequential.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The task may be upcoming, but condition concerns remain separate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use the vehicle's actual instructions; the worked numbers are not recommendations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • All service intervals and records in the worked table are invented. No vehicle-specific manual, condition, service monitor or mechanic recommendation was assessed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Saved search leads were reviewed for reader language only, not authority or prevalence. Quora was blocked in saved research. No search-volume or ranking estimate is available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Tell the mechanic what you noticed, when it happens, what you want done today and how to reach you. Before handing over the keys, agree what diagnosis costs and require a new price and your approval before additional work. Get the agreement in writing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The difficult moment is often the lunchtime call: the car is already apart, another job has been suggested and you have five minutes between meetings. A useful drop-off note makes that decision smaller. This guide covers communicating and authorizing work, not diagnosing the car or stating repair law for every US state.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Before you leave the car
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identify the vehicle by year, model, plate and current odometer reading. Bring relevant earlier invoices.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Describe the onset, frequency and conditions: cold start, braking, turning, speed or weather. Say what changed after recent work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Ask what diagnosis alone costs, whether that includes taxes and shop charges, and whether it is credited toward a repair.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Confirm any teardown, reassembly, storage or towing charges before agreeing to diagnostic work that could leave the car unavailable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Name the jobs you authorize, the total limit and the contact method. Ask the shop to wait for your answer about anything else.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Read the work order before signing. Keep a copy, including any terms on the reverse.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            5
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Describe the problem without naming a failed part
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write "a scraping sound while braking at low speed, first noticed Monday" rather than "replace my brakes" unless you are deliberately ordering that job. Include whether the problem is intermittent and whether another shop has already attempted a repair. Mark missing history as unknown.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A safely taken warning-light photo or recording can help explain an intermittent concern. Do not recreate a dangerous fault, film while driving or continue driving to produce evidence. Ask the shop whether the car should be towed if safe operation is uncertain.
