                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Words to use at the counter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Diagnosis only
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Please investigate this symptom first. What is the total diagnostic charge, including fees and tax? Do not start repairs until I approve the written estimate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Scheduled work
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Today I authorize only the listed service at the agreed total. Please contact me before any change and wait for my reply.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional work
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Please send the findings, proposed parts, labor and total price. What makes this urgent, and what happens if I leave it until another appointment?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Declining after inspection
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              I am not approving that repair today. What do I owe for the work already authorized, and what will reassembly or collection involve?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Invented example: a limit is not blanket permission
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A driver agrees to a $120 diagnostic inspection for a noise. The shop later quotes $460 for a repair. The $120 approval does not describe a $460 repair, and an available credit-card balance is not consent. The driver asks for the findings and full estimate, then replies with the exact job approved. These amounts illustrate the conversation, not typical prices.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write whether a limit covers diagnosis only or the whole authorized visit. "Call above $250" can otherwise leave everyone assuming something different. A clear note also says which number to try, when you are available and that silence is not approval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Parts, pickup and a disputed bill
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Ask before work begins if you want replaced parts returned. Warranty returns, exchange cores and other restrictions can affect what is available; confirm rather than treating return as unconditional. At pickup, compare the itemized bill with what you approved and ask about any difference. File the invoice with your [maintenance log](/guides/car-maintenance-log-what-to-write-down).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The [FTC repair guide](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/0211-auto-repair-basics) recommends written estimates and documenting disputes. [California BAR](https://www.bar.ca.gov/auto-repairs) provides a state-specific consumer route, not a nationwide rule. If the shop will not resolve a disputed charge, contact the relevant state consumer or repair regulator. Do not assume you can withhold payment and remove the car without legal consequences.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Should I tell the mechanic my budget?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              You can state a spending boundary, but also define its scope. Ask whether it includes diagnosis, parts, labor, taxes and fees. A number alone does not explain which work you consent to, so list the authorized job and require contact before changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Can a shop charge for diagnosis if I decline the repair?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              It may charge for diagnostic work you agreed to even when you do not buy the repair. Ask about that fee before the inspection begins, including reassembly and storage if relevant. Local rules and the agreement matter; a free estimate is not the same as free diagnosis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What if I cannot answer the shop during work?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Agree a contact window or an alternative authorized contact in advance. Ask the shop to pause rather than interpret a missed call as permission. Also ask how a delay changes completion time and whether any storage charge could arise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • If you bought a used car with no service records, ask the seller for receipts and previous service locations, write down today's mileage, check the correct owner's manual and arrange an independent mechanical inspection. Keep documented work separate from the seller's recollection. Start a record now, but do not treat the purchase date as the last service date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The keys are yours. The history is not. Someone says it was always looked after, the glove box has an old handbook, and you are trying to decide whether the next bill is overdue maintenance or work that was done six months ago. The answer is not to assume everything is fine, or pay to replace everything. It is to find what can be established and make the remaining questions specific.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • This guide is for US owners dealing with missing records. It helps you organise evidence and a conversation with a qualified mechanic; it does not diagnose the car or certify it safe to drive. If there are warning signs, damage or a known safety concern, follow the vehicle's warning instructions and seek appropriate professional help rather than waiting to finish the paperwork.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The first five things to do
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Record the VIN, year, model, engine or powertrain where known, current odometer reading and date. Check that the documents match the vehicle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Ask the seller for invoices, digital records and the shops used. Keep the reply, but label recollections as reported rather than documented.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Get the manufacturer's manual and maintenance schedule for the correct year and version. Note any time-based and usage-based requirements rather than using a generic interval from another car.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check official recall information and arrange an independent inspection. Explain that the maintenance history is incomplete and ask for a written priority list.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Agree what needs action, what needs further evidence, and what can be reviewed at a specific time or mileage. Recording a problem does not resolve a safety issue.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Four evidence sources separate recorded service, reported history, recall information and present mechanical condition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A report, a receipt, a recall check and an inspection answer different questions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Where to look for a used car's service history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What it might establish
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What it does not establish
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Seller's receipts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The work, vehicle, date and mileage shown on an invoice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Everything that happened outside that record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Previous shop or brand dealer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Work recorded in that business's systems, if it can be released
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Work done elsewhere or unrestricted access to a previous owner's personal information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Vehicle-history report
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Reported events, which may include service visits as well as title or damage information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A complete maintenance log or today's mechanical condition
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Manufacturer recall lookup
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Applicable recall information within that service's scope
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • That routine maintenance was done or that the whole vehicle is safe
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Independent inspection
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Findings about the vehicle's current condition and recommended next steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • An exact past service date where there is no evidence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Can CARFAX show oil changes and service records?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It can show reported services. [CARFAX describes](https://www.carfax.com/buying/how-to-read-a-carfax-report) maintenance entries such as oil changes and tire rotations. That does not mean every shop, owner or event appears. An empty entry is a gap in what you can see, not proof that the work never happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The [FTC explains](https://consumer.ftc.gov/features/feature-0040-used-cars) that vehicle-history products differ: title, loss and salvage data are not the same as a comprehensive service history. A history report does not replace an independent inspection. Use a report as one source and check what each entry actually says, rather than treating a clean-looking page as an all-clear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What you can document
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Invoice with the matching vehicle, work, date and mileage. Keep a copy and note anything unclear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Your own new service receipt or the written findings from an inspection. Record what was done separately from what was recommended.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                right
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What still needs checking
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Seller remembers a job but has no supporting record. Preserve their wording and its source; do not convert it into an exact service date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • No reliable information. Mark unknown and ask how to assess the risk for that item on this particular vehicle.
