                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Ask for a baseline, not a mystery full service
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Booking the inspection
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  I bought this car with incomplete service records. Can you inspect its current condition, compare the unknown items with the correct manufacturer schedule, and give me written priorities before I authorise repairs?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A large work list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Which items concern immediate safety, which are scheduled maintenance, and which are recommendations? What evidence supports each one, and what are the consequences of waiting?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Permission for extra work
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Please give me the scope and price for the work requested today. Contact me for approval before adding work, and put the agreed next review date or mileage in writing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Do I need to replace every fluid and belt?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • No blanket list can decide that from the absence of receipts. The model, age, actual condition, manufacturer instructions, use and evidence all matter. A timing belt is not interchangeable with a timing chain, and a photograph of a belt does not supply a reliable replacement history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Ask the mechanic to identify the important unknowns and explain the appropriate assessment or service for each. Do not infer fluid condition or the correct work solely from colour, a seller's description or a generic internet interval. For each recommendation, keep the reason, urgency, quoted scope and what you authorised. The [mechanic conversation guide](/guides/what-to-tell-a-mechanic-before-work-starts) helps you keep that boundary clear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Three evidence states distinguish a documented invoice, a seller's reported memory and a genuinely unknown maintenance history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Unknown is not the same as never done, and it is not permission to ignore a safety concern.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Check recalls without confusing them with maintenance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Use the [NHTSA recall lookup](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls) for a US vehicle and follow any manufacturer instructions for a relevant recall. Read the lookup's limitations: repaired recalls, some newly announced recalls, certain older recalls, some manufacturers and international vehicles may not appear in the VIN result.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A zero result is not a full safety inspection. Save the result and date, and ask the manufacturer or dealer about anything unclear. A routine service recommendation, a safety recall and a service campaign are different things; ask which one you are discussing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A first entry that does not invent the past
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                intro
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                An invented example, not an inspection or a recommendation for a specific car.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Field
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • What the owner records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ownership baseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Bought 12 November; odometer 84,000 miles. This is the purchase reading, not a service date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Seller's statement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Seller says oil changes were regular; no receipts supplied.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Evidence recovered
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • One invoice found. Check VIN, actual work, date and mileage before treating it as relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Unknown item
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Previous timing-system service is unconfirmed. Mechanic to identify applicable system and manufacturer requirements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Next action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Independent inspection booked. Written safety and maintenance priorities requested; repairs not yet authorised.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Once actual work is completed, add its date, mileage, shop and invoice reference. Keep recommendations and completed services in separate lines. The [car maintenance log guide](/guides/car-maintenance-log-what-to-write-down) shows what to keep, and the [manual schedule guide](/guides/car-maintenance-by-mileage-start-with-your-manual) helps you avoid transferring another model's intervals to yours.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When the records do not turn up
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Is buying a car with no service history always a mistake?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Missing records alone do not prove poor maintenance, but they leave uncertainty that paperwork cannot remove. If you have not bought yet, arrange an independent inspection before deciding. If you already own it, focus on a qualified assessment and a documented baseline, not on inventing a reassuring past.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can a dealer find service history by VIN?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A dealer may have access to work recorded in its own or the manufacturer's systems, subject to availability and privacy rules. Ask what can be supplied for the vehicle and what it covers. A record from one network does not prove that no work happened at an independent shop.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can I use the date I bought the car as the last service date?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  No. Buying it establishes when you became the owner, not when oil, belts or other maintenance were last done. Record the purchase date separately. Use a documented service date when you have one, or keep the history unknown while agreeing the appropriate next action with a mechanic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                15
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Give the next owner a better starting point
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • A folder and a clear log are enough to begin. Keep what you can establish, label the rest, and add evidence as work happens. You are not trying to reconstruct every mile. You are trying to stop the next decision from starting with the same blank page.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • If you want one place for the dates and intervals you actually know, [Vehicle Maintenance Companion](/shop/vehicle-maintenance-companion) is an optional tool. It supports unknown history and records you enter; it does not connect to your car, retrieve a VIN history, choose the real factory schedule or diagnose a problem. The guide and worksheet remain useful without buying it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A report, a receipt, a recall check and an inspection answer different questions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Four evidence sources separate recorded service, reported history, recall information and present mechanical condition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A car maintenance log needs the full date, the odometer reading with units and a precise description of completed work. Put the vehicle identity at the top. Add the shop or DIY name and a receipt reference when you have them; costs and warranty notes are useful but optional.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • You may be starting with one oil-change receipt, a stack of invoices or no history at all. The job is not to recreate a perfect past. It is to make the next question answerable: which vehicle, what work, when, and what evidence supports the entry?
