                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make the header unambiguous
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write the year, make, model and a stable identifier such as the VIN or plate. A VIN is vehicle identity, not the same thing as your bank account or home address. It is useful when records might be separated from the car or compared with invoices. For two similar cars, add a familiar label without relying on the label alone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose miles or kilometers and write the unit in the header and wherever a reading might be copied elsewhere. Use dates with a year. An entry saying "Mar 3" will be ambiguous after several years, even if it feels obvious today.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Start the log with the next real fact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write the vehicle header and choose one master record: notebook, spreadsheet or app.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Copy the actual service date and odometer from the invoice. If either is missing, mark it unknown rather than substituting today.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Describe the action and location: inspected front brakes, replaced rear pads, or topped up washer fluid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Add the performer and receipt reference. Photograph receipts clearly enough to read the work and odometer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Store warranty terms with the relevant job and note where they can be found.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep recommendations in a separate pending-work list. Add a completion entry only when the work is actually done.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [Open the free vehicle service log starter](/guides/print/library/car-maintenance-log-what-to-write-down.html). Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Four anchors connect a vehicle identity, full date and odometer, completed action and supporting evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Costs and warranty notes can be added without obscuring the basic entry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Inspected is not replaced
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • "Brakes" does not tell the next shop whether anyone inspected them, fitted pads or replaced a component. Likewise, a receipt for a filter proves purchase, not installation. For DIY work, record the installation date, odometer, what you fitted and relevant part or fluid information from the actual purchase.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A finding can be recorded without pretending a repair happened: "2026-09-10, 53,200 mi, shop inspected rear tires; recommendation retained in invoice 310." Put a follow-up beside the pending jobs, not in a completed-work row. Do not turn an informal comment into a measurement the shop never provided.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Completed services, planned jobs and unknown history are shown as three distinct record types.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Buying a part or booking a visit is not a completed service.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Missing history and conflicting records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you remember an old service but have no date, keep it in a separate note marked "owner recollection, date unknown." You do not need to discard useful context, but it should not look like a verified entry. Ask the servicing shop whether it can supply an invoice or vehicle-specific history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If mileage runs backward or two invoices conflict, stop calculating future due points from those numbers. Check the vehicle identifier, units and whether an invoice contains a typing error. Retain the original and add a dated correction note rather than silently changing evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keep the summary and evidence together
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/0211-auto-repair-basics) advises obtaining a completed repair order with work, parts, charges and odometer information. Your log makes that paperwork searchable; it does not independently prove workmanship or replace the invoice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Choose a simple filing name such as "2026-08-02 battery invoice 260" and make a backup outside the car. A notebook left in the glove box should not be the only copy. When preparing to sell, make a buyer version that removes personal payment details while preserving vehicle and service information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does DIY maintenance belong in the log?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes. Record what you actually completed, not only the parts you bought. Add the date, odometer and parts or fluid details that matter. Keep the purchase evidence, while being clear that it does not independently verify installation or the quality of the work.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should I put the next due date in the same table?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You can, but label it as a plan and keep it distinct from completed work. Future intervals come from the correct manual and applicable conditions, not from the log itself. A completed row should remain understandable even if a planned service later changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How much old history should I reconstruct?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Start with records you can identify reliably, then stop. Mark the earliest supported point and any known gaps. A short honest history is more useful than a long list with invented dates. Keep uncertain recollections in notes rather than using them to calculate maintenance deadlines.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • US-focused administration; requirements and individual circumstances vary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Saved Reddit leads informed reader-language only; no anecdotes treated as factual authority. Quora was blocked in the saved research.

Product registry inspected, but live product workflows not tested.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Purpose and search evidence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      intent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Prepare a credible, privacy-conscious service-history handover for a private US car sale without price promises.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      supportingQueries
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • prepare car service records for buyer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • redact service invoices before selling car
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • sell car missing maintenance receipts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Give a prospective buyer a dated summary of maintenance and repairs, backed by the records you actually hold. Identify the car, state where the history starts, mark gaps, and remove personal information from copies. Service history is evidence to inspect, not a guarantee of condition or a promised increase in price.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A buyer looking through twenty receipts should not have to work out which car they belong to or whether "service" means a repair, inspection or oil change. Your summary is an index to those records. This guide covers that handover, not all legal duties involved in a private US vehicle sale.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Build the buyer copy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Gather invoices, your log, DIY records and any history inherited from earlier owners.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Check the VIN or other vehicle identifier on each document before including it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • List each completed job by full date, odometer with units, work performed and performer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Assign each supporting document a short reference and put copies in the same order as the summary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • State missing periods and unsupported recollections explicitly. Do not describe an incomplete file as a full history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Remove addresses, payment details and unrelated information from buyer copies; keep service dates, mileage and shop details legible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Retain your own copy of the handover and check official sale requirements separately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Evidence has different strengths
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A garage invoice documents what the garage recorded. Your own log documents what you wrote. A parts receipt documents a purchase. Keep those distinctions visible, especially for DIY work. Do not create a garage-style invoice for your own labor or imply that a receipt validates every related job.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Earlier-owner invoices can document work before your ownership. Describe them as supplied records, rather than work you personally witnessed. If a service is remembered but unsupported, say so. A gap means the file is incomplete; it does not establish that no maintenance happened.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shop invoices, owner logs and a present-day inspection answer different buyer questions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        None of these makes all three checks unnecessary.
