                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        History reports can include servicing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • [CARFAX describes](https://www.carfax.com/buying/how-to-read-a-carfax-report) reports containing reported maintenance, including oil changes and tire rotations. Do not tell a buyer that history reports never show routine servicing. Equally, a report is not a complete account of everything ever done to a vehicle. Compare it with the original documents and identify differences without inventing an explanation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A detailed file does not establish the car is fault-free today. Leave room for an independent inspection and keep current faults or unanswered questions separate from the historical record. Avoid language such as "nothing to hide" as a substitute for evidence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Where does the history start?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          These are the records I have from my purchase onward. Earlier work is not documented in this file.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Was this garage work?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          That entry is a DIY job. The log records what I did and the parts receipt is attached; it is not a shop certification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is the replacement part still under warranty?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The terms are attached. I have not confirmed transferability, so please do not assume the coverage transfers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Privacy and sale requirements are separate checks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Make copies before redacting. On a digital copy, use proper redaction rather than placing a movable black shape over text, then inspect the exported file. Do not alter the work description or hide a relevant vehicle fact under the excuse of privacy. If a shop needs to reissue an invoice, ask it to do so.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A service file does not replace title transfer, odometer disclosures, lien releases or other applicable sale requirements. Use [your state motor vehicle agency](https://www.usa.gov/state-motor-vehicle-services). [California DMV](https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/vehicle-registration/titles/title-transfers-and-changes/) is one example of separate transfer paperwork, not a rule for other states. If ownership, a lien or a mileage discrepancy is unresolved, pause the transaction and obtain the appropriate agency or legal guidance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Will good service records increase the selling price?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          They give a buyer evidence to evaluate and can make questions easier to answer. They do not produce a dependable price premium for every vehicle or market. Do not quote a percentage uplift without reliable evidence specific to the situation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I sell with missing service receipts?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Missing receipts do not by themselves establish whether a sale can proceed or what disclosures apply. Describe the history accurately, include supported facts and check local sale requirements. Do not claim full history or suggest that a buyer inspection excuses misleading statements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Should I give the buyer my original invoices?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Decide what originals need to travel with the car and retain copies for yourself. During enquiries, a redacted copy is usually more practical than giving strangers your only evidence. Warranty documents may have their own transfer requirements, so check the actual terms before promising coverage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A clear index helps the buyer inspect the supporting records.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A four-stage handover joins vehicle identity, a service summary, supporting evidence and a privacy review.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        None of these makes all three checks unnecessary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        alt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Use the manufacturer maintenance schedule for your exact year, model, powertrain and market. Copy each required action, its time or mileage rule and any conditions or footnotes. A universal 30,000-, 60,000- or 90,000-mile list cannot tell you which replacements your particular car needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The confusing part is rarely finding a number. It is knowing whether that number means inspect or replace, whether months also apply, and whether a footnote changes your situation. This guide helps you extract those instructions into a usable record. It does not supply a factory schedule or diagnose wear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Find the correct source before copying intervals
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identify the model year, engine or powertrain, country of sale and current odometer units.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Look on the manufacturer owner website for the manual and any separate maintenance or warranty booklet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Check that the document covers your version rather than a similar car or another market.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Read the maintenance symbols, footnotes and special-operating-condition definitions before extracting rows.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For each job, copy the action, interval, conditions and page reference. Keep any uncertainty visible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If a document is missing or contradictory, ask the manufacturer or its service department for written clarification specific to the vehicle.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Schedule-extraction table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Field
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • What to copy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Mistake to avoid
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Inspect, replace, adjust or another stated action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Treating an inspection as an automatic replacement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Trigger
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Distance, elapsed time, dashboard system or combined rule
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Adding a made-up time limit to a distance-only entry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Only the listed conditions relevant to that task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Shortening every interval because one severe-use item applies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Document title, version and page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Using an undated generic chart as the source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            An invented arithmetic example, not a car recommendation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Suppose a fictional manual says to replace a particular item after 10,000 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first. The supported last replacement was on 2026-02-10 at 40,000 miles. Its two possible thresholds are 50,000 miles and 2027-02-10. Reaching either would trigger the job under that fictional instruction. These numbers demonstrate reading and arithmetic only.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If the same manual says "inspect" another item at that point, the schedule calls for an inspection, not necessarily a new part. Record any subsequent finding separately. Never use the example interval as a placeholder while searching for your real one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time and distance are separate triggers when the actual maintenance instruction says whichever comes first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Only use both triggers where the manufacturer instruction specifies them.
