                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time, mileage and monitor-based systems
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • When the actual instruction uses both time and distance, retain both. A rarely driven car can reach a time threshold before a distance threshold. A high-mileage driver may do the reverse. If the instructions specify an initial service followed by a different repeat interval, preserve that distinction too.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Some vehicles use service-reminder systems. Consult the manual for the displayed code, additional required tasks and any maximum elapsed-time provisions. Do not reset a reminder merely to clear the display, and do not assume an oil-life percentage is a report on every maintenance item. [California BAR](https://www.bar.ca.gov/auto-repairs) directs owners to consult the manual when reminders appear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            9
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Special conditions need item-by-item reading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Towing, dust, temperature and short-trip definitions vary. Match your actual use to the document wording, then identify which tasks change. A hard-use rule for one fluid does not establish a shorter interval for every filter and component. Halving all intervals is not a manufacturer-validated substitute.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/0211-auto-repair-basics) recommends comparing a shop schedule with the manufacturer instructions and asking why extra service is proposed. A shop may have a vehicle-specific reason; ask for the reason, the finding and the price rather than assuming either document is automatically wrong.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Safety checks do not wait for a mileage milestone
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • [NHTSA tire guidance](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires) calls for checking cold tire pressure at least monthly, using the vehicle placard or manual, not the sidewall maximum. This is separate from scheduled rotation. A visible tire problem, warning light or change in braking also should not wait for the next round-number service.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If the history is unknown, the schedule tells you what the manufacturer requires, not what the former owner completed. Keep those questions separate. Use the [missing-records guide](/guides/used-car-no-service-records-what-to-do) for establishing a baseline rather than filling the last-done column with guesses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What maintenance is required at 60,000 miles?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Read the schedule for your exact vehicle and check the previous completed work. The answer may include inspections, replacements or repeat tasks from earlier intervals. There is no reliable universal list for all engines, transmissions, model years and markets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Should I use miles or months?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Use the rule stated for each job in your own schedule. Where it says whichever comes first, retain both thresholds. Where a monitor or a special first-service instruction applies, preserve that wording instead of forcing it into a simple mileage-only tracker.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What if I cannot find my manual?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Ask the manufacturer or its service department for the correct owner and maintenance documents using the vehicle identity. Record the request and unresolved tasks. Do not quietly substitute an unrelated model schedule or a generic online replacement chart.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Compare the actual reading with the stated distance threshold.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Time
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Compare the current date with the elapsed-time threshold.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Decision
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Act when either applicable threshold is reached.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Only use both triggers where the manufacturer instruction specifies them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Time and distance are separate triggers when the actual maintenance instruction says whichever comes first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • US-focused administration; requirements and individual circumstances vary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Saved Reddit leads informed reader-language only; no anecdotes treated as factual authority. Product registry inspected, but live product workflows not tested.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Before freezing weather arrives, check the tires, visibility equipment, starting system, correct fluids and emergency supplies. Book help for checks you cannot perform safely. Record the result and any unresolved problem, rather than ticking off a system simply because it looked normal.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The first icy morning is a poor time to discover that the washer fluid freezes or the defroster does not clear the glass. Choose a practical check date ahead of your local cold season, not a fixed national month. This is a preparation list, not a repair manual or permission to travel in dangerous conditions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A pre-freeze check you can work through
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check tire condition and cold pressure against the vehicle placard. Ask a tire professional about damage, uneven wear or suitability for the routes you drive.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Test headlights, brake lights, turn signals, hazards, wipers, washers and glass-clearing functions. Resolve visibility problems before travel.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Ask for a starting-battery and charging-system assessment if appropriate, especially after slow starting or other concerns. Keep the test result.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check coolant and washer-fluid requirements in the manual. Have freeze protection assessed when uncertain; a visible level alone does not establish protection.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Locate the scraper, brush, blankets, flashlight, charging cable, water, food and the vehicle-appropriate recovery supplies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check the forecast and road authority advice before a trip. Allow for delay, closures and a decision not to go.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                What your record should distinguish

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Useful result

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Assuming all tires match because one reading did
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Battery
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Dated test result and any advice
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Assuming a test predicts the whole winter

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Choose tires for the actual route
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires) distinguishes winter, all-season and summer tires; the appropriate choice depends on conditions. Before asking a shop, note typical temperatures, snow or ice exposure, hills, journey frequency and the tires currently fitted. Confirm approved sizes and local chain or traction requirements with the relevant road authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Do not treat the tire-pressure warning lamp as a complete pressure inspection. Retain actual cold readings in your record. A damaged tire, persistent pressure loss or a serious driving concern needs assessment rather than a future calendar reminder.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A fluid-level observation does not establish freeze protection.
