                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Before you drive away
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Confirm with the insurer when cover is effective for this exact car and who is covered to drive it. Do not rely on the seller's assurance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Verify your license or permit conditions and the applicable registration, transfer or temporary-driving requirements through the official agency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Match the vehicle identifier on the car with the papers. Pause if ownership or identity is inconsistent.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Locate the lights, wipers, defroster, hazards and parking brake while parked. Adjust the seat and mirrors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Read the manual response to any warning or safety concern before driving. Arrange suitable help if safe operation is uncertain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Make sure you can obtain roadside assistance if needed and know what access or key arrangements exist.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  First-week priorities, not legal deadlines
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Task
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Useful result
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Before driving
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Confirm cover, permission and safe operation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Specific status confirmed rather than assumed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • At handover
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Check identity, keys and supplied documents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • List of what was received and what is missing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • As soon as possible
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Establish the official transfer process and deadlines
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Named owner and actual agency requirements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • During week one
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Find manual, check vehicle-specific basics and history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Baseline page with honest unknowns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Next
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Arrange outstanding inspections or service questions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A booked action, not a vague intention
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Invented example: Saturday collection
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A fictional buyer plans to collect a used hatchback on Saturday. On Friday they ask the insurer about the exact start of cover, check the state transfer instructions and ask the seller which documents and keys will be handed over. The buyer does not wait until the journey home to make the insurance call.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • At collection the VIN on one document does not match the car. The buyer pauses the handover and asks for clarification through the appropriate seller and agency routes. A nice folder and a promise to fix it later are not enough to resolve the identity problem.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Build a baseline without inventing a service history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Record the acquisition date, odometer with units, vehicle identity, keys received and location of the papers. Add the correct manual link and supported service records. "Last oil change unknown" is a usable fact; "probably done before sale" is not a completed-service entry.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you bought without an independent inspection, arrange an appropriate assessment of outstanding concerns. A vehicle history report and a seller's statement do not remove the need to investigate current problems. The [missing service-records guide](/guides/used-car-no-service-records-what-to-do) handles that specific situation in more detail.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A new owner baseline separates vehicle identity, received records and unresolved history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A clear unknown is a better starting point than assumed maintenance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Learn the car before adding accessories
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check the manual for warning indicators, fuel or charging requirements, maintenance documents and recovery guidance. Locate any spare wheel, inflation kit or other equipment actually supplied, without assuming you should use it on a dangerous roadside or without knowing the procedure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For tire pressure, [NHTSA](https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires) specifies cold checks at least monthly and the vehicle placard or manual pressure. Record your car's information rather than copying another driver's number. A tire problem or persistent warning needs assessment, not only a reminder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Paperwork and recall checks
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use [your state motor vehicle agency](https://www.usa.gov/state-motor-vehicle-services) to establish who submits the transfer, what is needed and when it is due. Dealer involvement is not evidence that every step is already complete; obtain confirmation of responsibilities and status.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Check the vehicle through [NHTSA's recall lookup](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls) and follow the specific manufacturer instructions for any result. Record when you checked and any follow-up. A recall search is not a comprehensive mechanical inspection or a guarantee that every issue is resolved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Stop points for a new owner
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not drive simply to see whether a serious warning will disappear. Stop and obtain appropriate advice for unresolved driving legality, vehicle identity, braking or steering concerns, or a warning that the manual says requires stopping. Do not delay those questions until the end of an arbitrary first week.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Optional upgrades can wait while you establish the basics. Keep a small current document folder, a known roadside contact and one service log. Those records make the second week easier without requiring you to become a mechanic on the first day.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should I call insurance before or after collecting the car?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Confirm the effective cover and covered drivers before driving it. Ask the insurer how its terms apply to your exact situation rather than assuming an existing policy automatically covers any purchase. If status is uncertain, resolve it before arranging the journey.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Do I need to complete everything within seven days?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No universal seven-day rule is being stated. Some tasks belong before driving, while transfer and registration deadlines depend on the jurisdiction. The first-week structure is an organizing aid. Check official deadlines immediately and do not postpone urgent safety questions to fit the schedule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if the car comes with no manual or receipts?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Find the manufacturer documents for the correct model year and powertrain, and record the history as unknown where appropriate. Begin a dated log now. Seek vehicle-specific assessment rather than filling gaps with generic replacement intervals or assuming the seller recently serviced everything.
