                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Put one dated summary per person in a family medical binder: identity, allergies and known reactions, current medicines, relevant conditions, clinicians, pharmacy, emergency contacts and insurance details where needed. Keep vaccination records and important documents alongside or referenced by location. Make separate copies for particular readers rather than handing everyone the full binder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The repeated questions tend to arrive at awkward moments: a new dentist asks about medicines while a school form asks for an official vaccine record. A binder should help you find the answer and its source. It should not turn into a second clinical record that appears more authoritative than the information behind it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A master record is not a handout
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This guide covers US household record organization, not medical decisions. A home summary does not diagnose symptoms, check doses or replace clinic forms. You can use paper, a secure digital record or both. The important distinction is between a working summary you maintain and original documents issued by someone else.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep each person separate even when names, doctors or insurance plans overlap. Put the full name and another appropriate identifier on each page. A shared household calendar can coordinate appointments, but it should not merge two people's allergies or medicine lists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A useful section map
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • What belongs there
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Source or check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Identity, allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Person, clinician instructions and current records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Medicines
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Names, strengths, actual use and unresolved differences
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current labels plus confirmed changes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Documents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Reports, discharge instructions, official forms and care plans
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Issuing clinician or organization
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Vaccines
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Official record and any working index
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Provider or relevant registry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Administration
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Insurance, permissions and document locations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current card or issuing office
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Visits
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Questions, dated notes and next actions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Your notes clearly distinguished from clinician instructions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Build the first usable version
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask each adult what information they want help keeping and who may see it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Create a separate summary for each person with a checked date and the name of whoever checked it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Start with current safety-relevant facts and contacts, not the entire history. Do not postpone known allergy information until the end.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Collect the medication information and mark any disagreement for pharmacist or prescriber review.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Request missing official records rather than recreating vaccination dates or test results from memory.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write where the source documents live and how an authorized helper can obtain them.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose one master, a backup and a replacement process for handed-out copies.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A family medical record separates a current summary, source documents and recipient-specific handouts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A concise summary is not a replacement for the document behind it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Invented example: one folder, two different outputs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A fictional household keeps Maya's summary and her father Ben's summary in separate sections. Maya needs a school form; Ben has a new-clinic visit. The household uses Maya's official vaccine record for the school packet and Ben's current medication list for his intake. It does not copy Maya's details onto Ben's page just because both share an insurer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The school packet does not include Ben's records at all. Maya's sitter receives current handover information and the relevant clinician plan, not a copy of the family archive. The master binder remains the place to check facts, not the default attachment to every message.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A changed health fact is confirmed, updated in the master and replaced in relevant handouts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Date the section actually checked, not unrelated records.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep source documents, not just copied answers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A summary is a route into the evidence. Keep a report when its exact wording matters and note the issuer and date. You may file paper documents in the binder or reference secure digital copies, depending on access needs. There is no rule that an insurance card image or test result can never belong in a binder; choose protected storage and a usable index.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines-children/records/index.html) says it does not hold individual vaccination records and directs families toward providers and relevant registries. If the record is incomplete, label it incomplete and ask the appropriate provider what to do. Do not turn your typed vaccine list into an official certificate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Update changed facts and retire stale copies
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Date each section when checked rather than stamping the entire file current after editing one phone number. A medication change should trigger review of the medicine section and any copies that show it. An insurance change affects forms and administrative copies. These triggers are more useful than assuming every family member's record changes at the same rate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep old clinical instructions and stopped-medication history identifiable where needed, but separate them from the active summary. Use a clear superseded label for retained copies. Tell a regular caregiver which version replaces the previous handout and check that they can find it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
