                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          What authorization and packaging do you require for this product, and who should receive it on arrival?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Clinic office
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          I have the current form and its deadline. Can you tell me what records or appointment you need before completing your section?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          An unfamiliar history question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          I do not know the exact date. What supporting record is needed, and how should I mark that uncertainty now?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Privacy and broad history requests
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Provide the relevant safety and participation information accurately. If a request is unclear or unusually broad, ask what is required, why it is needed, who can access it and what secure channel to use. Do not silently omit a relevant condition because it is absent from one small box; ask the designated health professional how to supply context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • [HHS student-record guidance](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/special-topics/ferpa-hipaa/index.html) explains that FERPA and HIPAA application depends on the setting and record holder. A school health form is not automatically protected in exactly the same way as a doctor's record. Ask the actual organization rather than relying on a general privacy label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Before the child arrives
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Read the final packet for the right name, dates, signatures and attachments. Confirm any conditions or follow-up requested by the program and replace changed information. An unsigned or incomplete form should not be made to look complete by attaching an unrelated summary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • If the clinic or program cannot meet the deadline, ask about the actual options before assuming attendance is permitted. Do not alter dates, copy a signature or treat an old clearance as current. Where a care arrangement remains unclear, resolve it with the program and clinician before handover.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Does every camp health form need a new physical?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          No universal rule is stated here. Check the actual packet for the examination or clinician documentation it requires, including timing and acceptable signers. Ask the clinic before booking if the requirement is unclear. Do not assume another program's rule applies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Can I complete the provider section myself?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          You can supply requested history and prepare your own sections, but do not sign or certify on behalf of a clinician. Give the clinic the actual current form and any requested supporting records. Ask which fields they expect you to complete first.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Is sending the form enough?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Not always. Keep proof of submission and ask how the program communicates missing items or acceptance. A delivered email or uploaded file does not by itself establish that signatures, records and care arrangements meet the program's requirements.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • US-focused; actual state, school and camp requirements must be checked with the program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ACA source PDF returned 403 during this pass, so no claim that every form has the ACA structure or that its exact instructions were reverified.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Saved research includes program-specific examples only; no national examination validity period or medication rule inferred.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Quora was blocked in saved research. No keyword-volume or ranking claims.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Leave the sitter the child's identity, your location and return plan, the care address, two reachable contacts, relevant allergies and existing care instructions, and a short routine. Review the sheet together before leaving. Medicine names alone are not permission or sufficient instructions to give a medicine.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A familiar grandparent may know the bedtime story and still have last month's information about a changed medicine or food restriction. A new sitter may know neither. The sheet should carry the current handover for these hours, supported by a conversation and any clinician plan that applies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What this page is for
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This is US-focused childcare administration, not guidance on diagnosing illness or giving treatment. It does not replace first-aid training, a clinician's plan, or legally required permissions. If a care task is outside the sitter's training or comfort, resolve that before the arrangement begins rather than relying on a detailed note.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Keep one child's health information clearly distinguishable from a sibling's. A shared house page can show the address and escape arrangements, while individual pages identify the child and relevant instructions. Do not let saving paper make it unclear who an allergy or medicine belongs to.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Prepare the handover before the doorbell
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write the exact care address, unit or access details and a useful location description for an emergency call.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Add your current contact, where you will be, when you expect to return and an agreed backup adult.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Identify each child and the current allergies or other facts relevant to safe care. Mark uncertainties for clarification, not interpretation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Provide any clinician-written plan the sitter needs and arrange appropriate instruction for its use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • If any medicine may be given, confirm the authorized instructions and labeled product, last administration information where needed, and a way to record what was given.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write relevant meals, sleep, comfort and house routines in ordinary words.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Show the sitter the sheet, supplies and emergency arrangements, then ask what remains unclear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ordered

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • [Open the free sitter or grandparent handover for this visit](/guides/print/library/babysitter-and-grandparent-info-sheet.html). Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A childcare handover includes a current page, a shared walkthrough, clarification and direct updates.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A printed note alone cannot establish caregiver readiness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Invented handover: an evening with one child
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example content without treatment directions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Identity and location
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Noah; care at the address written on the actual handover
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Contact plan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Parent at a nearby event until 10 p.m.; backup adult has agreed to answer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Relevant health information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Current clinician plan in the named folder; sitter has reviewed it with parent
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Medicine boundary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • No routine dose scheduled during this visit; any existing emergency plan reviewed separately
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Routine
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Dinner already eaten; bedtime story and hall light at bedtime
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Open issue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Parent checks backup number before departure
