                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What should I bring to a doctor's appointment?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Your questions, with the most important marked. A phone note is fine if you can find it quickly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Your current medicine and supplement list, including doses and frequency, plus allergies and reactions. Bring labels or bottles if the clinic requests them or the list is uncertain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Relevant records or results the clinic does not already have. Check before carrying an entire folder or paying for copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Photo ID, insurance details, referral or authorization if required. Check the appointment message for location, time and any specific preparation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pharmacy contact details, reading glasses or hearing support if used, and a way to write down the plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A support person if you want one and the clinic allows it. Agree beforehand whether they will take notes, help explain something, or simply be there.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not change medicines, stop eating or prepare for tests based on a general checklist. Follow the instructions for your appointment and ask the clinic if anything is unclear. AHRQ recommends bringing information about medicines and speaking up about questions; see its [patient fact sheet](https://www.ahrq.gov/questions/resources/20-tips.html).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  What to say when the appointment starts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    You have several concerns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I have a few things written down. This is the one I most need help with today. Can we decide what we can cover and what needs another appointment?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Worried about forgetting
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I made a note because I lose track when I am here. Is it okay if I read the short version?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The plan is unclear
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I say that back to check I have it right? And could you write down what I should do next?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A filled example: the note, not a diagnosis
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  intro
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  An invented adult follow-up. Notice that it records a question rather than recommending a change in treatment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Part of the page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example wording
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Main concern
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Since my last visit, I am struggling to keep to the plan. Can we talk through what is getting in the way?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What changed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • I changed work hours about two weeks ago. I have missed parts of the routine since then.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What I want to ask
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Which part should I prioritize? What should I do if I miss it again?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What I take
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Attach my current list, checked against the labels today. Do not fill this from memory.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • After the conversation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Write the agreed plan in the clinician's words. Note who to contact with questions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  compare
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Adjust the checklist for your visit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  left
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  New doctor or a child's visit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For a new doctor, ask how to transfer relevant records. Add history and prior results requested by the clinic; see [what to bring to a new doctor](/guides/new-doctor-intake-what-to-bring).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For a child, bring the current medicine and allergy details and any forms requested. Make room for what the child wants to say, too.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  right
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Video visit or helping a relative
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For a video appointment, check the link, sound and connection ahead of time. Keep your notes nearby and use a private space where possible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When helping a relative, ask what they want you to discuss. Check consent or authorization requirements with the clinic rather than assuming being family is enough.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Before you leave, get the next step out of your head
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What do I need to do next, and why? Ask for the plan in language you understand.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If there are tests, when and how should I expect the results? Who do I contact if they do not arrive?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If anything changes, who should I contact and how urgently? Ask the clinician for guidance specific to your situation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The Institute for Healthcare Improvement's [Ask Me 3](https://www.ihi.org/library/tools/ask-me-3-good-questions-your-good-health) is a useful fallback: understand the main problem, what to do and why it matters. You do not have to phrase your own questions perfectly. You need an answer you can use when you get home.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  When preparation is not straightforward
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if I have too many questions for one doctor visit?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Bring the full list, but mark the one that matters most. At the start, ask what can realistically be covered and how to arrange the rest. A longer page cannot create more appointment time. A second visit or another contact route may be needed; agree that with the clinic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I prepare for an appointment without a printer?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes. Use a phone note, a notebook or a plain sheet of paper. Put your main concern, dated changes, medicines and questions in separate short sections. Leave room for answers. The free printable is a convenience, not a requirement, and you do not need an account to use it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should I record the doctor's appointment?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Ask the clinician and anyone present before recording, and check local rules and clinic policy. Do not assume permission. If recording is not an option, take short notes, bring an agreed support person or request written instructions. Keep anything containing personal health information somewhere you control.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keep the next visit from starting at zero
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Afterward, date the page and put it somewhere you will actually look next time. A folder works. So does a private note on your device. The useful thing is being able to find what was agreed, not owning a particular system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you are keeping track of several people's visits, medicines and questions, the [Draftpace Family Health Binder](/shop/family-health-binder) is an option worth looking at. Check its current features and choose it only if it fits how you work. The checklist and [free appointment sheet](/guides/print/doctor-appointment.html) are yours to use either way.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • You do not need to arrive as the most organized person in the waiting room. Bring the question you came for. Leave with the next step written down.
