                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write one question per line, put your main concern first and show the clinician the whole list near the start. Leave space for the answer and next action. Keep lower-priority questions visible rather than hiding them because the appointment is short; the clinician can help decide what needs attention now.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A phone note saying "test, tired, prescription, form" contains useful concerns but not yet usable questions. You do not need medical vocabulary. You need enough context that the clinician understands what you are asking and what you are trying to decide.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Questions are preparation, not self-triage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • This guide is about communicating at a medical appointment for yourself or someone you support. It does not decide which symptom is urgent, which test is necessary or which treatment to choose. If something changes before the visit or you are uncertain whether waiting is safe, contact the clinic through its appropriate advice route.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For an emergency, get urgent help rather than refining the list. In the US, call 911 for a suspected life-threatening emergency. [MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm) describes emergency warning signs; no short writing guide can provide a complete assessment for every age and situation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Turn the notes into a usable page
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write the visit date, the person's name and the main reason for the appointment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Collect concerns without trying to answer them yourself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Turn each concern into a question with enough context: what changed, when, or what decision needs explanation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Mark your main concern, then show the complete list so the clinician can assess priorities too.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Separate administrative questions from clinical ones, while noting any real deadline.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Leave room for the answer, responsible person, timing and contact route.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Bring relevant symptom notes or medication information rather than embedding the whole record in every question.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Original reminder
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Question to bring

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Test results
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • What do these results mean for the next step, and is anything still outstanding?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Prescription confusion
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • My printed list and recent instructions differ. Can we confirm the current instructions and update the record?

What should I know about activity and follow-up?

Who should handle it and what information is needed?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ask for decisions you can understand
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A useful question does not have to force a one-sentence answer. "What are the options and what are the tradeoffs for me?" may need discussion. For a proposed test, ask what question it is intended to answer, what preparation is required and how results will reach you. For an instruction, ask what to do if following it is difficult.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [AHRQ](https://www.ahrq.gov/questions/be-engaged/index.html) recommends preparing questions, checking understanding and asking about next steps. Use that as permission to speak plainly, not as a promise that a particular list will produce a particular outcome. The clinician still needs to assess the actual concern.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I wrote down my concerns so I do not miss them. This is the main one, and here is the rest of the list.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Can I say back what I understood so you can correct anything I missed?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    An unfamiliar term
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Please explain that in ordinary words and write the important name or instruction down.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    I am not sure I can follow that plan because of this obstacle. What should we arrange instead?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Which questions need another visit or message, and who should I contact about them?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Record the answer as an action, not a verdict
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Under each question, write the explanation and the agreed next step. If a test is planned, record who arranges it, the expected route for results and what to do if nothing arrives. If a decision is deferred, write that it is deferred and what information is still needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Do not write "all fine" when the actual answer includes a follow-up condition or an unresolved issue. Equally, distinguish your interpretation from the clinician's words. If you do not understand a phrase, ask before turning it into a confident note that another caregiver may later treat as an instruction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Long lists and difficult conversations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • You can bring more questions than fit into one visit, but tell the clinic if you need several issues addressed and ask about suitable booking arrangements. Do not silently drop a concern that might change clinical priorities. Showing the whole list makes the limits visible; it does not obligate the clinician to complete every topic immediately.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If you need an interpreter, accessible communication or a support person, ask in advance how to arrange that. A companion can help with notes, but should not replace the patient's own voice. Ask about privacy for any topic you prefer to discuss without them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  After the appointment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Review the notes while the conversation is fresh and compare them with any written visit instructions. If they differ, ask the clinic to clarify rather than choosing whichever version is easier. Put a specific follow-up task in your calendar only when it reflects the agreed plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use the clinic's stated route for remaining questions and ask how urgent concerns should be handled. A portal message is not necessarily monitored continuously. If you become worried about a change, seek the appropriate advice rather than waiting for the next scheduled visit or a response to a nonurgent message.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How many questions should I bring?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    There is no reliable universal limit. Bring the full list, identify your main concern and ask which topics can be handled in this visit. If there are several substantial issues, discuss booking needs with the clinic. Do not omit a potentially important concern merely to hit a number.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Is it okay to read directly from my phone?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Yes, a paper or phone list can support communication. Choose a form you can find and read easily during the visit. Keep it accessible without searching through unrelated notes, and leave a way to record the answer and follow-up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    What if I only think of the question afterward?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Write it down and use the clinic's agreed contact route. Include the visit date and enough context to identify the issue. If you are uncertain whether it can wait, ask the appropriate clinical advice service; do not assume ordinary messaging is suitable for an emergency.
