                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Keep one current list per person with every medicine and supplement used, its name and strength, the instructions, and how the person actually takes it. Include occasional products. Date the check, record allergies or reported reactions separately, and ask a pharmacist or prescriber to resolve any disagreement rather than choosing a dose yourself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The difficult question is often not "what is the name?" but "which instruction is current?" A bottle, discharge paper and clinic portal may show different information. Your list should make that difference visible. It is a communication tool, not a prescription, interaction checker or medication-administration record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Start from the products and current instructions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Collect labels, current written instructions and any recent change notices. Ask the person what they actually use, including products kept outside the usual medicine cupboard. Do not gather someone else's medicines into the same row because the packaging looks similar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The [FDA medication-list guidance](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/consumer-updates/create-and-keep-medication-list-your-health) includes prescription medicines, nonprescription products, vitamins and supplements. A product being available without prescription does not make it irrelevant to the list. Keep enough information for a professional to identify it accurately.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Build and check the list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Identify the person and write the date of this check. Name who helped check it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record each medicine or supplement by its actual label name and strength or concentration. Include the form where it helps identify the product.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Copy the current instructions for amount, route, timing and any relevant conditions without converting units yourself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write actual use separately if it differs from the instruction. Do not conceal missed use or self-directed changes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Add the prescriber or relevant contact and the purpose if confirmed; mark unknown information as unknown.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Separate active, stopped and uncertain entries. Retain useful change history without making stopped items look current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Bring unresolved differences to the pharmacist or prescriber and update copies after clarification.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A medication record separates product identity, confirmed instructions, actual use and current status.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A product strength alone does not describe the complete directions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      table
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Invented record structure: no treatment instructions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Field
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Example of what to record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Product identity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Exact name, form and strength from the actual label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current instruction source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Dated clinician instruction or pharmacy label reference
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Actual use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Person reports following the current directions, or describes the difference
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current, stopped on confirmed date, or awaiting clarification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Recent discharge paper differs from bottle directions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Resolution
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Pharmacist or prescriber confirms the instruction; date and contact recorded
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Strength and dose are not interchangeable labels
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A product's strength or concentration describes the product. The amount taken and when it is taken are separate pieces of information. A row that records only a strength does not necessarily say how much the person uses. Likewise, writing only "one" without the product form or unit may be unclear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This guide deliberately avoids filled examples with drug doses. Copy the real information for the actual person and ask the pharmacist to clarify unfamiliar wording. Do not derive a child's amount from an adult example, change liquid units, or identify a medicine solely by color or shape.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Occasional use and stopped items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • For something used only occasionally, preserve the relevant confirmed instructions and describe actual recent use when useful to the clinical conversation. Do not turn "when needed" into an invented daily schedule. If you are not sure whether a product remains part of the current plan, flag that uncertainty instead of deleting it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • When a clinician stops or changes a medicine, record the source and date. Move the prior entry out of the active section without losing the history needed to explain the change. A list of current products answers a different question from a record of every administration; keep those tools distinct.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Conflicting medication records are gathered, professionally clarified, updated and replaced in active copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Neither a bottle nor a portal should be treated as infallible when records disagree.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      width

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      When the bottle, portal and discharge page disagree
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A label is valuable evidence, but it can be older than a later instruction. A portal can also contain outdated entries. Do not apply a blanket rule that the bottle always wins or that the newest-looking screen is always right. Show the conflicting sources and ask the pharmacist or prescriber which instruction applies now.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [FDA pharmacist advice](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/information-consumers-and-patients-drugs/stop-learn-go-tips-talking-your-pharmacist-learn-how-use-medicines-safely) asks people to describe actual use, stopped products and problems or reactions. State exactly what differs. If a decision about the next administration is imminent, obtain appropriate clinical advice promptly rather than treating the discrepancy as a filing task for later.

Here are the product details and what has actually been taken. Please confirm the current directions.

Can you explain that and help me complete the list?

Where can I get the updated written instruction?
