                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep reactions and copies accurate
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Record the substance, the observed reaction and any uncertainty about its classification. Do not diagnose an allergy from a symptom or remove an allergy label on your own. Bring uncertain histories to the clinical team so the record can be clarified.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Choose one master list, then make dated copies for visits and agreed caregivers. Review the affected entries after changes, replace stale active copies and keep retained history identifiable. An old copy should not look newly checked because you changed only the page heading.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What the list cannot do
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It cannot decide whether two products interact, whether a dose is suitable or whether a medicine should be started, stopped or restarted. It also cannot establish that someone took a medicine at a particular time. Those are different clinical or recording questions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • If an error, concerning reaction or urgent medication question may have occurred, seek the appropriate professional or emergency help rather than relying on this article. Bring the available labels and information, but do not delay help to make the list complete.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I include inhalers, creams and supplements?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Include the products the person actually uses, not only regular tablets. Record enough label information to identify them and show the list to the relevant health professional. Do not decide that a product is unimportant solely because it is topical, occasional or nonprescription.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if the printed list does not match the bottle?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep both sources and ask the pharmacist or prescriber to resolve the difference. A bottle may be outdated after a later instruction, and a printed list can be stale too. This article cannot select the correct treatment direction from conflicting records.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Is a medicine list the same as a dose checklist?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        No. The list describes current products and instructions. A dose or administration record tracks what was actually given and when, with a process appropriate to the care arrangement. Keeping the distinction clear prevents a planned instruction from being mistaken for a completed administration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not let one number stand for everything
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Identity
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Record the product name, form and strength.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Instructions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep amount, route and timing from the confirmed source.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Actual use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Record any difference or uncertainty honestly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Status
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Show whether the entry is current, stopped or unresolved.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A product strength alone does not describe the complete directions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A medication record separates product identity, confirmed instructions, actual use and current status.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      record

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Organize the question without choosing a dose

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Gather
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Keep both conflicting sources and actual-use details.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Obtain clarification from the pharmacist or prescriber.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Update
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Record the confirmed instruction and its date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Replace
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Update relevant copies without losing useful history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Neither a bottle nor a portal should be treated as infallible when records disagree.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Conflicting medication records are gathered, professionally clarified, updated and replaced in active copies.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Symptom notes for a doctor visit: what to record

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          before
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Four notes help a doctor most: when it started, how long it lasted, how bad it was and what helped. A notes page, not a symptom checker.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          after
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Record what happened, when it began, how long it lasted and its effect on daily life. Keep observations distinct from guesses and seek help when needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Write what happened, when it first started, how long each episode lasted and how it affected ordinary activities. Note relevant context and what you tried without assuming the cause. Bring a short summary plus the dated entries to the appointment. A log does not tell you whether it is safe to wait.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Sometime last week" is an understandable answer when several days blur together. Even a few dated observations can help separate the first symptom from the day you started writing. You do not need a perfect diary or a medical label before contacting the clinic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Safety comes before the notes
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This is a communication guide, not a symptom checker or advice to monitor a condition at home. If you are unsure whether a symptom needs attention, contact the appropriate clinical advice service. Do not wait to collect several days of data before asking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For a suspected emergency in the US, call 911. [MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm) includes trouble breathing, unconsciousness and serious changes in responsiveness among emergency warning signs, with age-specific examples. These examples are not an exhaustive list, and absence from a short list does not establish safety.
