                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Observation before interpretation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              When
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Separate onset, episode time and entry date.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              What
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Describe the symptom and its duration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Impact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Record the effect on ordinary activities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Context
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Note circumstances and relevant actions without assuming cause.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Uncertain timing should remain labelled approximate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A symptom entry connects timing, description, daily impact and context while keeping cause unconfirmed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            record

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • title
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            From entries to appointment summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Keep the originals available
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Collect
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Write dated observations when feasible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Summarize
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Identify onset, change and impact in a few lines.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Ask
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Bring the question and original entries to the clinician.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Do not wait to finish a log before seeking needed help.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Dated observations become a short appointment summary and a question for the clinician.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Recordkeeping only; no diagnosis, monitoring schedule or waiting period is prescribed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • NIA indexed content supports preparing symptom notes; direct page fetch returned 405. MedlinePlus emergency page was accessible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The example is invented and is not a clinical pattern or recommendation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Saved research was reviewed for user intent; Quora blocked. Search volume unknown.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • An emergency contact information sheet should identify the person and relevant location, state how to obtain emergency help, list a first and backup contact, and provide concise current health information or its location. Add a checked date and tell the people who may need it where it is. A contact listing does not appoint a medical decision-maker.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The sheet has to work for someone who did not write it. They may know the person but not the apartment number, or know the address but not which relative can answer during work. Make those questions explicit rather than assuming the reader shares your household knowledge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Emergency help comes before family notifications
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For a suspected life-threatening emergency in the US, call 911. Do not make a family contact a mandatory first approval step. [MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001927.htm) recommends accessible emergency numbers and describes warning signs including trouble breathing and unconsciousness. This guide is not a complete triage tool.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • An emergency page is supporting information, not a diagnosis, treatment plan or promise that responders will find it. Get help first. If the page is immediately available, it can help with identification and contact details without delaying the call.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Build the working sheet
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Write the person's name and enough identification for the intended setting. Keep different people's pages separate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For a home or care location, write the exact address, unit and necessary location details rather than relying on phone location alone.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Label the emergency-help route for the place where the sheet will be used. This guide's 911 wording is US-focused.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask the first and backup contacts whether they are willing, reachable and suitable for the role.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • List phone numbers with area codes and clear relationship labels; add country codes where relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Add current safety-relevant facts and the location of a checked medication list or clinician plan.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Date the check, choose a findable but appropriate location and tell regular helpers about it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Do not delay an emergency call while seeking family approval.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Field
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • What the household records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Person and location
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Elena; actual home address and unit written on her real sheet
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Emergency route
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • US emergency instruction stated separately from family contact order
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • First contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Brother, mobile number checked directly with him
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Backup contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Neighbor who agreed to help; number checked
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Health information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Current list and clinician documents in the identified folder
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Authority documents
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Named role and document location recorded separately, if established

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A contact is a person to notify, not a legal appointment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use relationship labels that describe reality: partner, sister, neighbor or friend. If someone also has a legal role, identify that separately and note the document location. Do not write "next of kin decides everything" or assume the nearest relative automatically has unlimited authority.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • [HHS guidance](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/faq/under-hipaa-when-can-a-family-member/index.html) distinguishes a personal representative under applicable law from a family member involved in care. This page cannot determine the legal role in a particular case. Ask the clinical team or a qualified local adviser about required documents and authority.
