                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Make health information concise without making it misleading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Keep current allergies or reported reactions clearly identified, with relevant uncertainties. Where a full medication list is needed, provide it or say where the current copy can be found. Do not abbreviate a product into an unrecognizable nickname, invent instructions or imply that a short selection is a complete medical history.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If there is an existing clinician plan, identify it as that document and keep an accessible copy as appropriate. A contact sheet should not become a homemade substitute for emergency treatment instructions. For a longer form or intake, take the supporting records rather than expecting a small summary to answer every clinical question.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Test whether another person can use it
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ask a regular helper to find the location, contact order and document reference without prompting. You are checking the sheet, not testing their memory. If they need to unlock your phone or search your private messages, decide whether that access will actually be available in the situation you are planning for.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A paper copy can fail through being hidden, outdated or exposed to unnecessary readers. A digital copy can fail through access problems or an uncharged device. Choose a practical combination for the people involved. Do not assume a sheet is a wearable medical ID or appears on a locked screen.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  scripts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Check the arrangement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Asking a contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    May I list you as my backup contact? Here is what I mean by that, and here is who else is listed. What number and availability should I write?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Showing a helper
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The emergency-help instruction comes first. These are the people to notify, and this is where the current supporting information is.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Separating authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    This name is a contact for notification. Any legal decision-making role is recorded separately with the relevant documents.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Copies, privacy and changed facts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Use only the identifiers the intended reader needs. A home notice does not need every insurance number or financial detail. Keep more sensitive clinical or administrative documents in an appropriate place while making relevant emergency information accessible to the agreed helpers.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • When a phone number, care location, relevant health fact or contact willingness changes, update the master and replace active copies. If you retain old pages, mark them superseded. Tell the people who regularly use the sheet what changed rather than assuming they will notice a new date at the bottom.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    How many contacts should I list?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A first and a backup contact are a practical starting point, not a universal legal requirement. Choose people who have agreed to the role and can realistically be reached. More names do not help if the order, numbers or expected responsibilities are unclear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Does the sheet make someone my medical decision-maker?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    No. Listing a name for notification does not itself establish decision-making authority. Relevant legal documents and applicable law determine that role. Keep the contact order and any established legal role separately identified so readers do not confuse the two.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Should the sheet be on the fridge?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    That can be practical in some homes if agreed helpers know to look there, but it also exposes information to visitors. Choose a place that balances access and privacy for your situation. A hidden sheet nobody knows about and a public full medical history are both poor defaults.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Help, notify, inform
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Keep the order unambiguous
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Help
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Obtain emergency assistance when needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Notify
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Use the agreed first and backup contacts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Inform
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Provide relevant current facts or their location.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Do not delay an emergency call while seeking family approval.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  An emergency sheet separates obtaining help, notifying contacts and supplying relevant information.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Contact and authority
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  kicker
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Two roles that can overlap but are not identical
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Notification
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A contact can be someone to call or inform.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Legal role
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Decision-making authority depends on applicable arrangements and law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Evidence
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Keep the document location separate from the contact label.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A name on a contact sheet is not a legal appointment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Notification contacts and legal decision-making roles are distinguished with supporting document locations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Limits and verification

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • US-focused administration; requirements and individual circumstances vary.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Saved Reddit leads informed reader-language only; no anecdotes treated as factual authority. Quora was blocked in the saved research.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • No keyword-volume dataset or ranking guarantee. Product registry inspected, but live product workflows not tested.
