                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask the new clinic what documents, forms and records it needs. Bring current medication information, allergies and reported reactions, relevant history, the reason for the visit and any requested identification or insurance details. Start records-transfer questions before the visit and confirm receipt; do not assume two clinics can automatically see each other's files.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A first appointment often combines two jobs: establishing the administrative record and explaining why you need care. A short summary helps with the conversation, but the original reports and current instructions may still matter. Prepare both deliberately rather than arriving with an undifferentiated folder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Confirm the clinic-specific requirements
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This is US-focused intake preparation, not a universal rule about what every practice must demand or a guide to choosing treatment. Ask for the new-patient packet, accepted submission method, arrival arrangements and any requested referral or insurance authorization. If a requested document is unavailable, explain that before assuming you cannot be seen.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Also ask about communication access, interpreter arrangements, mobility needs or a support person. These practical questions belong at booking because they can affect whether the visit works for you. They should not depend on remembering to mention them after arrival.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Prepare the first-visit packet
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Confirm the appointment purpose, location, time and any instructions sent by the clinic.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Complete your sections of the intake forms using current sources; mark unknown answers rather than guessing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Prepare the current medication list, available labels or the clinic's requested product information, including nonprescription products and actual use.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write allergies or reactions, relevant conditions, surgeries or hospital stays, with dates or clearly labelled approximate timing.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Add relevant family history, identifying the relative and condition where known; say when information is unknown.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Write a short reason for the visit and your priority questions, with dated symptom notes if relevant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask both offices how required records will move and confirm what the new clinic actually received.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Current list checked with the patient on 2026-11-17
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Bring conflicting sources for professional review
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Past surgery

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Test performed by previous clinic
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Confirm report receipt and whether other material is needed
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Family history
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • One side known; other side unknown
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Do not fill unknown history with assumed negatives

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      What to ask about records transfer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask the new clinic which specific records are useful for the planned visit and how it receives them securely. Then ask the holder of those records about its process. Confirm the recipient, dates or categories requested and any action required from you. Keep a note of the request and a follow-up contact.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [HHS explains](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-individuals/medical-records/index.html) rights to access and request corrections to records held by covered organizations, with exceptions and qualifications. This article does not promise a particular transfer time or that a signed release is required in every situation. Ask about the actual process instead of treating one clinic's procedure as national law.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Medication disagreements should travel with the question
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A bottle, portal list and recent instruction may differ. Do not settle that difference by copying whichever one is easiest to read. Bring the relevant sources and explain what the person actually takes. Ask the prescriber or pharmacist to confirm the current instruction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [FDA pharmacist guidance](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/information-consumers-and-patients-drugs/stop-learn-go-tips-talking-your-pharmacist-learn-how-use-medicines-safely) emphasizes reporting actual use and changes. A new clinic should not receive an artificially neat list that hides an unresolved difference. Use the [medication-list guide](/guides/medication-list-what-to-write-down) to organize that question, not to choose treatment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      alt
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      A records-transfer sequence includes a specific request, correct destination, receipt check and follow-up.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not assume separate clinics automatically share every record.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      10
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Keep the summary honest and selective
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Use plain words for what you know. "Operation in about 2012, exact details requested" is better than a precise invented date. For family history, an unknown side of the family is different from no family history of a condition. For a current concern, describe onset and effect rather than presenting an online guess as a diagnosis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • [NIA preparation guidance](https://www.nia.nih.gov/health/medical-care-and-appointments/how-prepare-doctors-appointment) supports gathering history and asking for forms in advance. Your own summary is a starting point for review, not a substitute for the clinical record or permission to leave out information relevant to the assessment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Useful intake questions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What do you need me to bring or send, and how can I check that the records you requested arrived?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
