                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        I cannot obtain this document before the appointment. What should I bring instead, and does the visit need any different arrangement?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Conflicting record
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        This field differs from my current understanding. Can we review the sources rather than copy either version without checking?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        At the end
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Which outside records are still outstanding, who is following up, and what should I do if nothing arrives?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      If you are attending for someone else
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ask the person what support they want and ask the clinic about its arrangements for involvement, privacy and any legal authority it needs to establish. Do not log into another adult's portal using their credentials simply because you organize their forms. Use the authorized access route.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A support person can keep track of questions without taking over the conversation. If information should be discussed privately, tell the clinic. For a child or an adult with particular legal arrangements, verify the relevant requirements rather than assuming every relationship works the same way.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      After the first visit
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Review the printed or electronic instructions and ask about anything that differs from your notes. Update the relevant summary, record confirmed changes and keep outstanding transfer tasks open. Do not mark the whole history complete because the appointment happened.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • An incomplete file should not delay emergency help. If there is an urgent clinical concern before the new appointment, seek the appropriate advice or emergency service rather than waiting for the records packet or the first available routine slot.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      false

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Do I have to bring every medical record I own?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask which records the clinic wants for this visit. A concise summary plus relevant reports is easier to review than an unexplained archive, but the clinician may need specific source material. Keep an index and arrange secure transfer rather than assuming the summary is enough.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Should I bring medicine bottles or a written list?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ask the clinic what it prefers and bring enough information to identify the actual products and instructions. A list can help, while labels and recent instructions help resolve questions. If they disagree, do not choose a dose yourself; show the discrepancy for professional review.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        What if the old clinic has not sent the records?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tell the new clinic what was requested and what remains outstanding. Ask how the visit should proceed and who will follow up. Do not say the file is complete without confirmation, and do not invent missing details to fill the new-patient form.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Give the school the accurate information required for its program and the facts needed for safe participation and support. Ask its designated health contact about anything unclear, sensitive or not captured by the form. A sitter, school and treating clinician need different information; neither "print everything" nor "only answer the boxes" is a reliable rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The full family record may be the easiest page to send, especially just before a deadline. But it can expose unrelated private information while still failing to explain the actual care arrangement. Decide who needs what for this purpose, then check that the selected page is current and not misleading.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Start with the task, not a fixed list of secrets
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • This is US-focused information-sharing administration, not legal advice about every school or guidance on withholding information from a treating clinician. Requirements, privacy protections, student rights and permissions can differ. For a specific dispute or sensitive concern, use the school's appropriate health or privacy contact and qualified advice where needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A short form may not cover every relevant need. If the child needs a care arrangement, accommodation or clinician plan, ask how to supply it and who should receive it. Do not remove a safety-relevant fact merely because a template did not provide a convenient field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          list
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Check the page before it leaves you
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          checkable
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          true
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Identify the recipient and what they are being asked to do. A classroom teacher, nurse and intake clinician do not necessarily need identical copies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Read the current requested form and any separate instructions about health support, medication or emergency plans.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Confirm current facts against the appropriate record. Keep unknown information labelled instead of inventing a complete-looking answer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ask about an unclear field, a broad history request or relevant information that has no place on the form.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Retain safety-relevant context and existing clinician instructions needed for the arrangement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Remove unrelated information from a selected handout only after checking that the omission does not make it misleading.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Use the organization's appropriate channel and keep a record of what you sent, when and to whom.

Use the worksheet without an account or purchase.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A health-sharing decision checks recipient, purpose, needed information and the submission route.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do not let a form omission hide a relevant care need.
