                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Invented example: one child, different recipients
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          columns
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Recipient
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Purpose
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • What to check
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          rows
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • School health contact
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Arrange safe participation and required records
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Current form, relevant health facts and any requested clinician plan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Evening sitter
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Provide the agreed care during those hours
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Address, contacts, current relevant care instructions and routines
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Treating clinician
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Assess health and make clinical decisions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Relevant full history, current products, symptoms and uncertainties
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • General event volunteer
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Carry out a specific assigned role
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Necessary task information and emergency arrangements, not the whole family archive
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          7
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A shorter page must not appear complete when it is not
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If you make a selected medication or history page, identify its scope. "Information for this school arrangement" describes something different from "complete medical history." Do not write "no medicines" because you excluded private rows from a printout. A missing entry and an affirmative negative are different statements.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Similarly, avoid turning a mild previous reaction into a claim that future reactions will be mild. Supply the relevant recorded facts and clinician plan without creating your own risk forecast. A privacy choice should not quietly rewrite the meaning of the health information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          8
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Ask questions about access and storage
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • [Joint HHS and Education guidance](https://www.hhs.gov/sites/default/files/2019-hipaa-ferpa-joint-guidance.pdf) explains the relationship between FERPA and HIPAA for student records. The applicable framework depends on the record and setting; a school health page is not automatically governed exactly like a hospital chart. This article does not determine the rule for a particular institution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ask who receives the submission, who can access it for the program, how updates are made and which secure method to use. Do not assume that writing "confidential" prevents copying or that every organization has the same retention and deletion rules. Obtain an answer from the actual holder when it matters.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          A selected health handout is distinguished from a complete history and a dated replacement copy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          caption
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Omitting an entry must not become a false statement that none exists.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Questions before sending
