                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Unclear requirement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Is this field required for this program, and can the health lead explain what information is needed?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Relevant fact without a box
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            There is a current care need that the form does not capture. Who should receive the details and any clinician plan?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Broad access
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Who can access this information and what is the appropriate channel for sensitive attachments?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • situation
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Selected handout
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            line
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            This page is selected for this care arrangement, not a complete medical history. Please tell me if you need additional relevant information.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          11
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The sitter version still needs a real handover
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A sitter needs information that lets them provide the agreed care safely, not merely a list of diagnoses. [AAP babysitting guidance](https://www.healthychildren.org/English/safety-prevention/at-home/Pages/Babysitting-Reminders.aspx) includes contact, address and specific-needs preparation. Explain applicable instructions and show the relevant supplies or plans.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Do not assume that a medicine taken outside the visit is automatically irrelevant, or that a short visit needs no medical context. Ask the clinician when relevance is uncertain. Equally, the sitter does not automatically need insurance identifiers, unrelated family history or other people's medical details simply because those appear in the master binder.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          12
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Clinician sharing is a different decision
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A treating clinician may need information that would not belong on a casual handover. Do not apply the sitter's short selection rule to an assessment. If you are worried about a sensitive topic, ask how to discuss it privately and how information is recorded or shared.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For a child or teenager, privacy and parental access can depend on the service and applicable law. Do not promise secrecy or unrestricted parental access based on this article. Ask the clinical team about the actual arrangement and obtain appropriate advice for a disputed issue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          13
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          After a change or a mistaken disclosure
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • When a relevant fact changes, update the recipient through the agreed route and identify the earlier copy it replaces. A newer master file does not update a school's old attachment automatically. Keep the sent version and confirmation so everyone can identify what is current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • If information went to the wrong person, contact the recipient and the relevant organization promptly, request appropriate handling and follow its privacy process. Do not promise yourself that an email recall, deletion request or print filter can retrieve every copy. Review the remaining copies without removing information someone still needs for safety.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          14
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          faq
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Should I answer only the exact boxes on the school form?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Start with the form, but do not ignore a relevant care need because there is no box for it. Ask the designated health contact how to provide the information. If a request seems unrelated or unclear, ask why it is needed rather than guessing or silently omitting it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Is the school health record protected by HIPAA?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Not automatically. FERPA, HIPAA and other applicable rules depend on the setting, holder and record. Ask the school about its privacy arrangements rather than relying on a label. This guide does not determine which law controls a particular school or disclosure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • q
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Can I leave a sensitive medicine off every printed page?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A print choice does not decide clinical relevance. Before sharing a selected page, consider its purpose and whether an omission would make it unsafe or misleading. Discuss uncertain relevance with the clinician or designated health professional instead of allowing a software filter to make that judgment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Three questions for every handout
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          steps
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • label
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Who
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Identify the specific recipient and role.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            detail
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use the appropriate channel and keep the sent version.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Do not let a form omission hide a relevant care need.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            8.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             12.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             13.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             14. faq (faq; new or rewritten block)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Actual rewritten content, section by section
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Use one clearly separated record per person and a shared next-action list for the work you coordinate. Give each task a named owner and follow-up date. Ask your parent what support they want, confirm clinic access arrangements and keep any legal authority documents distinct from the health summaries. A combined filing system does not merge people's rights or care needs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The hard part may be two different requests arriving during the same morning: a child's school packet and a parent's clinic follow-up. Both need reliable information, but they do not need the same information or the same permission. Organize the work together without treating everyone as one family medical record.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              unchangedFromBaseline
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              false
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • position
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              kind
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              heading
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Start with the person, not the paperwork
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              paragraphs
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • This guide covers US caregiving administration, not clinical care, capacity assessment or a legal determination about who can decide. A parent may want help finding documents but not want you attending appointments. Another may want extensive help while keeping a particular topic private. Ask before designing access around your own convenience.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • [CDC care-plan guidance](https://www.cdc.gov/caregiving/guidelines/index.html) recommends involving the person receiving care and organizing relevant information. Use that conversation to establish what the record is for, who maintains it and what other helpers may see. A template does not decide those boundaries.
